Presidential Records
summary: Sets procedures for executive privilege claims over Presidential records NARA plans to release, with 30-day notice and review by the Attorney General and Counsel to the President. Revokes EO 13233.

title: Ethics Commitments by Executive Branch Personnel
summary: Requires every executive agency appointee to sign an ethics pledge covering a lobbyist gift ban and revolving-door limits, and sets waiver, agency administration and enforcement procedures.

title: Ensuring Lawful Interrogations
summary: Limits interrogation of detainees in armed conflicts to Army Field Manual 2-22.3 techniques, revokes EO 13440, and requires the CIA to close its detention facilities.

title: Review and Disposition of Individuals Detained At the Guantanamo Bay Naval Base and Closure of Detention Facilities
summary: Orders the Guantánamo detention facilities closed within 1 year and directs an interagency review, led by the Attorney General, of each detainee's transfer, release or prosecution. It halts military commission proceedings.

title: Review of Detention Policy Options
summary: Establishes a Special Task Force on Detainee Disposition, co-chaired by the Attorney General and Secretary of Defense, to review lawful options for captured individuals and report in 180 days.

title: Economy in Government Contracting
summary: Makes costs of activities to persuade employees on organizing and collective bargaining unallowable under Government contracts, and directs the FAR Council to adopt implementing rules within 150 days.

title: Nondisplacement of Qualified Workers Under Service Contracts
summary: Requires successor service contracts to include a clause giving the predecessor's non-supervisory employees a right of first refusal of jobs; assigns Labor enforcement and revokes Executive Order 13204.

title: Notification of Employee Rights Under Federal Labor Laws
summary: Requires federal contracts to include a clause obligating contractors to post notices of employees' rights under federal labor laws, with the Secretary of Labor enforcing it, and revokes Executive Order 13201.

title: Revocation of Certain Executive Orders Concerning Regulatory Planning and Review
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 13258 and 13422, which amended Executive Order 12866 on regulatory planning and review, and directs OMB and agencies to promptly rescind implementing policies consistent with law.

title: Amendments to Executive Order 13199 and Establishment of the President's Advisory Council for Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships
summary: Renames the White House faith-based office as the Office of Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships, adds duties to it, and establishes a President's Advisory Council of up to 25 members.

title: Further Amendments to Executive Order 12835, Establishment of the National Economic Council
summary: Adds six officials to the National Economic Council's membership in Executive Order 12835, including the Secretaries of Health and Human Services and Education, and relletters the following subsections.

title: Further Amendments to Executive Order 12859, Establishment of the Domestic Policy Council
summary: Amends section 2 of Executive Order 12859 by striking three positions and inserting others, including Assistant to the President for Energy and Climate Change and Chief Technology Officer.

title: Establishment of the President's Economic Recovery Advisory Board
summary: Establishes the President's Economic Recovery Advisory Board within the Treasury Department, with up to 17 outside members, to advise the President on economic and financial policy; it ends after 2 years unless extended.

title: Use of Project Labor Agreements for Federal Construction Projects
summary: Permits executive agencies to require project labor agreements on federal construction projects costing $25 million or more, and revokes Executive Orders 13202 and 13208.

title: Establishment of the White House Office of Urban Affairs
summary: Establishes the White House Office of Urban Affairs in the Executive Office of the President to coordinate urban policy across agencies and work with state and local officials, nonprofits and the private sector.

title: Amending Executive Order 13390
summary: Extends the work of the Coordinator of Federal Support for the Recovery and Rebuilding of the Gulf Coast Region from February 28, 2009 to September 30, 2009, by amending Executive Order 13390.

title: Removing Barriers to Responsible Scientific Research Involving Human Stem Cells
summary: Permits NIH to support and conduct human stem cell research, including embryonic, and requires new NIH guidance within 120 days. Revokes EO 13435 and ends the 2001 funding statement.

title: Establishing a White House Council on Women And Girls
summary: Establishes a White House Council on Women and Girls, made up of Cabinet and other senior officials, to coordinate Federal policy on women and girls and submit an interagency plan within 150 days.

title: Establishment of the White House Office of Health Reform
summary: Establishes a White House Office of Health Reform in the Executive Office of the President to lead health policy, and directs HHS to set up its own Office of Health Reform to coordinate with it.

title: Chesapeake Bay Protection and Restoration
summary: Establishes a Federal Leadership Committee chaired by the EPA Administrator to coordinate Chesapeake Bay restoration, and directs agency reports, a restoration strategy, and annual action plans.

title: Establishing a White House Council on Automotive Communities and Workers
summary: Establishes the White House Council on Automotive Communities and Workers, co-chaired by the Labor Secretary and the NEC Director, to coordinate Federal policy and programs affecting auto communities and workers.

title: Waiver Under the Trade Act of 1974 With Respect to the Republic of Belarus
summary: Waives the application of subsections (a) and (b) of section 402 of the Trade Act of 1974 with respect to the Republic of Belarus, following the President's report to Congress under subsection 402(c)(2).

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues fifteen federal advisory committees until September 30, 2011 and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for them to the head of each listed department or agency.

title: Amending Executive Order 13390
summary: Extends the work of the Coordinator of Federal Support for the Recovery and Rebuilding of the Gulf Coast Region by changing the end date in Executive Order 13390 from September 30, 2009, to April 1, 2010.

title: Federal Leadership On Reducing Text Messaging While Driving
summary: Prohibits federal employees from text messaging while driving on official business or using government-supplied devices, and directs agencies to implement it and encourage contractors to adopt similar bans.

title: Federal Leadership in Environmental, Energy, and Economic Performance
summary: Requires federal agencies to set 2020 greenhouse gas reduction targets and meet water, waste, building and purchasing goals through annual Strategic Sustainability Performance Plans.

title: Increasing Participation of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders in Federal Programs
summary: Establishes a President's Advisory Commission on Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders and an interagency White House Initiative, requiring agency plans to increase AAPI participation in Federal programs.

title: Amending Executive Order 13462
summary: Amends Executive Order 13462 to cap the PIAB at 16 members, allow Co-Chairs, and require forwarding of information on possible federal criminal violations to the Attorney General.

title: Amendments to Executive Orders 13183 and 13494
summary: Amends EO 13183 to expand the Puerto Rico Task Force's duties and require a report within 1 year, and amends EO 13494 to treat employee-relations costs as allowable contractor costs.

title: Employment of Veterans in the Federal Government
summary: Establishes an interagency Council on Veterans Employment and a Veterans Employment Initiative requiring agencies to set up veterans employment offices and plans, with OPM to develop a government-wide strategic plan.

title: Establishment of the Financial Fraud Enforcement Task Force
summary: Establishes an interagency Financial Fraud Enforcement Task Force led by the Justice Department and chaired by the Attorney General, to advise on financial crime cases; it replaces the Corporate Fraud Task Force.

title: Reducing Improper Payments
summary: Directs OMB to identify high-priority programs and set improper payment reduction targets, Treasury to publish payment data online, and agencies to name accountable officials.

title: Establishing the Presidential Commission for the Study of Bioethical Issues
summary: Establishes the Presidential Commission for the Study of Bioethical Issues within HHS, with up to 13 members, to advise the President on bioethical issues from biomedical advances; it supersedes EO 13237.

title: Creating Labor-Management Forums to Improve Delivery of Government Services
summary: Establishes the National Council on Federal Labor-Management Relations and requires agencies with union representation to create labor-management forums and submit implementation plans to the Council.

title: Half-Day Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies on Thursday, December 24, 2009
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies for the last half of the workday on December 24, 2009 and excuses employees from duty, while letting agency heads keep essential offices and staff open for national security or public need.

title: Amending Executive Order 12425 Designating Interpol as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain Privileges, Exemptions, and Immunities
summary: Removes the exception in Executive Order 12425 that withheld certain International Organizations Immunities Act provisions (Sections 2(c), 3, 4, 5, 6) from INTERPOL, extending those privileges and immunities to it.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2010 pay schedules for statutory pay systems, the Senior Executive Service, executive, legislative and judicial offices, the uniformed services and administrative law judges, and sets locality pay. It supersedes EO 13483.

title: Classified National Security Information
summary: Prescribes a uniform system for classifying, safeguarding and declassifying national security information, and revokes Executive Orders 12958 and 13292.

title: Establishing Federal Capability for the Timely Provision of Medical Countermeasures Following a Biological Attack
summary: Directs HHS and DHS to establish a national Postal Service model for delivering medical countermeasures after a large-scale biological attack, and directs plans for a Federal rapid response and continuity.

title: Establishment of the Council of Governors
summary: Establishes a Council of Governors of 10 State Governors, no more than five from one party, to exchange views with federal officials on National Guard, homeland defense, and civil support matters.

title: Ordering the Selected Reserve and Certain Individual Ready Reserve Members of the Armed Forces to Active Duty
summary: Authorizes the Secretaries of Defense and Homeland Security to order Selected Reserve units and members, and certain Individual Ready Reserve members, to active duty for Haiti earthquake relief operations.

title: President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability
summary: Establishes the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability within Treasury, with up to 22 appointed members, to advise the President and Treasury Secretary on promoting financial capability; it ends after 2 years unless extended.

title: National Commission on Fiscal Responsibility and Reform
summary: Establishes an 18-member National Commission on Fiscal Responsibility and Reform in the Executive Office of the President to propose recommendations to balance the budget, excluding interest, by 2015.

title: Promoting Excellence, Innovation, and Sustainability at Historically Black Colleges and Universities
summary: Establishes the White House Initiative on HBCUs in the Department of Education and a President's Board of Advisors, requires agency plans to strengthen HBCU capacity, and revokes Executive Order 13256.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Defense
summary: Sets the order in which listed Defense Department officials, starting with the Deputy Secretary, act as Secretary of Defense when the Secretary is unable to serve, and revokes Executive Order 13394.

title: National Export Initiative
summary: Establishes an Export Promotion Cabinet to coordinate the National Export Initiative, assigns agencies export-promotion tasks, and requires a comprehensive plan to the President within 180 days.

title: Ensuring Enforcement and Implementation of Abortion Restrictions in the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act
summary: Directs OMB and HHS to develop model segregation guidelines for state insurance commissioners within 180 days, and directs HHS to ensure community health centers comply with abortion funding limits.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons Contributing to the Conflict in Somalia
summary: Declares a national emergency over Somalia and blocks the property of persons listed in the Annex or designated by Treasury for threatening Somalia's stability, obstructing aid, or arms violations.

title: Interagency Group on Insular Areas
summary: Establishes the Interagency Group on Insular Areas within Interior to advise the President on policies for Guam, American Samoa, the U.S. Virgin Islands and the Northern Mariana Islands; supersedes EO 13299.

title: Establishing the President's Management Advisory Board
summary: Establishes the President's Management Advisory Board within GSA to advise on business practices in federal management, with up to 18 members, including 17 private-sector appointees, and a 2-year term.

title: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
summary: Establishes the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, up to 21 members, to advise the President on science, technology and innovation policy, and revokes Executive Order 13226.

title: Interagency Task Force on Veterans Small Business Development
summary: Establishes an Interagency Task Force on Veterans Small Business Development within the SBA to coordinate agency efforts on capital access and contracting goals for veteran-owned small businesses.

title: Temporary Organization To Facilitate a Strategic Partnership With the Republic of Iraq
summary: Establishes the Iraq Strategic Partnership Office, a temporary organization within the Department of State, to support the U.S.–Iraq strategic partnership and take over the functions, personnel and assets of the ITAO.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Agriculture
summary: Establishes the order in which listed Agriculture officials act as Secretary when both Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unavailable, and revokes Executive Order 13241 on the same subject.

title: National Commission on the BP Deepwater Horizon Oil Spill and Offshore Drilling
summary: Establishes a Commission of up to 7 members to examine the causes of the Deepwater Horizon oil disaster, develop offshore drilling safeguards, and report to the President within 6 months of its first meeting.

title: Establishing the National Prevention, Health Promotion, and Public Health Council
summary: Establishes the National Prevention, Health Promotion, and Public Health Council within HHS, chaired by the Surgeon General, to develop a national prevention strategy, and creates an outside Advisory Group.

title: President's Council on Fitness, Sports, and Nutrition
summary: Amends Executive Order 13265 to rename the council the President's Council on Fitness, Sports, and Nutrition, add nutrition to its mission, and have HHS run a national program with up to 25 members.

title: Optimizing the Security of Biological Select Agents and Toxins in the United States
summary: Directs HHS and Agriculture to designate a Tier 1 subset of the Select Agent List within 18 months, and establishes a Federal Experts Security Advisory Panel on BSAT security.

title: Stewardship of the Ocean, Our Coasts, and the Great Lakes
summary: Establishes a National Ocean Council to guide agency actions on the ocean, coasts and Great Lakes under the Task Force's recommendations, and directs coastal and marine spatial planning. Revokes EO 13366.

title: Increasing Federal Employment of Individuals With Disabilities
summary: Directs OPM to design model hiring strategies and training, and each agency to adopt a plan with numerical goals and a senior official, to recruit and retain more federal employees with disabilities.

title: Classified National Security Information Program for State, Local, Tribal, and Private Sector Entities
summary: Establishes a program to safeguard and govern access to classified information shared with state, local, tribal and private sector entities, with DHS as Executive Agent, and creates an SLTPS Policy Advisory Committee.

title: Establishment of Pakistan and Afghanistan Support Office
summary: Establishes the Pakistan and Afghanistan Support Office, a temporary organization within the State Department, to support agencies in strengthening the Afghan and Pakistani governments, and absorbs the Afghanistan Support Office.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons With Respect to North Korea
summary: Blocks the property of persons listed in the Annex and of those Treasury determines involved in North Korean arms trade, luxury goods, or illicit finance, and expands the emergency declared in EO 13466.

title: 2010 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts II and IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, as described in the Annex attached, taking effect 30 days from the date of this order.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons With Respect to Serious Human Rights Abuses by the Government of Iran and Taking Certain Other Actions
summary: Blocks the property of persons listed in the Annex and of persons the Treasury Secretary determines are Iranian government officials or others responsible for serious human rights abuses, or who support them.

title: Establishing the Gulf Coast Ecosystem Restoration Task Force
summary: Establishes the Gulf Coast Ecosystem Restoration Task Force of federal, state and tribal representatives to coordinate restoration efforts and prepare a Gulf of Mexico restoration strategy within one year.

title: White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics
summary: Establishes the White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics in the Department of Education, with an interagency working group and a presidential advisory commission of up to 30 members.

title: Controlled Unclassified Information
summary: Establishes a uniform Controlled Unclassified Information program for the executive branch, with the National Archives and Records Administration as Executive Agent to approve categories and markings and oversee agency compliance.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Justice
summary: Sets the order of succession to act as Attorney General after the Deputy and Associate AGs: U.S. Attorneys for Eastern District of Virginia, Minnesota, and Arizona. Revokes Executive Order 13481.

title: Export Enforcement Coordination Center
summary: Establishes an interagency Export Enforcement Coordination Center within the Department of Homeland Security to coordinate export control enforcement and intelligence exchange among federal departments and agencies.

title: Fundamental Principles and Policymaking Criteria for Partnerships With Faith-Based and Other Neighborhood Organizations
summary: Amends EO 13279 to set principles for social service funding, incl. beneficiary referral protections, and creates an Interagency Working Group to review agency policies and report within 120 days.

title: White House Council for Community Solutions
summary: Establishes the White House Council for Community Solutions within CNCS, with up to 30 outside members, to recommend ways to support community-developed solutions and civic participation; it ends after 2 years unless renewed.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2011 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, VA, Senior Executive Service, Executive Schedule, Congress, judges, uniformed services and ALJs, sets locality payments, and supersedes EO 13525.

title: Recruiting and Hiring Students and Recent Graduates
summary: Establishes the Internship Program and Recent Graduates Program, which with the modified Presidential Management Fellows Program form the Pathways Programs, and directs OPM to issue implementing regulations.

title: Improving Regulation and Regulatory Review
summary: Directs agencies to base regulations on public participation, cost-benefit principles and sound science, and to submit plans within 120 days for periodic review of existing significant rules.

title: Establishment of the President's Council on Jobs and Competitiveness
summary: Establishes the President's Council on Jobs and Competitiveness in Treasury to advise on economic growth and job creation, ends after 2 years unless extended, and revokes Executive Order 13501.

title: Establishment of the Intellectual Property Enforcement Advisory Committees
summary: Establishes two interagency IP enforcement advisory committees, chaired by the IP Enforcement Coordinator, to advise on and develop the Joint Strategic Plan required under the PRO IP Act.

title: Blocking Property and Prohibiting Certain Transactions Related to Libya
summary: Declares a national emergency over Libya and blocks property of listed persons, senior Libyan officials, Qadhafi's children, human rights abusers, and the Libyan government and Central Bank.

title: Periodic Review of Individuals Detained at Guantánamo Bay Naval Station Pursuant to the Authorization for Use of Military Force
summary: Requires periodic review by Periodic Review Boards of continued law of war detention for certain Guantánamo detainees, with initial hearings within 1 year, then full reviews every 3 years.

title: Extending Provisions of the International Organizations Immunities Act to the Office of the High Representative in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the International Civilian Office in Kosovo
summary: Extends International Organizations Immunities Act privileges and immunities to the Office of the High Representative in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the International Civilian Office in Kosovo.

title: Amendments to Executive Orders 12824, 12835, 12859, and 13532, Reestablishment Pursuant to Executive Order 13498, and Revocation of Executive Order 13507
summary: Amends four earlier orders (a Transportation medal, NEC and DPC membership, an HBCU regulatory citation), reestablishes the faith-based advisory council for 2 years, and revokes EO 13507.

title: Prohibiting Certain Transactions With Respect to North Korea
summary: Prohibits importing goods, services, or technology from North Korea into the United States, bans transactions that evade the ban, and authorizes the Treasury Secretary to issue implementing rules.

title: Streamlining Service Delivery and Improving Customer Service
summary: Requires each agency to develop a Customer Service Plan with OMB within 180 days, including a technology-based signature initiative and customer feedback, and to publish it on its Open Government web page.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons With Respect to Human Rights Abuses in Syria
summary: Blocks the U.S. property of persons listed in the Annex and others the Treasury Secretary determines responsible for human rights abuses in Syria, expanding the Syria national emergency of EO 13338.

title: Blocking Property of Senior Officials of the Government of Syria
summary: Blocks the U.S.-held property of persons listed in the Annex and of persons the Treasury Secretary determines to be senior Syrian government officials, their affiliates or supporters, and bars related transactions and donations.

title: Authorizing the Implementation of Certain Sanctions Set Forth in the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996, as Amended
summary: Directs the Treasury Secretary to implement Iran Sanctions Act section 6 sanctions on designated persons: bar loans, foreign exchange and credit transfers, block property, and restrict imports.

title: Establishment of the White House Rural Council
summary: Establishes the White House Rural Council, chaired by the Secretary of Agriculture, to coordinate federal programs and engagement with rural communities and make policy recommendations to the President.

title: Delivering an Efficient, Effective, and Accountable Government
summary: Establishes an 11-member Government Accountability and Transparency Board to oversee fraud detection and spending transparency, and has agency COOs and CFOs lead performance reviews and cost savings.

title: Establishment of the SelectUSA Initiative
summary: Establishes the SelectUSA Initiative in the Department of Commerce to coordinate federal efforts to attract and retain business investment, and creates a Federal Interagency Investment Working Group.

title: Coordinating Policies on Automotive Communities and Workers
summary: Directs the Secretary of Labor to coordinate federal policies and programs affecting automotive communities and workers and advise the President on them; revokes Executive Order 13509.

title: Regulation and Independent Regulatory Agencies
summary: Asks independent regulatory agencies to follow E.O. 13563's principles as law permits and to publish plans within 120 days for periodic review of existing significant rules.

title: Interagency Working Group on Coordination of Domestic Energy Development and Permitting in Alaska
summary: Establishes an interagency working group, led by the Interior Department, to coordinate federal permitting and environmental review of onshore and offshore energy development projects in Alaska.

title: Blocking Property of Transnational Criminal Organizations
summary: Declares a national emergency over transnational criminal organizations and blocks property of those listed in the Annex and of persons Treasury designates, with Treasury authorized to issue implementing rules.

title: Blocking Property of the Government of Syria and Prohibiting Certain Transactions With Respect to Syria
summary: Blocks the property of the Government of Syria and of persons found to support or act for blocked persons, and bars new U.S. investment in Syria, services exports to it, and dealings in Syrian-origin petroleum.

title: Establishing a Coordinated Government-Wide Initiative to Promote Diversity and Inclusion in the Federal Workforce
summary: Directs OPM and OMB to set up a government-wide diversity and inclusion initiative and issue a strategic plan within 90 days; agencies must then submit and implement their own plans.

title: Developing an Integrated Strategic Counterterrorism Communications Initiative and Establishing a Temporary Organization to Support Certain Government-wide Communications Activities Directed Abroad
summary: Assigns the State Department's Center for Strategic Counterterrorism Communications to coordinate government-wide counterterrorism communications aimed abroad, and establishes a temporary Counterterrorism Communications Support Office.

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues 15 listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2013, and amends Executive Order 13515 to change the Co-Chairs and agency membership of the Asian American and Pacific Islander initiative.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board to Investigate Disputes Between Certain Railroads Represented by the National Carriers' Conference Committee of the National Railway Labor Conference and Their Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a five-member Emergency Board, effective October 7, 2011, to investigate and report within 30 days on disputes between certain railroads and employees represented by certain labor organizations.

title: Structural Reforms To Improve the Security of Classified Networks and the Responsible Sharing and Safeguarding of Classified Information
summary: Establishes a Steering Committee, a classified-information sharing office, and an Insider Threat Task Force, and names an Executive Agent, to secure classified networks and govern sharing of classified information.

title: Reducing Prescription Drug Shortages
summary: Directs the FDA to require drug manufacturers to give advance notice of discontinuances that could cause shortages, expedite regulatory reviews, and report stockpiling or exorbitant pricing to DOJ.

title: Promoting Efficient Spending
summary: Requires each agency to plan a cut of at least 20 percent below FY2010 levels by FY2013 in travel, IT devices, printing, fleet, and promotional item costs, with plans due to OMB in 45 days.

title: Authorizing the Imposition of Certain Sanctions With Respect to the Provision of Goods, Services, Technology, or Support for Iran's Energy and Petrochemical Sectors
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of State to impose trade, financial, procurement and asset-blocking sanctions on persons who provide Iran goods, services, technology or support above set values for its petroleum or petrochemical sectors.

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues seven listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2013 and one until September 30, 2012. Amends Executive Order 13530 so the Financial Capability Council ends January 29, 2013 unless extended.

title: Improving American Indian and Alaska Native Educational Opportunities and Strengthening Tribal Colleges and Universities
summary: Establishes the White House Initiative on American Indian and Alaska Native Education, co-chaired by the Education and Interior Secretaries, with an interagency working group and agency plans; revokes EOs 13270 and 13336.

title: 2011 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts III and IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, as set out in an attached Annex, with the amendments taking effect 30 days after the order's date and not applying retroactively.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2012 pay schedules for General Schedule, Foreign Service, SES, Executive Schedule, judges, uniformed services and ALJs, provides locality pay under Schedule 9, and supersedes EO 13561.

title: Instituting a National Action Plan On Women, Peace, And Security
summary: Requires a National Action Plan on Women, Peace, and Security, and directs State, Defense and USAID to designate coordinators and submit implementation plans within 150 days of its release.

title: Amendments to Executive Orders 12131 and 13539
summary: Revises the membership of the President's Export Council and directs the Department of Energy to fund and support PCAST, with the Energy Secretary performing the President's FACA functions.

title: Establishing Visa and Foreign Visitor Processing Goals and the Task Force On Travel and Competitiveness
summary: Establishes a Task Force on Travel and Competitiveness to develop a National Travel and Tourism Strategy, and directs State and Homeland Security to plan faster visa processing, including 40% more capacity in China and Brazil.

title: Assignment of Functions Relating to Certain Promotion and Appointment Actions in the Armed Forces
summary: Assigns to the Secretary of Defense the President's functions under title 10 on certain officer reports, promotion eligibility extensions and Marine Band appointments, limiting how they may be reassigned.

title: Blocking Property of the Government of Iran and Iranian Financial Institutions
summary: Blocks all property of the Government of Iran, the Central Bank of Iran and Iranian financial institutions within U.S. jurisdiction, and delegates implementation and NDAA section 1245 authorities to Treasury and State.

title: Establishing the President's Global Development Council
summary: Establishes the President's Global Development Council within USAID, with up to 12 outside members, to advise the President on global development policy and public-private partnerships; it terminates after 2 years unless renewed.

title: Establishment of the Interagency Trade Enforcement Center
summary: Establishes the Interagency Trade Enforcement Center within USTR to coordinate enforcement of U.S. trade rights and domestic trade laws among USTR, State, Treasury, Justice, Agriculture, Commerce, DHS and ODNI.

title: Establishing a White House Council on Strong Cities, Strong Communities
summary: Establishes a White House Council on Strong Cities, Strong Communities within HUD, co-chaired by the HUD Secretary and the Domestic Policy adviser, to coordinate agency technical assistance to local communities.

title: National Defense Resources Preparedness
summary: Delegates Defense Production Act priorities, allocations, loan, purchase and other authorities to agency heads by resource area, sets up the DPA Committee and National Defense Executive Reserve, and revokes EO 12919.

title: Improving Performance of Federal Permitting and Review of Infrastructure Projects
summary: Establishes a Steering Committee, chaired by the Chief Performance Officer, to improve federal infrastructure permitting and review, and requires a Federal Plan and agency plans to cut permitting times.

title: Supporting Safe and Responsible Development of Unconventional Domestic Natural Gas Resources
summary: Establishes an interagency working group, chaired by the Domestic Policy Council Director, to coordinate federal agency policy, information sharing and planning on unconventional domestic natural gas development.

title: Blocking the Property and Suspending Entry Into the United States of Certain Persons With Respect to Grave Human Rights Abuses by the Governments of Iran and Syria via Information Technology
summary: Blocks the property of persons listed in the Annex or designated by Treasury for providing technology used in Iranian or Syrian human rights abuses, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Establishing Principles of Excellence for Educational Institutions Serving Service Members, Veterans, Spouses, and Other Family Members
summary: Directs Defense, Veterans Affairs and Education to establish Principles of Excellence for schools receiving military and veterans education benefits, and to implement them and plan stronger complaint enforcement.

title: Prohibiting Certain Transactions With and Suspending Entry Into the United States of Foreign Sanctions Evaders With Respect to Iran and Syria
summary: Authorizes Treasury to bar transactions with foreign persons who evade or violate Iran and Syria sanctions, and suspends the entry into the United States of such persons.

title: Promoting International Regulatory Cooperation
summary: Tasks the Regulatory Working Group with coordinating international regulatory cooperation and issuing guidelines. Requires agencies to report such activities in Regulatory Plans and consider foreign approaches.

title: Identifying and Reducing Regulatory Burdens
summary: Directs agencies to invite regular public suggestions on regulations for retrospective review, prioritize savings and burden reductions, and report on progress to OIRA, with drafts due September 10, 2012.

title: Blocking Property of Persons Threatening the Peace, Security, or Stability of Yemen
summary: Declares a national emergency and blocks the property of persons Treasury, consulting State, determines threaten Yemen's peace, security, or stability, including by obstructing its political transition.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Agriculture
summary: Sets the order of succession for acting Secretary of Agriculture when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unavailable, listing 15 officials, and revokes Executive Order 13542 of May 13, 2010.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Commerce
summary: Sets the order in which nine Commerce Department officials, starting with the Deputy Secretary, act as Secretary of Commerce when the Secretary dies, resigns or cannot serve. Revokes Executive Order 13242 and a 2002 memorandum.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Environmental Protection Agency
summary: Sets the order in which listed EPA officials, starting with the General Counsel, act as Administrator when the Administrator and Deputy are unavailable, and revokes Executive Orders 13261 and 13344.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Office of Management and Budget
summary: Sets an order of succession of 13 OMB officers, starting with the Deputy Director for Management, to act as OMB Director when the Director and Deputy Director are unavailable. Revokes Executive Order 13370.

title: Accelerating Broadband Infrastructure Deployment
summary: Establishes a Broadband Deployment on Federal Property Working Group and directs agencies to adopt consistent broadband siting strategies, uniform permit templates, and dig-once highway conduit practices.

title: Blocking Property of the Government of the Russian Federation Relating to the Disposition of Highly Enriched Uranium Extracted From Nuclear Weapons
summary: Blocks Russian government property directly related to the HEU Agreements within U.S. jurisdiction, voids judicial attachments against it, and declares a national emergency; Treasury implements.

title: Assignment of National Security and Emergency Preparedness Communications Functions
summary: Establishes an NS/EP Communications Executive Committee and a DHS-run Joint Program Office, assigns communications duties to OSTP, Defense, DHS, Commerce, GSA, DNI and FCC, and revokes EO 12472.

title: Blocking Property of Persons Threatening the Peace, Security, or Stability of Burma
summary: Blocks property of persons determined to threaten Burma's peace or stability, commit human rights abuses there, or supply North Korean arms to Burma, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Taking Additional Steps to Address the National Emergency With Respect to Somalia
summary: Amends EO 13536 to block property of persons involved in Somali charcoal trade, misappropriating public assets, or violence against civilians, and prohibits importing Somali charcoal into the U.S.

title: White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for African Americans
summary: Establishes the White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for African Americans in the Department of Education, with an interagency working group and a presidential advisory commission of up to 25 members.

title: Authorizing Additional Sanctions With Respect to Iran
summary: Authorizes sanctions on foreign financial institutions and other persons that knowingly buy Iranian petroleum or petrochemicals or deal with NIOC or NICO, including correspondent account limits and asset blocking.

title: Preventing and Responding to Violence Against Women and Girls Globally
summary: Establishes an Interagency Working Group, co-chaired by the Secretary of State and USAID Administrator, to coordinate agency implementation of the global strategy to prevent and respond to gender-based violence.

title: Accelerating Investment in Industrial Energy Efficiency
summary: Directs Energy, Commerce, Agriculture and EPA to coordinate policies encouraging industrial energy efficiency investment, including a goal of 40 gigawatts of new industrial CHP by end of 2020.

title: Improving Access to Mental Health Services for Veterans, Service Members, and Military Families
summary: Directs agencies to expand veterans' suicide prevention and mental health services, including Veterans Crisis Line capacity, and establishes an interagency task force on military mental health.

title: Gulf Coast Ecosystem Restoration
summary: Designates the EPA Administrator and Agriculture Secretary as additional Deepwater Horizon natural resource damage trustees, and terminates the Gulf Coast Ecosystem Restoration Task Force.

title: Strengthening Protections Against Trafficking in Persons in Federal Contracts
summary: Directs the FAR Council to amend the Federal Acquisition Regulation within 180 days to bar trafficking-related practices by contractors and require compliance plans for large overseas contracts.

title: Authorizing the Implementation of Certain Sanctions Set Forth in the Iran Threat Reduction and Syria Human Rights Act of 2012 and Additional Sanctions With Respect to Iran
summary: Implements Iran Sanctions Act measures, blocks property of persons tied to Iranian human rights abuses or censorship, and bars U.S.-owned foreign entities from sanctioned Iran transactions.

title: Establishing the White House Homeland Security Partnership Council
summary: Establishes a White House Homeland Security Partnership Council to foster local homeland security partnerships, plus an agency Steering Committee that guides it, selects its members and reports annually to the President.

title: Establishment of an Interagency Task Force on Commercial Advocacy
summary: Establishes an Interagency Task Force on Commercial Advocacy, chaired by the Secretary of Commerce, to coordinate federal support for U.S. firms competing for foreign contracts and report to the Export Promotion Cabinet.

title: Reestablishment of Advisory Group
summary: Reestablishes the Advisory Group on Prevention, Health Promotion, and Integrative and Public Health until September 30, 2013, unless extended, and reappoints the members serving on September 30, 2012.

title: Establishing the Hurricane Sandy Rebuilding Task Force
summary: Establishes the Hurricane Sandy Rebuilding Task Force, chaired by the HUD Secretary, to coordinate regional rebuilding and prepare a Rebuilding Strategy within 180 days of first convening.

title: Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on Monday, December 24, 2012
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 24, 2012, while letting agency heads keep offices open and staff on duty for national security, defense, or other public need.

title: Reestablishment of Advisory Commission
summary: Reestablishes the President's Advisory Commission on Educational Excellence for Hispanics until September 30, 2013 unless extended, and reappoints the members serving on October 19, 2012.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets rates of pay for federal civilian, uniformed services, executive, legislative, judicial and administrative law judge positions via attached schedules, and supersedes Executive Order 13594.

title: Improving Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity
summary: Directs NIST to develop a voluntary Cybersecurity Framework for critical infrastructure, and has DHS expand cyber threat information sharing and set up a voluntary program to support the Framework's adoption.

title: Administration of Reformed Export Controls
summary: Delegates the President's Arms Export Control Act functions to State, Defense and the Attorney General, revokes EO 11958, and amends EO 13222 on licensing Commerce-controlled items.

title: Amendments to Executive Order 12777
summary: Replaces section 4 of Executive Order 12777 to delegate Oil Pollution Act liability-limit adjustment and reporting functions to the Coast Guard's Secretary, the EPA Administrator, and the Transportation and Interior Secretaries.

title: Establishment of the Presidential Commission on Election Administration
summary: Establishes the Presidential Commission on Election Administration, with up to nine members, to identify best practices and recommend ways to improve election administration and voter experience, reporting to the President.

title: Continuance of Advisory Council
summary: Extends the President's Advisory Council on Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships, which will terminate 2 years from the date of the order unless the President extends it further.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2013 pay rates for General Schedule, Foreign Service, VA, Senior Executive Service, Executive Schedule, judges, uniformed services and ALJs, with locality pay, and supersedes EO 13635.

title: Making Open and Machine Readable the New Default for Government Information
summary: Directs OMB to issue an Open Data Policy making new government information open and machine readable by default, and requires agencies to implement it while safeguarding privacy and security.

title: 2013 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts III and IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial as set out in an annex, effective on the order's date, without making earlier acts punishable or invalidating pending proceedings.

title: Amendment to Executive Order 13639
summary: Amends EO 13639 to set the Presidential Commission on Election Administration at not more than ten presidentially appointed members, including election administrators and customer service-oriented business representatives.

title: Authorizing the Implementation of Certain Sanctions Set Forth in the Iran Freedom and Counter- Proliferation Act of 2012 and Additional Sanctions With Respect To Iran
summary: Authorizes sanctions on foreign financial institutions and other persons for Iranian rial dealings, aiding blocked Iranian persons, and Iran auto-sector trade; amends Executive Order 13622.

title: Establishing the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans
summary: Establishes the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans within the Treasury Department to advise the President and the Treasury Secretary on building young people's financial capability.

title: Establishing the White House Council on Native American Affairs
summary: Establishes the White House Council on Native American Affairs, chaired by the Interior Secretary, to coordinate federal programs and resources for tribal communities and federal engagement and consultation with tribes.

title: Combating Wildlife Trafficking
summary: Establishes a Presidential Task Force on Wildlife Trafficking, co-chaired by State, Interior and the Attorney General, to produce a national strategy; also directs Interior to create an eight-member advisory council.

title: Accelerating Improvements in HIV Prevention and Care in the United States Through the HIV Care Continuum Initiative
summary: Establishes the HIV Care Continuum Initiative under the Office of National AIDS Policy and a Working Group to coordinate federal HIV efforts, with recommendations to the President within 180 days.

title: Improving Chemical Facility Safety and Security
summary: Establishes a Chemical Facility Safety and Security Working Group co-chaired by DHS, EPA and Labor, and directs it to improve federal coordination, information sharing and chemical safety standards.

title: Prohibiting Certain Imports of Burmese Jadeite and Rubies
summary: Prohibits importing into the U.S. jadeite, rubies, and jewelry containing them mined or extracted from Burma, and revokes sections 3 and 8 of Executive Order 13310.

title: Continuance Of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues 26 listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2015, and amends several orders, including those on the National Infrastructure Advisory Council and the Global Development Council.

title: Preparing the United States for the Impacts of Climate Change
summary: Establishes an interagency Council on Climate Preparedness and Resilience and a State, Local, and Tribal Leaders Task Force, and directs agencies to reform programs, share data and adopt climate adaptation plans.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between the Long Island Rail Road Company and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a three-member emergency board to investigate disputes between the Long Island Rail Road and certain employees' unions, reporting to the President within 30 days.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets adjusted pay rates for statutory pay systems, Senior Executive Service, executive, legislative and judicial offices, uniformed services and administrative law judges, and locality payments.

title: Establishment of Afghanistan and Pakistan Strategic Partnership Office and Amendment to Executive Order 12163
summary: Establishes the Afghanistan and Pakistan Strategic Partnership Office, a temporary organization within the State Department, to support a strategic partnership and drawdown; amends Executive Order 12163 section 1-701(c).

title: Changing the Name of the National Security Staff to the National Security Council Staff
summary: Renames the National Security Staff as the National Security Council staff, so references to it or to the Homeland Security Council Staff in any Executive Order or Presidential directive mean that staff.

title: Establishing a Minimum Wage for Contractors
summary: Requires agencies to put a clause in new federal contracts setting a minimum wage of $10.10 per hour from January 1, 2015, adjusted annually by the Secretary of Labor, with a separate tipped-worker cash wage.

title: Streamlining the Export/Import Process for America's Businesses
summary: Establishes the Border Interagency Executive Council to coordinate border agencies' supply chain processes, and requires participating agencies to be able to use the ITDS single window for trade data by December 31, 2016.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons Contributing to the Situation in Ukraine
summary: Declares a national emergency over Ukraine and blocks the property of persons Treasury determines undermined Ukraine's stability or asserted authority over its territory. Also suspends their entry into the US.

title: Blocking Property of Additional Persons Contributing to the Situation in Ukraine
summary: Expands the Ukraine national emergency and blocks property of listed persons, Russian government officials, and arms-sector operators; also suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Blocking Property of Additional Persons Contributing to the Situation in Ukraine
summary: Blocks property of persons the Treasury Secretary determines operate in designated Russian economy sectors or support or act for blocked persons, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board to Investigate Disputes Between the Long Island Rail Road Company and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a three-member second emergency board, effective March 22, 2014, to investigate disputes between the Long Island Rail Road and certain employees, and to report on the most reasonable final offer.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons With Respect to South Sudan
summary: Declares a national emergency over South Sudan and blocks the property of persons Treasury determines threaten its peace, commit abuses, or obstruct aid. It also suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Non-Retaliation for Disclosure of Compensation Information
summary: Amends Executive Order 11246 to bar federal contractors from retaliating against employees or applicants who discuss or disclose compensation, and directs the Secretary of Labor to propose implementing regulations within 160 days.

title: Expanding Eligibility for the Defense Meritorious Service Medal
summary: Amends Executive Order 12019 so the Defense Meritorious Service Medal may also be awarded to members of the armed forces of a friendly foreign nation, not only U.S. Armed Forces members.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons Contributing to the Conflict in the Central African Republic
summary: Declares a national emergency over the Central African Republic conflict and blocks property of listed persons and those Treasury designates, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Ending Immunities Granted to the Development Fund for Iraq and Certain Other Iraqi Property and Interests in Property Pursuant to Executive Order 13303, as Amended
summary: Terminates the bar on attachment, judgment and other judicial process against the Development Fund for Iraq, Iraqi petroleum and Central Bank of Iraq property set by EO 13303, as amended; the 2003 national emergency stays.

title: 2014 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Part II of the Manual for Courts-Martial, its Discussion and Analysis, as set out in an attached Annex, effective on the order's date without making earlier acts punishable or invalidating pending actions.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between the Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a three-member emergency board to investigate and report within 30 days on disputes between SEPTA and certain employees represented by labor organizations under the Railway Labor Act.

title: Taking Additional Steps to Address the National Emergency With Respect to the Conflict in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: Amends Executive Order 13413 to expand the blocking of property to persons Treasury designates for destabilizing the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including leaders of armed groups and arms suppliers.

title: Further Amendments to Executive Order 11478, Equal Employment Opportunity in the Federal Government, and Executive Order 11246, Equal Employment Opportunity
summary: Adds gender identity to the federal employment nondiscrimination policy and to the nondiscrimination clauses for federal contractors, and directs the Secretary of Labor to prepare implementing regulations within 90 days.

title: Fair Pay and Safe Workplaces
summary: Requires bidders on federal contracts over $500,000 to disclose labor law violations from the past 3 years and creates agency Labor Compliance Advisors. Adds paycheck and arbitration terms.

title: Revised List of Quarantinable Communicable Diseases
summary: Amends Executive Order 13295 to replace subsection (b) of its list of quarantinable communicable diseases with severe acute respiratory syndromes, excluding influenza, as defined in the text.

title: Establishing the President's Advisory Council on Doing Business in Africa
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to establish an advisory council of up to 15 private sector members to advise the President on strengthening U.S.-Africa trade and investment; it ends after 2 years unless extended.

title: Combating Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria
summary: Establishes an interagency Task Force on antibiotic-resistant bacteria to produce a 5-year National Action Plan, and directs HHS to create a Presidential Advisory Council and agencies to adopt stewardship measures.

title: Climate-Resilient International Development
summary: Requires agencies with international development programs to assess climate risks and build climate resilience into their decisions, and establishes a Working Group on Climate-Resilient International Development.

title: Conversion Authority for Criminal Investigators (Special Agents) of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives
summary: Allows ATF criminal investigators hired under Schedule B to convert noncompetitively to career appointments after 3 years of satisfactory service, and directs OPM to issue regulations.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate a Dispute Between the Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority and Its Locomotive Engineers Represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers and Trainmen
summary: Establishes a three-member emergency board, effective October 13, 2014, to investigate the SEPTA–BLET locomotive engineers dispute and report to the President its selection of the most reasonable final offer.

title: Ordering the Selected Reserve and Certain Individual Ready Reserve Members of the Armed Forces to Active Duty
summary: Authorizes the Defense and Homeland Security Secretaries to call Selected Reserve and certain Individual Ready Reserve members to active duty, and end their service, for Operation United Assistance (Ebola response).

title: Improving the Security of Consumer Financial Transactions
summary: Directs agencies to move payment terminals and cards to enhanced security features such as chip-and-PIN, and sets identity theft remediation steps and multifactor authentication planning for online federal services.

title: Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on Friday, December 26, 2014
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 26, 2014, while letting agency heads keep certain offices open and staff on duty for national security, defense, or public need.

title: Amendments to Executive Orders 11030, 13653, and 13673
summary: Amends Executive Order 11030 on proclamations for special days and trade proclamations prepared by the United States Trade Representative, and amends Executive Orders 13653 and 13673.

title: Establishment of the President's Task Force on 21st Century Policing
summary: Establishes the President's Task Force on 21st Century Policing, up to eleven members, to recommend how policing practices can reduce crime while building public trust, reporting by March 2, 2015.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons and Prohibiting Certain Transactions With Respect to the Crimea Region of Ukraine
summary: Prohibits new U.S. investment in, and trade with, the Crimea region of Ukraine, and blocks property of persons determined to operate there, lead entities operating there, or support blocked persons.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2015 pay rates for statutory pay systems, the Senior Executive Service, executive, legislative and judicial salaries, uniformed services, and administrative law judges, and sets locality pay; supersedes EO 13655.

title: Imposing Additional Sanctions With Respect To North Korea
summary: Blocks property of North Korean government and Workers' Party officials, agencies and their supporters, as determined by Treasury, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Federal Support for Local Law Enforcement Equipment Acquisition
summary: Establishes an interagency Law Enforcement Equipment Working Group to recommend improvements to federal support for local law enforcement acquisition of controlled equipment, with recommendations due in 60 and 120 days.

title: Enhancing Coordination of National Efforts in the Arctic
summary: Establishes an Arctic Executive Steering Committee, chaired by the OSTP Director, to guide agencies and coordinate Federal Arctic policy, including with Alaska, Alaska Native tribal governments and other stakeholders.

title: Establishing a Federal Flood Risk Management Standard and a Process for Further Soliciting and Considering Stakeholder Input
summary: Amends Executive Order 11988 to define floodplains by a higher federal flood standard (climate-informed science, 2 or 3 feet of freeboard, or 0.2 percent flood) and sets a public comment process before implementation.

title: Promoting Private Sector Cybersecurity Information Sharing
summary: Directs DHS to encourage formation of cybersecurity information sharing organizations (ISAOs), contract with a standards body for them, designate the NCCIC to sign ISAO agreements, and amend EO 12829.

title: Blocking Property and Suspending Entry of Certain Persons Contributing to the Situation in Venezuela
summary: Declares a national emergency over Venezuela and blocks property of listed persons and those found responsible for undermining democracy or abusing rights; suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Planning for Federal Sustainability in the Next Decade
summary: Directs agencies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and meet energy, water, fleet, building and procurement sustainability goals through fiscal year 2025; revokes Executive Orders 13423 and 13514.

title: Blocking the Property of Certain Persons Engaging in Significant Malicious Cyber-Enabled Activities
summary: Declares a national emergency over malicious cyber-enabled activities and blocks the property of persons Treasury determines are responsible for them. It also suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the Risk of Nuclear Proliferation Created by the Accumulation of a Large Volume of Weapons-Usable Fissile Material in the Territory of the Russian Federation
summary: Terminates the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13617 over weapons-usable fissile material in Russia and revokes that order, preserving pending actions and rights or penalties already incurred.

title: 2015 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Part II, Part III, and Part IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, as described in the Annex, effective as of the date of this order.

title: Amendment to Executive Order 11155, Awards for Special Capability in Career and Technical Education
summary: Amends Executive Order 11155 to let the Commission choose up to twenty more Presidential Scholars a year, at large, for scholarship and accomplishment in career and technical education.

title: Hostage Recovery Activities
summary: Establishes an interagency Hostage Recovery Fusion Cell within the FBI to coordinate recovery of U.S. nationals held hostage abroad, plus a Hostage Response Group and a Special Presidential Envoy for Hostage Affairs.

title: Establishing the Advisory Board on Toxic Substances and Worker Health
summary: Establishes the Advisory Board on Toxic Substances and Worker Health within the Department of Labor, with up to 15 members, to advise the Labor Secretary on site exposure matrices and EEOICPA claims guidance.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between New Jersey Transit Rail and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a three-member emergency board under the Railway Labor Act to investigate and report within 30 days on disputes between New Jersey Transit Rail and certain employees' labor organizations.

title: Delegation of Certain Authorities and Assignment of Certain Functions Under the Bipartisan Congressional Trade Priorities and Accountability Act of 2015
summary: Delegates the President's title I trade promotion authority functions to the U.S. Trade Representative, with listed exceptions, and assigns certain review and reporting functions to State, Labor and OMB.

title: Creating a National Strategic Computing Initiative
summary: Establishes the National Strategic Computing Initiative for high-performance computing, assigns lead, research and deployment agency roles, and creates an Executive Council to produce an implementation plan within 90 days.

title: Implementing the National HIV/AIDS Strategy for the United States for 2015-2020
summary: Directs implementation of the Updated National HIV/AIDS Strategy through ONAP monitoring, ten designated lead agencies' action plans, and a new Federal Interagency Working Group co-chaired by ONAP and HHS.

title: Presidential Innovation Fellows Program
summary: Directs the GSA Administrator to establish the Presidential Innovation Fellows Program, placing outside innovators in agencies for 6 months to 2 years, with a Director and an Advisory Board.

title: Designating the International Renewable Energy Agency as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain Privileges, Exemptions, and Immunities
summary: Designates the International Renewable Energy Agency as a public international organization entitled to the privileges, exemptions, and immunities of the International Organizations Immunities Act.

title: Establishing Paid Sick Leave for Federal Contractors
summary: Requires agencies to include in new covered contracts a clause that employees earn at least 1 hour of paid sick leave per 30 hours worked, and directs the Labor Secretary to issue implementing regulations by September 30, 2016.

title: Using Behavioral Science Insights To Better Serve the American People
summary: Directs agencies to apply behavioral science insights by streamlining access to programs, improving information presentation and default choices, and reviewing incentives; the SBST gives guidance and the NSTC reports yearly.

title: Continuance or Reestablishment of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues or reestablishes the listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2017, and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to each committee's agency head.

title: National Security Medal
summary: Amends Executive Order 10431 to broaden eligibility for the National Security Medal and set a nomination process through the NSC Executive Secretary, with the Director of National Intelligence's office processing awards.

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the Actions and Policies of Former Liberian President Charles Taylor
summary: Terminates the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13348 regarding Charles Taylor and revokes that order, while preserving pending actions, prior acts, and matured rights, duties and penalties.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between New Jersey Transit Rail and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a three-member second emergency board to investigate the disputes between New Jersey Transit Rail and certain employees' unions, and to report on the most reasonable final offer.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons Contributing to the Situation in Burundi
summary: Declares a national emergency over Burundi and blocks the property of persons listed in the Annex or designated by Treasury for threatening Burundi's stability or abusing rights; suspends their entry.

title: Half-Day Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on Thursday, December 24, 2015
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees for the last half of the workday on December 24, 2015, letting agency heads keep essential offices and staff open for national security or public need.

title: Strengthening the Senior Executive Service
summary: Establishes a PMC Subcommittee on the Senior Executive Service and requires agencies to adopt SES hiring, rotation, succession planning, onboarding and award-spending reforms under OPM direction.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2016 pay rates for General Schedule, Foreign Service, VA health, SES, Executive Schedule, Congress, judges, uniformed services and ALJs, and sets locality payments; supersedes EO 13686.

title: Revocation of Executive Orders 13574, 13590, 13622, and 13645 With Respect to Iran, Amendment of Executive Order 13628 With Respect to Iran, and Provision of Implementation Authorities for Aspects of Certain Statutory Sanctions Outside the Scope of U.S. Commitments Under the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action of July 14, 2015
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 13574, 13590, 13622 and 13645 on Iran sanctions, amends EO 13628, and authorizes Treasury and State to impose blocking and other sanctions under IFCA outside the JCPOA commitments.

title: Establishing a Federal Earthquake Risk Management Standard
summary: Requires agencies to apply earthquake-resistant codes to new, leased and existing Federal buildings, using the 2015 IBC/IRC and ICSSC Standards. Revokes Executive Orders 12699 and 12941.

title: Commission on Enhancing National Cybersecurity
summary: Establishes within the Department of Commerce a Commission of up to 12 members to recommend ways to strengthen public and private cybersecurity, with a final report to the President due December 1, 2016.

title: Establishment of the Federal Privacy Council
summary: Establishes the Federal Privacy Council as an interagency forum chaired by OMB's Deputy Director for Management, and directs OMB to revise Senior Agency Officials for Privacy policy within 120 days.

title: Delegation of Certain Authorities and Assignment of Certain Functions Under the Trade Preferences Extension Act of 2015
summary: Delegates the President's authorities under title I of the Trade Preferences Extension Act of 2015 to the U.S. Trade Representative, with listed exceptions, and assigns other functions to USAID and the USTR.

title: Developing an Integrated Global Engagement Center To Support Government-wide Counterterrorism Communications Activities Directed Abroad and Revoking Executive Order 13584
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to establish a Global Engagement Center to coordinate government-wide counterterrorism communications to foreign audiences, with a steering committee and temporary support office. Revokes EO 13584.

title: Blocking Property of the Government of North Korea and the Workers' Party of Korea, and Prohibiting Certain Transactions With Respect to North Korea
summary: Blocks property of the Government of North Korea and the Workers' Party of Korea and of persons designated under set criteria. Bans US exports and new investment in North Korea and suspends entry of designated persons.

title: Establishing the Inherent Resolve Campaign Medal
summary: Establishes the Inherent Resolve Campaign Medal for service members who serve in Iraq, Syria, or contiguous waters or airspace on or after June 15, 2014, and bars receiving both it and the GWOT Expeditionary Medal.

title: Amending Executive Order 12137
summary: Amends Executive Order 12137 to delegate to the Director of the Peace Corps the functions of adopting, altering, and using an official Peace Corps seal or emblem, and deletes section 1-301(e).

title: Steps to Increase Competition and Better Inform Consumers and Workers to Support Continued Growth of the American Economy
summary: Directs agencies to use their authorities to promote competition, inform consumers and workers, and remove anticompetitive regulations, with lists due in 30 days, recommendations in 60, then semi-annual reports.

title: Blocking Property and Suspending Entry Into the United States of Persons Contributing to the Situation in Libya
summary: Expands the Libya national emergency, blocks property of persons the Treasury Secretary determines threaten Libya's stability or commit related abuses, and suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Facilitation of a Presidential Transition
summary: Establishes a White House Transition Coordinating Council to guide agencies and support candidates' transition teams, and an Agency Transition Directors Council to coordinate agency transition activities.

title: Wildland-Urban Interface Federal Risk Mitigation
summary: Requires agencies to build and alter large Federal buildings in moderate-or-greater wildfire risk wildland-urban interface areas to the 2015 IWUIC or an equivalent code, with MitFLG issuing guidelines within 240 days.

title: A Comprehensive Approach to Atrocity Prevention and Response
summary: Continues the interagency Atrocities Prevention Board, sets its structure, monthly meetings and annual reporting, and directs agencies to build mass atrocity prevention and response capabilities.

title: 2016 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts II, III, and IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial as described in an attached Annex, effective on the order's date, with pending proceedings and earlier acts unaffected.

title: Global Entrepreneurship
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to run the PAGE Program with an Advisory Board of up to 25 members, and sets up a State-chaired Global Connect Steering Group to promote global Internet access.

title: United States Policy on Pre- and Post-Strike Measures To Address Civilian Casualties in U.S. Operations Involving the Use of Force
summary: Directs agencies to take measures to reduce and respond to civilian casualties in force operations, and requires the DNI to release annual public reports on strikes outside active hostilities.

title: Delegation of Certain Authorities and Assignment of Certain Functions Under the Trade Facilitation and Trade Enforcement Act of 2015
summary: Assigns the President's functions under the Trade Facilitation and Trade Enforcement Act of 2015 to the Commerce, State, USAID and USTR heads, and sets Treasury currency-analysis consultation steps.

title: Amending Executive Order 13675 To Expand Membership on the President's Advisory Council on Doing Business in Africa
summary: Raises the maximum membership of the President's Advisory Council on Doing Business in Africa from 15 to 26 private sector corporate members by amending Executive Order 13675.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of the Treasury
summary: Sets the order in which Treasury officers act as Secretary when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unable to serve, starting with the Under Secretaries. Revokes Executive Order 13246 and a 2002 memorandum.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Veterans Affairs
summary: Sets the order in which listed Veterans Affairs officials act as Secretary when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unavailable, and revokes Executive Order 13247 and related prior succession documents.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Environmental Protection Agency
summary: Sets the order in which listed EPA officials, starting with the General Counsel, act as Administrator when the Administrator and Deputy Administrator are unavailable, and revokes Executive Order 13614.

title: Amendment to Executive Order 13673
summary: Amends Executive Order 13673 so that subcontractor disclosures go to an entity designated by a final Federal Acquisition Regulation rule rather than to the contractor, and strikes "and (ii)" in subsection 4(c)(i).

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the Situation in or in Relation to Côte d'Ivoire
summary: Terminates the national emergency regarding Côte d'Ivoire declared in Executive Order 13396 and revokes that order, preserving pending actions, prior acts, and matured rights or penalties.

title: 2016 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Part I, Part II, and Part IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, as described in the Annex, effective as of the date of this order.

title: Amending Executive Order 13467 To Establish the Roles and Responsibilities of the National Background Investigations Bureau and Related Matters
summary: Amends EO 13467 to set the National Background Investigations Bureau's duties as primary background investigation provider and DoD's IT role, and directs the Council to recommend governance updates within 90 days.

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the Actions and Policies of the Government of Burma
summary: Terminates the national emergency regarding Burma and revokes six Burma sanctions orders. Waives JADE Act sanctions and ends the related entry suspensions under Proclamation 8693.

title: Charitable Fundraising
summary: Amends Executive Order 12353 on the Combined Federal Campaign, replacing "agencies" with "organizations," letting OPM consider annuitant contributions, and revising rules for outreach coordinators and campaign administrators.

title: Coordinating Efforts To Prepare the Nation for Space Weather Events
summary: Directs the OSTP Director to coordinate federal space weather preparedness, assigns roles to agencies, and sets deadlines for actions such as a grid-device pilot plan and a federal operating concept.

title: Delegation of Function to the Director of the Office of Personnel Management
summary: Delegates to the OPM Director the President's authority to direct OPM to establish an emergency leave transfer program, in consultation with OMB's Director, and requires notifying the President of any program.

title: Advancing the Goals of the Power Africa Initiative to Expand Access to Electricity in Sub- Saharan Africa Through the Establishment of the President's Power Africa Working Group
summary: Establishes the Power Africa Working Group, a multi-agency body co-chaired by USAID's new Power Africa Coordinator and an NSC staff member, to coordinate U.S. energy projects in Sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Advancing the Global Health Security Agenda To Achieve a World Safe and Secure From Infectious Disease Threats
summary: Establishes a GHSA Interagency Review Council to guide and review U.S. Global Health Security Agenda efforts, and assigns roles to the heads of State, Defense, Justice, Agriculture, HHS, DHS, USAID and CDC.

title: Establishing a Community Solutions Council
summary: Establishes a Council for Community Solutions with two Co-Chairs to coordinate agency investments and community engagement, and revokes Executive Orders 13560 and 13602, which it supersedes.

title: Providing for the Appointment in the Competitive Service of Certain Employees of the Foreign Service
summary: Lets agency heads appoint to the competitive service people with 48 months of Foreign Service Limited Non-Career Appointment service, who become career conditional employees.

title: Providing for the Appointment of Alumni of the Fulbright U.S. Student Program, the Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship Program, and the Critical Language Scholarship Program to the Competitive Service
summary: Authorizes agency heads to noncompetitively appoint certified alumni of the Fulbright, Gilman, and Critical Language Scholarship programs to the competitive service, within 1 year (extendable) of program completion.

title: Safeguarding the Nation From the Impacts of Invasive Species
summary: Amends EO 13112 to set federal agency duties on invasive species, expand the National Invasive Species Council's membership and duties, and require a Council Management Plan by December 31, 2019.

title: Relating to the Implementation of the Convention on the International Recovery of Child Support and Other Forms of Family Maintenance
summary: Designates the Department of Health and Human Services as the U.S. Central Authority under the Hague child support Convention, and lets it designate State IV-D child support agencies to perform specific functions.

title: Amending the Order of Succession in the Department of Homeland Security
summary: Replaces Section 88 of EO 13286 with a new order of succession for acting Secretary of Homeland Security, beginning with the Deputy Secretary, and revokes EO 13442.

title: Northern Bering Sea Climate Resilience
summary: Withdraws the Norton Basin Planning Area and parts of the St. Matthew-Hall Planning Area from oil and gas leasing, and creates a Bering Task Force and a Tribal Advisory Council for the Northern Bering Sea.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Labor
summary: Sets the order in which listed Labor Department officials, starting with the Solicitor of Labor, act as Secretary when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unavailable, and revokes Executive Order 13245.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
