summary: Sets 2017 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, Senior Executive Service, Executive Schedule, military, judges and others, and orders locality payments per Schedule 9. Supersedes EO 13715.

title: Taking Additional Steps to Address the National Emergency With Respect to Significant Malicious Cyber- Enabled Activities
summary: Amends EO 13694 to block property of persons responsible for cyber-enabled activities that interfere with election processes, adds an Annex of listed persons, and lets Treasury delist them.

title: Amending Executive Order 11016 To Update Eligibility Criteria for Award of the Purple Heart
summary: Rewrites Purple Heart eligibility criteria in EO 11016, including wounds from attacks inspired by foreign terrorist organizations and friendly fire, and excludes wounds from willful misconduct.

title: Designating the World Organisation for Animal Health as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain Privileges, Exemptions, and Immunities
summary: Designates the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) as a public international organization entitled to the privileges, exemptions, and immunities of the International Organizations Immunities Act.

title: Exclusions From the Federal Labor-Management Relations Program
summary: Amends Executive Order 12171 to revise and add lists of Department of Defense agencies and subdivisions excluded from the Federal Labor-Management Relations Program, determining they perform national security work.

title: Recognizing Positive Actions by the Government of Sudan and Providing for the Revocation of Certain Sudan-Related Sanctions
summary: Revokes Sudan sanctions in EO 13067 (secs. 1-2) and EO 13412 effective July 12, 2017, if State publishes a notice that Sudan sustained its positive actions; waives TSRA and CPSA provisions and requires annual reports.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Justice
summary: Sets the order of succession to act as Attorney General: the U.S. Attorneys for D.C., Northern District of Illinois, and Central District of California, in turn. Revokes Executive Order 13557.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Environmental Protection Agency
summary: Sets the order in which 16 listed EPA officials, starting with the General Counsel, act as Administrator when the Administrator and Deputy Administrator are unavailable, and revokes Executive Order 13737.

title: Amending the Civil Service Rules, Executive Order 13488, and Executive Order 13467 To Modernize the Executive Branch-Wide Governance Structure and Processes for Security Clearances, Suitability and Fitness for Employment, and Credentialing, and Related Matters
summary: Amends the Civil Service Rules and EOs 13488 and 13467 to set fitness standards, require continuous vetting and reciprocity, and define roles of the Council, Executive Agents and NBIB.

title: Minimizing the Economic Burden of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act Pending Repeal
summary: Directs HHS and other agencies, to the extent permitted by law, to waive, defer, exempt or delay Affordable Care Act requirements that burden States or individuals and industry, and to give States more flexibility.

title: Expediting Environmental Reviews and Approvals for High Priority Infrastructure Projects
summary: Directs the CEQ Chairman to decide within 30 days whether a requested infrastructure project is "high priority" and to set expedited deadlines with agencies for its environmental reviews and approvals.

title: Border Security and Immigration Enforcement Improvements
summary: Directs DHS to plan and build a physical wall on the southern border, expand detention, end "catch and release," hire 5,000 Border Patrol agents, and enter 287(g) agreements with states and localities.

title: Enhancing Public Safety in the Interior of the United States
summary: Directs agencies to enforce immigration laws against all removable aliens, sets removal priorities, and bars federal grants to jurisdictions that willfully refuse to comply with 8 U.S.C. 1373.

title: Protecting the Nation From Foreign Terrorist Entry Into the United States
summary: Suspends entry of aliens from countries in INA section 217(a)(12) for 90 days and suspends the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for 120 days; also suspends Syrian refugee entry indefinitely.

title: Ethics Commitments by Executive Branch Appointees
summary: Requires every executive agency appointee to sign an ethics pledge with lobbying, gift and foreign-agent restrictions, sets waiver and enforcement rules, and revokes Executive Order 13490.

title: Reducing Regulation and Controlling Regulatory Costs
summary: Requires agencies to identify at least two existing regulations to repeal for each new one, caps fiscal year 2017 incremental regulatory costs at zero, and sets annual OMB-managed agency cost allowances.

title: Core Principles for Regulating the United States Financial System
summary: Establishes seven Core Principles for financial regulation and directs the Treasury Secretary to report within 120 days, and periodically after, on whether existing laws and policies promote them.

title: Enforcing Federal Law With Respect to Transnational Criminal Organizations and Preventing International Trafficking
summary: Directs four cabinet officials to co-chair the interagency Threat Mitigation Working Group to coordinate action against transnational criminal organizations, and requires a report to the President within 120 days.

title: Preventing Violence Against Federal, State, Tribal, and Local Law Enforcement Officers
summary: Directs the Attorney General to develop a strategy to prosecute violence against law enforcement officers, review federal laws, evaluate Justice Department grants, and recommend legislation to the President.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Justice
summary: Sets the order of succession to act as Attorney General: U.S. Attorneys for the Eastern District of Virginia, Northern District of Illinois, and Western District of Missouri. Revokes EO 13762.

title: Task Force on Crime Reduction and Public Safety
summary: Directs the Attorney General to establish a Task Force on Crime Reduction and Public Safety to develop crime-reduction strategies and propose legislation, and to report to the President at least yearly.

title: Enforcing the Regulatory Reform Agenda
summary: Requires each agency to designate a Regulatory Reform Officer and set up a Regulatory Reform Task Force to evaluate existing regulations and recommend repeal, replacement or modification.

title: Restoring the Rule of Law, Federalism, and Economic Growth by Reviewing the "Waters of the United States" Rule
summary: Directs EPA and the Army's Assistant Secretary for Civil Works to review the 2015 Clean Water Rule and propose rescinding or revising it, and to consider reading "navigable waters" per Justice Scalia's Rapanos opinion.

title: White House Initiative To Promote Excellence and Innovation at Historically Black Colleges and Universities
summary: Establishes the White House Initiative on HBCUs and a President's Board of Advisors, requires identified agencies to prepare annual HBCU plans, and revokes Executive Order 13532.

title: Protecting the Nation From Foreign Terrorist Entry Into the United States
summary: Suspends entry of nationals of Iran, Libya, Somalia, Sudan, Syria and Yemen for 90 days and refugee admissions for 120 days, with waivers and exceptions. Revokes Executive Order 13769.

title: Comprehensive Plan for Reorganizing the Executive Branch
summary: Directs each agency head to submit a reorganization plan to OMB within 180 days, and directs the OMB Director to submit to the President a plan to reorganize the executive branch and eliminate unnecessary agencies.

title: Revocation of Federal Contracting Executive Orders
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 13673, 13738 and section 3 of Order 13683 on federal contracting, and directs agencies to consider promptly rescinding rules and policies implementing them.

title: Promoting Energy Independence and Economic Growth
summary: Orders agencies to review rules burdening domestic energy production, revokes Executive Order 13653 and other climate actions, and directs EPA to review the Clean Power Plan.

title: Establishing the President's Commission on Combating Drug Addiction and the Opioid Crisis
summary: Establishes the President's Commission on Combating Drug Addiction and the Opioid Crisis to study the Federal response and recommend improvements, with interim and final reports due and ONDCP support.

title: Establishing Enhanced Collection and Enforcement of Antidumping and Countervailing Duties and Violations of Trade and Customs Laws
summary: Directs DHS to develop a plan within 90 days requiring risky importers to post bonds for antidumping and countervailing duties, and to build a strategy against trade violations and IPR infringement.

title: Omnibus Report on Significant Trade Deficits
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary and USTR to report to the President within 90 days on trading partners with significant 2016 goods trade deficits, assessing causes, effects and national security impacts.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Justice
summary: Sets the order in which three U.S. Attorneys (E.D. Va., E.D.N.C., N.D. Tex.) act as Attorney General when higher officials are unable to serve, and revokes Executive Order 13775.

title: Buy American and Hire American
summary: Requires agencies to enforce Buy American Laws, minimize waivers and assess compliance within 150 days; directs immigration agencies to propose rules and H-1B reforms to protect U.S. workers.

title: Identifying and Reducing Tax Regulatory Burdens
summary: Directs the Treasury Secretary to review significant tax regulations issued since January 1, 2016, report on burdensome ones, and delay, modify or rescind them as appropriate and lawful.

title: Promoting Agriculture and Rural Prosperity in America
summary: Establishes an Interagency Task Force on Agriculture and Rural Prosperity, chaired by the Agriculture Secretary, to identify changes for rural America and report in 180 days; revokes the White House Rural Council order.

title: Enforcing Statutory Prohibitions on Federal Control of Education
summary: Directs the Secretary of Education to review Department regulations and guidance for compliance with bans on federal control of curriculum, and to rescind or revise inconsistent ones within 300 days.

title: Review of Designations Under the Antiquities Act
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to review national monument designations made since 1996 that exceed 100,000 acres or lacked outreach, with an interim report in 45 days and a final report in 120 days.

title: Improving Accountability and Whistleblower Protection at the Department of Veterans Affairs
summary: Directs the VA Secretary to establish, within 45 days, an Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection led by a Special Assistant, to advise on discipline and protect employees who report wrongdoing.

title: Establishment of the American Technology Council
summary: Establishes the American Technology Council, chaired by the President, to coordinate the Federal Government's use of information technology and digital service delivery, and sets its membership and functions until January 20, 2021.

title: Implementing an America-First Offshore Energy Strategy
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to consider annual oil and gas lease sales in seven Outer Continental Shelf planning areas. Revokes EO 13754 and orders reviews of offshore energy rules.

title: Addressing Trade Agreement Violations and Abuses
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary and USTR to review all U.S. trade and investment agreements and certain trade relations, report violations to the President within 180 days, and take lawful action to remedy them.

title: Establishment of Office of Trade and Manufacturing Policy
summary: Establishes the Office of Trade and Manufacturing Policy within the White House Office, led by a Director, to advise the President on trade policy, liaise with Commerce, and help improve federal procurement and hiring policies.

title: Promoting Free Speech and Religious Liberty
summary: Directs agencies to respect religious and political speech, bars Treasury adverse tax action over religious speech on moral issues, and tells the Attorney General to issue religious liberty guidance.

title: Establishment of Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity
summary: Establishes an advisory commission chaired by the Vice President to study voter registration and voting processes in Federal elections and report to the President, terminating 30 days after the report.

title: Strengthening the Cybersecurity of Federal Networks and Critical Infrastructure
summary: Requires agency heads to use the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and submit risk management reports, and orders reports on critical infrastructure, deterrence, and cyber workforce.

title: Expanding Apprenticeships in America
summary: Directs the Labor Secretary to consider rules for industry-recognized apprenticeship programs, creates an apprenticeship task force, and requires agencies to evaluate job training programs.

title: Amending Executive Order 13597
summary: Amends Executive Order 13597 by deleting subsection (b)(ii) of its section 2, and directs the Secretaries of State and Homeland Security to revise the implementation plan to match.

title: Reviving the National Space Council
summary: Revives the National Space Council, chaired by the Vice President, to advise the President on space policy and strategy, and sets its membership, duties, a Users' Advisory Group and annual reporting.

title: Allowing Additional Time for Recognizing Positive Actions by the Government of Sudan and Amending Executive Order 13761
summary: Changes the July 12, 2017 dates in sections 1, 10 and 12(b) of Executive Order 13761 on Sudan to October 12, 2017, and revokes section 11 of that order.

title: Establishing a Presidential Advisory Council on Infrastructure
summary: Establishes a Presidential Advisory Council on Infrastructure in the Department of Commerce, with up to 15 members, to study federal infrastructure funding and delivery and report recommendations to the President.

title: Assessing and Strengthening the Manufacturing and Defense Industrial Base and Supply Chain Resiliency of the United States
summary: Directs the Secretary of Defense, with other agencies, to report to the President within 270 days assessing U.S. manufacturing capacity, defense industrial base and supply chain resiliency, with recommended changes.

title: Establishing Discipline and Accountability in the Environmental Review and Permitting Process for Infrastructure Projects
summary: Requires federal agencies to use "One Federal Decision" for major infrastructure projects: a lead agency, one Record of Decision, and permitting timetables. Revokes Executive Order 13690.

title: Imposing Additional Sanctions With Respect to the Situation in Venezuela
summary: Prohibits U.S. persons from dealing in certain Venezuelan government and PdVSA debt, equity, bonds and dividend payments, and from buying securities from the Venezuelan government.

title: Restoring State, Tribal, and Local Law Enforcement's Access to Life-Saving Equipment and Resources
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13688 on federal support for local law enforcement equipment acquisition, and directs agencies to stop implementing its recommendations and rescind implementing rules and policies.

title: Imposing Additional Sanctions With Respect to North Korea
summary: Blocks property of persons operating in key North Korean industries, ports, or trade, and authorizes sanctions on foreign banks dealing with them. Restricts ships and aircraft that visited North Korea.

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues 32 listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2019 and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to each committee's designated agency head. Revokes Executive Order 13805.

title: Revocation of Executive Order Creating Labor- Management Forums
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13522, abolishing the National Council on Federal Labor-Management Relations and agency forums, and directs OPM and agencies to rescind implementing rules and policies.

title: Promoting Healthcare Choice and Competition Across the United States
summary: Directs agencies to consider rules or guidance expanding association health plans, short-term limited-duration insurance and health reimbursement arrangements, and requires a biennial report to the President.

title: Amending Executive Order 13223
summary: Amends Executive Order 13223 to make national-emergency authorities under 10 U.S.C. 688 and 690 available to the Secretary concerned, with the military department Secretaries under the Secretary of Defense's direction.

title: Resuming the United States Refugee Admissions Program With Enhanced Vetting Capabilities
summary: Ends the refugee admissions suspension under EO 13780 and directs State and DHS to assess risks from refugee categories; requires an Attorney General report on resettlement within 180 days.

title: Revising the Seal for the National Credit Union Administration
summary: Approves a new official seal for the National Credit Union Administration, with the design made part of the order, and revokes Executive Order 11580 of 1971, which established the prior seal.

title: A Federal Strategy To Ensure Secure and Reliable Supplies of Critical Minerals
summary: Directs Interior to publish a list of critical minerals within 60 days, and Commerce to report within 180 days after that on a strategy to reduce reliance on them, covering mapping, trade and permitting.

title: Blocking the Property of Persons Involved in Serious Human Rights Abuse or Corruption
summary: Declares a national emergency over serious human rights abuse and corruption abroad and blocks the property of listed persons and those Treasury determines involved; also suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2018 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, Senior Executive Service, uniformed services and other pay systems, and sets locality payments. Supersedes Executive Order 13756.

title: Termination of Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13799 of May 11, 2017, and terminates the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity that it established.

title: Streamlining and Expediting Requests To Locate Broadband Facilities in Rural America
summary: Requires applicants and Federal property managing agencies to use the GSA Common Form Application for broadband facility siting requests on Federal property, and directs GSA to evaluate and report on it.

title: Supporting Our Veterans During Their Transition From Uniformed Service to Civilian Life
summary: Directs the Defense, Veterans Affairs and Homeland Security Secretaries to submit a Joint Action Plan within 60 days on mental health and suicide prevention access for transitioning service members, plus a 180-day status report.

title: Protecting America Through Lawful Detention of Terrorists
summary: Revokes the section of EO 13492 ordering closure of Guantánamo Bay detention facilities and allows more detainees to be transported there. Directs the Defense Secretary to recommend detainee disposition policies within 90 days.

title: President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition
summary: Revokes EO 13545 and amends EO 13265 to rename the council as the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition and direct HHS to develop a national youth sports strategy.

title: 2018 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts II, III, and IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial per Annex 1, and makes further Annex 2 amendments effective January 1, 2019 to implement the Military Justice Act of 2016.

title: Federal Interagency Council on Crime Prevention and Improving Reentry
summary: Establishes the Federal Interagency Council on Crime Prevention and Improving Reentry to develop recommendations and reports on crime prevention and reducing recidivism, and revokes the April 29, 2016 reentry memorandum.

title: Taking Additional Steps to Address the Situation in Venezuela
summary: Prohibits U.S. persons and transactions within the United States from dealing in, or financing, any digital currency, coin or token issued by or for the Government of Venezuela on or after January 9, 2018.

title: Reducing Poverty in America by Promoting Opportunity and Economic Mobility
summary: Directs eight cabinet Secretaries to review public assistance rules and work requirements, recommend changes within 90 days, then implement them, and report on compliance with alien benefit restrictions.

title: Task Force on the United States Postal System
summary: Establishes a Task Force on the United States Postal Service, chaired by the Treasury Secretary, to evaluate USPS operations and finances and report recommendations for administrative and legislative reform within 120 days.

title: Delegation of Authority To Approve Certain Military Decorations
summary: Authorizes military department Secretaries, and Homeland Security for the Coast Guard, to award listed decorations in the President's name under set criteria, superseding EOs 4601 and 9260.

title: Establishment of a White House Faith and Opportunity Initiative
summary: Establishes the White House Faith and Opportunity Initiative in the Executive Office of the President, headed by an Advisor. Renames related offices in earlier orders and revokes Executive Orders 13199 and 13498.

title: Enhancing Noncompetitive Civil Service Appointments of Military Spouses
summary: Requires agencies to advertise the military spouse hiring authority and note it in job announcements, and directs OPM to issue guidance and training; agencies report annually on spouse hiring.

title: Enhancing the Effectiveness of Agency Chief Information Officers
summary: Directs covered agency heads to have CIOs report directly to them, consolidate IT functions, and add CIO roles in cybersecurity and boards; directs OPM to propose a rule on IT direct-hire authority.

title: Efficient Federal Operations
summary: Directs agencies to meet statutory energy, water, waste and building-efficiency goals cost-effectively, assigns duties to CEQ, OMB and agency heads, and revokes Executive Order 13693.

title: Prohibiting Certain Additional Transactions With Respect to Venezuela
summary: Prohibits U.S. persons from purchasing debt owed to the Government of Venezuela, accepting such debt as collateral, or dealing in sales or pledges of its 50%-or-more-owned equity interests.

title: Developing Efficient, Effective, and Cost- Reducing Approaches To Federal Sector Collective Bargaining
summary: Establishes an OPM-chaired Interagency Labor Relations Working Group and sets bargaining objectives, negotiation timelines and limits for agencies; requires agencies to submit term CBAs to OPM for public posting.

title: Ensuring Transparency, Accountability, and Efficiency in Taxpayer-Funded Union Time Use
summary: Limits taxpayer-funded union time: agencies must target a union time rate of 1 hour or less, require advance written authorization, and report to OPM. Employees must spend three-quarters of paid time on agency work.

title: Exemption From Executive Order 13658 for Recreational Services on Federal Lands
summary: Amends EO 13658 to exempt seasonal recreational services and equipment rental contracts on Federal lands from its contractor minimum wage, except lodging and food services; directs agencies to remove the clauses.

title: Promoting Accountability and Streamlining Removal Procedures Consistent With Merit System Principles
summary: Limits agency grievance and bargaining terms on removals and ratings, generally caps performance opportunity periods at 30 days, and requires annual adverse-action reports to OPM.

title: Ocean Policy To Advance the Economic, Security, and Environmental Interests of the United States
summary: Establishes an interagency Ocean Policy Committee, co-chaired by the CEQ Chairman and OSTP Director, to coordinate ocean-related matters, and revokes Executive Order 13547 on ocean stewardship.

title: Affording Congress an Opportunity To Address Family Separation
summary: Directs DHS to keep alien families in custody together during improper-entry and immigration proceedings, and directs the Attorney General to seek modification of the Flores settlement to permit this.

title: Establishing an Exception to Competitive Examining Rules for Appointment to Certain Positions in the United States Marshals Service, Department of Justice
summary: Places Deputy U.S. Marshals and Criminal Investigators of the USMS in Schedule B of the excepted service, and allows non-competitive conversion to career appointments after 3 years of satisfactory service.

title: Excepting Administrative Law Judges From the Competitive Service
summary: Places administrative law judges in a new Schedule E of the excepted service by amending Civil Service Rule VI, and directs OPM to adopt implementing regulations and guidance on the transition.

title: Establishment of the Task Force on Market Integrity and Consumer Fraud
summary: Establishes a Task Force on Market Integrity and Consumer Fraud within the Department of Justice to guide fraud investigations and prosecutions, and revokes Executive Order 13519, ending the Financial Fraud Enforcement Task Force.

title: Establishing the President's National Council for the American Worker
summary: Establishes the President's National Council for the American Worker to develop workforce policy and strategy recommendations, and creates an American Workforce Policy Advisory Board to advise it.

title: Reimposing Certain Sanctions With Respect to Iran
summary: Authorizes blocking, correspondent-account and menu-based sanctions on persons involved in specified Iran transactions, and revokes Executive Orders 13628 and 13716.

title: Strengthening Retirement Security in America
summary: Directs Labor and Treasury to examine expanding multiple employer retirement plans, simplifying plan disclosures, and updating life expectancy tables for required minimum distributions.

title: Imposing Certain Sanctions in the Event of Foreign Interference in a United States Election
summary: Declares a national emergency over foreign election interference, requires post-election intelligence assessments, and blocks property of foreign persons Treasury determines engaged in such interference.

title: Authorizing the Implementation of Certain Sanctions Set Forth in the Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act
summary: Directs Treasury and other agencies to implement CAATSA and Ukraine Freedom Support Act sanctions, including asset blocking, financing and export bans, procurement limits, and visa denials.

title: Blocking Property of Additional Persons Contributing to the Situation in Venezuela
summary: Blocks property of persons determined to operate in Venezuela's gold sector or other designated sectors, or to be involved in corruption with its government, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons Contributing to the Situation in Nicaragua
summary: Declares a national emergency over Nicaragua and blocks property of persons the Treasury Secretary designates for abuses, corruption or undermining democracy, and suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 5, 2018
summary: Closes all executive departments and agencies on December 5, 2018, in respect for George H. W. Bush, lets agency heads keep essential offices open, and treats the day as a holiday for pay and leave.

title: Establishing the White House Opportunity and Revitalization Council
summary: Establishes a White House Opportunity and Revitalization Council, chaired by the HUD Secretary, to coordinate agency efforts to spur investment in distressed communities and opportunity zones, and amends EO 13845.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 24, 2018
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 24, 2018, while letting agency heads keep essential offices and staff working for national security or public need.

title: Promoting Active Management of America's Forests, Rangelands, and Other Federal Lands To Improve Conditions and Reduce Wildfire Risk
summary: Directs the Interior and Agriculture Secretaries to set wildfire prevention goals, streamline fuel-reduction review processes, and jointly develop a wildfire strategy by December 31, 2020.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2019 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, SES, Executive Schedule, uniformed services, judges and others, and authorizes locality payments. Supersedes Executive Order 13819.

title: Taking Additional Steps To Address the National Emergency With Respect to Venezuela
summary: Amends the "Government of Venezuela" definition in five Venezuela orders to include the Central Bank, PDVSA, persons it owns or controls, and persons acting for it, including the Maduro regime.

title: Strengthening Buy-American Preferences for Infrastructure Projects
summary: Directs agencies administering infrastructure financial assistance programs to encourage award recipients to use U.S.-produced iron, aluminum, steel, cement and other manufactured products, and to report to the President within 120 days.

title: Maintaining American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Launches the American AI Initiative: agencies must prioritize AI R&D funding, open federal data and computing to AI researchers, and issue AI regulatory guidance, standards, and workforce plans.

title: Supporting the Transition of Active Duty Service Members and Military Veterans Into the Merchant Marine
summary: Directs the Defense and Homeland Security Secretaries to identify military training that counts toward merchant mariner credentials, and to waive or pay credentialing fees for active duty members.

title: National Roadmap to Empower Veterans and End Suicide
summary: Establishes a Veteran Wellness, Empowerment, and Suicide Prevention Task Force, which must submit a roadmap on preventing veteran suicide, with a research strategy and grant proposal, within 365 days.

title: Revocation of Reporting Requirement
summary: Revokes Section 3 of Executive Order 13732, ending the annual requirement that the Director of National Intelligence release an unclassified summary of strikes outside areas of active hostilities and resulting deaths.

title: Taking Additional Steps to Address the National Emergency With Respect to Significant Transnational Criminal Organizations
summary: Amends Executive Order 13581 to redefine "significant transnational criminal organization" as a group including foreign persons engaged in serious criminal activity across at least two states' jurisdictions that threatens U.S. interests.

title: Improving Free Inquiry, Transparency, and Accountability at Colleges and Universities
summary: Directs covered agencies to ensure grant-receiving institutions promote free inquiry, and directs Education to expand College Scorecard earnings and debt data and build a loan borrower website.

title: Coordinating National Resilience to Electromagnetic Pulses
summary: Directs the National Security Advisor to coordinate executive branch efforts to assess and manage electromagnetic pulse risks, and assigns agencies roles and deadlines on EMP research, risk assessment and infrastructure protection.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2019 pay rates for General Schedule, Foreign Service, SES, Executive Schedule, judges, uniformed services and ALJs, sets locality pay, and supersedes Executive Order 13856.

title: Issuance of Permits With Respect to Facilities and Land Transportation Crossings at the International Boundaries of the United States
summary: Designates the Secretary of State to receive Presidential permit applications for cross-border pipelines, bridges and crossings, sets a 60-day process, and revokes Executive Orders 13337 and 11423.

title: Promoting Energy Infrastructure and Economic Growth
summary: Directs EPA to issue new Clean Water Act section 401 guidance and revise its rules, and directs DOT to update LNG facility safety rules and allow LNG in rail tank cars; orders related reviews and reports.

title: Transferring Responsibility for Background Investigations to the Department of Defense
summary: Amends EO 13467 to make the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency, renamed from DSS, the primary federal background investigator, and directs OPM's NBIB functions transferred to DoD by September 30, 2019.

title: America's Cybersecurity Workforce
summary: Directs DHS to set up a federal cybersecurity rotational assignment program and plan an annual President's Cup Cybersecurity Competition; also tasks agencies with workforce, award and NICE Framework measures.

title: Imposing Sanctions With Respect to the Iron, Steel, Aluminum, and Copper Sectors of Iran
summary: Blocks property of persons determined to operate in or knowingly transact significantly with Iran's iron, steel, aluminum, or copper sectors, and authorizes correspondent-account sanctions on foreign banks.

title: Economic Empowerment of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders
summary: Establishes an advisory commission in Commerce and a White House interagency initiative, co-chaired by the Commerce and Transportation Secretaries, to broaden AAPI access to economic resources; supersedes EO 13515.

title: Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain
summary: Declares a national emergency over foreign adversaries' ICT threats and prohibits transactions the Commerce Secretary determines pose undue risks, authorizing Commerce to issue implementing regulations.

title: Modernizing the Regulatory Framework for Agricultural Biotechnology Products
summary: Directs USDA, EPA and FDA to streamline agricultural biotechnology regulations, exempt low-risk products, and plan a joint web platform for developers, plus consumer and international outreach and trade strategies.

title: Evaluating and Improving the Utility of Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Requires each agency to terminate at least one-third of its discretionary advisory committees by September 30, 2019, and caps eligible committees government-wide at 350, absent an OMB waiver.

title: Imposing Sanctions With Respect to Iran
summary: Blocks the property of Iran's Supreme Leader, his Office, and persons tied to them; authorizes correspondent-account sanctions on foreign banks dealing with them; and suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Improving Price and Quality Transparency in American Healthcare To Put Patients First
summary: Directs HHS to propose a rule requiring hospitals to post standard charges, and directs agencies on out-of-pocket cost notices, quality measures, claims data access, and health account guidance.

title: Establishing a White House Council on Eliminating Regulatory Barriers to Affordable Housing
summary: Establishes a White House Council on Eliminating Regulatory Barriers to Affordable Housing, chaired by the HUD Secretary, to identify and recommend ways to reduce barriers to housing development; it terminates January 21, 2021.

title: Advancing American Kidney Health
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to launch a kidney disease awareness initiative, select two Medicare payment models, propose organ procurement and living-donor regulations, and promote artificial kidney development.

title: Collecting Information About Citizenship Status in Connection With the Decennial Census
summary: Directs all agencies to give the Commerce Department maximum lawful access to administrative records on citizenship, and establishes an interagency working group chaired by the Census Bureau Director.

title: Maximizing Use of American-Made Goods, Products, and Materials
summary: Directs the FAR Council to consider proposing rules treating end products as foreign if foreign content is 5% (iron/steel) or 45% (others), and raising price preferences to 20% or 30%.

title: Blocking Property and Suspending Entry of Certain Persons Contributing to the Situation in Mali
summary: Declares a national emergency over Mali and blocks property of persons found to threaten its peace, security or stability, or to commit abuses or corruption there; also suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Administration of Proliferation Sanctions and Amendment of Executive Order 12851
summary: Directs Treasury to implement CBW Act sanctions on a country by opposing international financial institution aid and barring U.S. bank loans to its government, and delegates these powers to Treasury.

title: Blocking Property of the Government of Venezuela
summary: Blocks all property of the Government of Venezuela in U.S. jurisdiction, and of persons who support or act for blocked persons, and suspends entry into the U.S. of aliens meeting those criteria.

title: Establishing the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee
summary: Establishes the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee, with up to 22 members appointed by the Secretary of Energy, to advise the Secretary and the Subcommittee on Quantum Information Science.

title: Modernizing Sanctions To Combat Terrorism
summary: Amends Executive Order 13224 to revise terrorism-related asset-blocking criteria and let Treasury restrict foreign banks' US accounts; revokes Executive Order 12947 and its national emergency.

title: Modernizing Influenza Vaccines in the United States to Promote National Security and Public Health
summary: Establishes a National Influenza Vaccine Task Force to produce a 5-year plan for modernizing influenza vaccines, and directs HHS, DOD and VA to estimate costs and take vaccine research and manufacturing steps.

title: Enhancing State and Local Involvement in Refugee Resettlement
summary: Requires State and HHS to set up a process, within 90 days, to obtain written State and local consent before resettling refugees there, with exceptions only if the Secretary of State so concludes.

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues 30 listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2021, and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to each committee's designated agency head.

title: Protecting and Improving Medicare for Our Nation's Seniors
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to propose Medicare rules expanding Medicare Advantage plan choices, adjusting network adequacy and reducing provider burdens, and to report on market-based pricing.

title: Promoting the Rule of Law Through Improved Agency Guidance Documents
summary: Requires agencies to post all guidance documents in a searchable website database, rescind outdated ones, and adopt regulations setting procedures for issuing guidance, including public comment on significant ones.

title: Promoting the Rule of Law Through Transparency and Fairness in Civil Administrative Enforcement and Adjudication
summary: Restricts agency use of guidance documents in civil enforcement and adjudication, requires notice and an opportunity to be heard, and directs agencies to publish inspection rules and report to the President.

title: Increasing Government Accountability for Administrative Actions by Reinvigorating Administrative PAYGO
summary: Requires agencies to submit discretionary actions to OMB for review, with a comparable offsetting mandatory-spending reduction for any increase, and directs OMB to issue guidance and revoke Memorandum M-05-13.

title: Blocking Property and Suspending Entry of Certain Persons Contributing to the Situation in Syria
summary: Declares a national emergency over Syria and blocks property of persons the Treasury Secretary determines are Turkish government officials or entities or are responsible for Syria abuses; authorizes further sanctions and suspends entry.

title: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
summary: Establishes the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, chaired by the OSTP Director with up to 16 outside members, to advise on science and technology policy; revokes EO 13539.

title: Commission on Law Enforcement and the Administration of Justice
summary: Directs the Attorney General to establish a Commission on Law Enforcement and the Administration of Justice to study crime and justice issues and recommend actions, with reports due within one year.

title: Improving Federal Contractor Operations by Revoking Executive Order 13495
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13495, which required successor federal contractors to offer predecessor employees a right of first refusal, and directs agencies to rescind implementing rules and end related investigations.

title: Establishing the Task Force on Missing and Murdered American Indians and Alaska Natives
summary: Establishes a task force, co-chaired by the Attorney General and Interior Secretary, to develop protocols, review cold cases and consult tribes on missing and murdered American Indians and Alaska Natives.

title: Combating Anti-Semitism
summary: Directs agencies enforcing Title VI to consider the IHRA working definition of anti-Semitism and its examples, and requires them to report within 120 days on other authorities where it could apply.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 24, 2019
summary: Closes all executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 24, 2019, while letting agency heads keep essential offices and staff working for national security or public need.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2020 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, Senior Executive Service, Executive Schedule, judges, uniformed services and ALJs, and sets locality payments; supersedes EO 13866.

title: Imposing Sanctions With Respect to Additional Sectors of Iran
summary: Blocks property of persons determined to operate in Iran's construction, mining, manufacturing, or textiles sectors or to support blocked persons. Authorizes correspondent account sanctions on foreign banks and suspends entry.

title: Combating Human Trafficking and Online Child Exploitation in the United States
summary: Directs federal agencies to combat human trafficking and online child exploitation: a dedicated Domestic Policy Council position, prevalence estimates, better enforcement coordination, missing-child location, and school prevention programs.

title: Ensuring Safe and Lawful E-Commerce for United States Consumers, Businesses, Government Supply Chains, and Intellectual Property Rights Holders
summary: Directs DHS to propose importer-of-record criteria excluding CBP-suspended or debarred persons and to score international posts, with inspection and import limits on non-compliant posts.

title: Strengthening National Resilience Through Responsible Use of Positioning, Navigation, and Timing Services
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to develop positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) profiles within 1 year, and assigns agencies related testing, federal contract, reporting and R&D tasks.

title: Amending Executive Order 13803 Reviving the National Space Council
summary: Revises National Space Council membership, adding the Secretary of Energy, the Secretary of Homeland Security, and the Assistants to the President for Economic and Domestic Policy, and revokes the quarterly reporting requirement.

title: Establishment of the Interagency Environment Committee for Monitoring and Enforcement Under Section 811 of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act
summary: Establishes the Interagency Environment Committee for Monitoring and Enforcement, chaired by the USTR, to coordinate U.S. monitoring and enforcement of Mexico's and Canada's USMCA environmental obligations.

title: Establishment of the Interagency Committee on Trade in Automotive Goods Under Section 202A of the United States Mexico Canada Agreement Implementation Act
summary: Establishes the Interagency Committee on Trade in Automotive Goods, chaired by the USTR, to advise on USMCA automotive provisions, and directs Treasury, Labor and CBP to issue implementing regulations.

title: Prioritizing and Allocating Health and Medical Resources to Respond to the Spread of COVID-19
summary: Delegates to the HHS Secretary the President's Defense Production Act section 101 authority to prioritize contracts and allocate health and medical resources needed to respond to COVID-19 within the United States.

title: Preventing Hoarding of Health and Medical Resources To Respond to the Spread of COVID-19
summary: Delegates to the Health and Human Services Secretary the President's Defense Production Act authority to prevent hoarding of COVID-19 health and medical resources, including designating scarce materials.

title: Delegating Additional Authority Under the Defense Production Act With Respect to Health and Medical Resources To Respond to the Spread of COVID-19
summary: Delegates to the Secretaries of Health and Human Services and Homeland Security the President's Defense Production Act loan, purchase and voluntary-agreement authorities for COVID-19 response.

title: National Emergency Authority To Order the Selected Reserve and Certain Members of the Individual Ready Reserve of the Armed Forces to Active Duty
summary: Authorizes the military service Secretaries and Homeland Security (for the Coast Guard) to order Ready Reserve units and members to active duty for up to 24 months, capped at 1,000,000, for the COVID-19 emergency.

title: Establishing the Committee for the Assessment of Foreign Participation in the United States Telecommunications Services Sector
summary: Establishes a Committee, chaired by the Attorney General, to review FCC telecommunications applications and licenses for national security and law enforcement risks and recommend that the FCC deny, condition or revoke them.

title: Encouraging International Support for the Recovery and Use of Space Resources
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to encourage international support for public and private space resource recovery and use, negotiate arrangements with foreign states, and object to treating the Moon Agreement as customary law.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of the Interior
summary: Sets the order of succession to act as Secretary of the Interior when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unavailable, starting with the Solicitor, and revokes Executive Order 13244.

title: National Emergency Authority To Temporarily Extend Deadlines for Certain Estimated Payments
summary: Makes 19 U.S.C. 1318(a) deadline-extension authority available to the Treasury Secretary and directs consideration of extending estimated payment deadlines for importers in COVID-19 hardship.

title: Delegating Authority Under the Defense Production Act With Respect to Food Supply Chain Resources During the National Emergency Caused by the Outbreak of COVID- 19
summary: Delegates Defense Production Act contract-priority and allocation authority over food supply chain resources to the Secretary of Agriculture, who must act to keep meat and poultry processors operating.

title: Establishment of the Interagency Labor Committee for Monitoring and Enforcement Under Section 711 of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act
summary: Establishes an Interagency Labor Committee, co-chaired by the U.S. Trade Representative and Secretary of Labor, to monitor Canada's and Mexico's USMCA labor obligations and recommend enforcement actions.

title: Ordering the Selected Reserve of the Armed Forces to Active Duty
summary: Directs the Secretary of Defense to call Selected Reserve units and members to active duty for up to 365 consecutive days, no more than 200 at a time, for a Western Hemisphere counternarcotic operation.

title: Securing the United States Bulk-Power System
summary: Declares a national emergency and prohibits acquiring or installing bulk-power system electric equipment from foreign adversaries when the Energy Secretary finds undue risk; creates a procurement task force.

title: Promoting American Seafood Competitiveness and Economic Growth
summary: Directs agencies to reduce fishing regulatory burdens, speed aquaculture permitting, combat illegal fishing, and identify aquaculture areas; creates an Interagency Seafood Trade Task Force.

title: Delegating Authority Under the Defense Production Act to the Chief Executive Officer of the United States International Development Finance Corporation To Respond to the COVID-19 Outbreak
summary: Delegates to the DFC Chief Executive Officer the President's Defense Production Act title III loan authority, limited to COVID-19 response and domestic supply chains, expiring with the CARES Act waiver period.

title: Establishment of the Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force Under Section 741 of the United States- Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act
summary: Establishes the Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force, chaired by the Secretary of Homeland Security, to monitor enforcement of the Tariff Act section 307 ban, and sets its membership and decision rules.

title: Regulatory Relief To Support Economic Recovery
summary: Directs agency heads to use emergency authorities to support COVID-19 economic recovery, identify regulatory standards to rescind or waive, speed pre-enforcement rulings, and review fairness in enforcement.

title: Preventing Online Censorship
summary: Directs Commerce to petition the FCC to clarify section 230(c) immunity for online platforms, orders agency ad-spending reviews, and tasks the FTC and a DOJ working group with reviewing platform practices.

title: Advancing International Religious Freedom
summary: Directs State and USAID to plan for prioritizing international religious freedom and budget at least $50 million yearly for it. Also requires staff training and economic-tool recommendations.

title: Accelerating the Nation's Economic Recovery From the COVID-19 Emergency by Expediting Infrastructure Investments and Other Activities
summary: Directs agencies to use emergency and other authorities to expedite infrastructure and other projects, including under NEPA, the ESA and the Clean Water Act, and to file summary and recurring status reports.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons Associated With the International Criminal Court
summary: Declares a national emergency over the ICC and blocks property of foreign persons who help ICC efforts to investigate or prosecute U.S. or allied personnel, and suspends their entry, and that of ICC staff, into the U.S.

title: Safe Policing for Safe Communities
summary: Directs DOJ to limit discretionary grants to law enforcement agencies seeking credentialing, with use-of-force standards including a chokehold ban, and to create a database of excessive-force incidents.

title: Strengthening the Child Welfare System for America's Children
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to publish foster care data, issue guidance on partnering with nongovernmental organizations, expand caregiver resources, and strengthen federal reviews of State child welfare practices.

title: Continuing the President's National Council for the American Worker and the American Workforce Policy Advisory Board
summary: Extends the President's National Council for the American Worker and the American Workforce Policy Advisory Board until September 30, 2021, by amending Executive Order 13845's termination provision.

title: Modernizing and Reforming the Assessment and Hiring of Federal Job Candidates
summary: Directs OPM to revise competitive-service job classification and qualification standards to limit minimum education requirements, and directs agencies to assess candidates on skills, not education or self-evaluation alone.

title: Protecting American Monuments, Memorials, and Statues and Combating Recent Criminal Violence
summary: Directs the Attorney General to prioritize prosecuting destruction of monuments and vandalism of government property, and agencies to limit grants to jurisdictions failing to protect monuments.

title: Building and Rebuilding Monuments to American Heroes
summary: Establishes an interagency Task Force chaired by the Interior Secretary to plan a National Garden of American Heroes statuary park, and directs agencies to prioritize funding for statues of historically significant Americans.

title: White House Hispanic Prosperity Initiative
summary: Establishes the White House Hispanic Prosperity Initiative in the Department of Education and a President's Advisory Commission on Hispanic Prosperity, to improve Hispanic Americans' access to educational and economic opportunities.

title: The President's Executive Order on Hong Kong Normalization
summary: Declares a national emergency on Hong Kong, suspends its differential treatment under listed statutes, directs agencies to end preferences, and blocks property of those undermining its autonomy.

title: Access to Affordable Life-Saving Medications
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to condition future health center grants on FQHCs offering insulin and injectable epinephrine at their 340B discounted price plus a minimal fee to low-income patients with high costs or no insurance.

title: Increasing Drug Importation To Lower Prices for American Patients
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to expand access to lower-cost imported prescription drugs by facilitating importation waivers, authorizing emergency insulin re-importation, and finishing the Canada importation rule.

title: Lowering Prices for Patients by Eliminating Kickbacks to Middlemen
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to finish rulemaking removing anti-kickback safe harbor protection for certain Part D drug rebates and creating safe harbors for point-of-sale discounts and PBM service fees.

title: Aligning Federal Contracting and Hiring Practices With the Interests of American Workers
summary: Directs agencies to review FY2018-2019 contractor use of temporary foreign labor and offshoring and report to OMB within 120 days; directs Labor and DHS to protect U.S. workers from H-1B wage effects.

title: Improving Rural Health and Telehealth Access
summary: Directs HHS to announce a rural payment model and to propose a rule extending telehealth flexibilities beyond the PHE, and HHS and Agriculture to develop a rural health infrastructure strategy.

title: Addressing the Threat Posed by TikTok, and Taking Additional Steps To Address the National Emergency With Respect to the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain
summary: Prohibits transactions with ByteDance Ltd. and its subsidiaries 45 days after the order, as identified by the Commerce Secretary, who is also authorized to issue implementing regulations.

title: Addressing the Threat Posed by WeChat, and Taking Additional Steps To Address the National Emergency With Respect to the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain
summary: Prohibits, beginning 45 days after the order, transactions related to WeChat with Tencent Holdings Ltd. or its subsidiaries, and directs the Secretary of Commerce to identify the covered transactions.

title: Combating Public Health Emergencies and Strengthening National Security by Ensuring Essential Medicines, Medical Countermeasures, and Critical Inputs Are Made in the United States
summary: Directs agencies to limit competition to U.S.-produced essential medicines, countermeasures and inputs, and directs HHS/FDA to list them and identify and reduce supply chain vulnerabilities.

title: Fighting the Spread of COVID-19 by Providing Assistance to Renters and Homeowners
summary: Directs HHS and CDC to consider eviction-halting measures, Treasury and HUD to identify federal funds for renters and homeowners, and HUD and FHFA to act on or review ways to prevent evictions and foreclosures.

title: Targeting Opportunity Zones and Other Distressed Communities for Federal Site Locations
summary: Amends Executive Orders 12072 and 13006 to prefer opportunity zones and other distressed areas when locating Federal space, and revises the General Services Administrator's duties.

title: Lowering Drug Prices by Putting America First
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to implement rulemaking for a payment model testing whether Medicare Part B pays no more than the most-favored-nation price, the lowest price in comparable OECD countries, for certain high-cost drugs.

title: Lowering Drug Prices by Putting America First
summary: Directs HHS to implement a Medicare Part B payment model and develop a Part D model capping payment at the most-favored-nation price (lowest OECD price, adjusted). Revokes the July 24, 2020 order.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons With Respect to the Conventional Arms Activities of Iran
summary: Blocks property of persons determined to contribute to arms transfers to or from Iran or to support such persons, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Combating Race and Sex Stereotyping
summary: Prohibits agencies and the Uniformed Services from teaching defined 'divisive concepts' on race and sex, and requires federal contracts to bar such training by contractors.

title: An America-First Healthcare Plan
summary: Directs HHS to seek a surprise-billing law by Dec. 31, 2020, or else act administratively, and to add hospital billing-quality data to Hospital Compare; agencies keep expanding healthcare choice and lowering costs.

title: Protecting Vulnerable Newborn and Infant Children
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to make federally funded programs aware of EMTALA and Rehab Act duties toward premature or disabled infants, investigate complaints, enforce, and prioritize related grants.

title: Addressing the Threat to the Domestic Supply Chain From Reliance on Critical Minerals From Foreign Adversaries and Supporting the Domestic Mining and Processing Industries
summary: Declares a national emergency over reliance on critical minerals from foreign adversaries and directs the Interior Secretary to investigate and report within 60 days; directs agencies to expand domestic mining.

title: Saving Lives Through Increased Support for Mental- and Behavioral-Health Needs
summary: Establishes the Coronavirus Mental Health Working Group, to report within 45 days on service coordination, and directs agencies to encourage grantees to adopt mental-health policies and fund community providers.

title: Establishing the One Trillion Trees Interagency Council
summary: Establishes the United States One Trillion Trees Interagency Council, co-chaired by the Interior and Agriculture Secretaries, to coordinate federal tree growing, restoration and conservation work; it ends December 31, 2030.

title: Modernizing America's Water Resource Management and Water Infrastructure
summary: Establishes an interagency Water Subcabinet, co-chaired by the Interior Secretary and EPA Administrator, to coordinate water policy, consolidate working groups, and report recommendations on water management and infrastructure.

title: Creating Schedule F in the Excepted Service
summary: Creates Schedule F of the excepted service for career policy-related positions and directs agency heads to review positions and petition OPM to place them there.

title: Establishing the President's Advisory 1776 Commission
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to establish the President's Advisory 1776 Commission, with up to 20 members, to report on founding principles and advise on patriotic education. Directs agencies to prioritize related resources.

title: Addressing the Threat From Securities Investments That Finance Communist Chinese Military Companies
summary: Declares a national emergency and bars U.S. persons from transactions in securities of Communist Chinese military companies from January 11, 2021, allowing divestment until November 11, 2021.

title: Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government
summary: Sets nine principles agencies must follow when using AI outside defense and national security, and requires OMB guidance, annual agency inventories of AI use cases, and AI expertise programs.

title: Governance and Integration of Federal Mission Resilience
summary: Establishes the Federal Mission Resilience Executive Committee to coordinate the Strategy and continuity policy, and amends PPD-40 and EO 13618 to name the APNSA as continuity coordinator.

title: Ensuring Access to United States Government COVID-19 Vaccines
summary: Directs HHS to ensure Americans, starting with the most vulnerable, get priority access to U.S. Government COVID-19 vaccines, and to facilitate international access once domestic supply is sufficient.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Defense
summary: Sets the order in which listed Defense Department officials, starting with the Deputy Secretary, act as Secretary of Defense when the Secretary is unable to serve, and revokes Executive Order 13533.

title: Rebranding United States Foreign Assistance To Advance American Influence
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to start rulemaking within 120 days to mark all U.S. foreign assistance as "American aid" with a single presidentially selected logo, with waivers allowed, and requires annual reports.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 24, 2020
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses their employees from duty on December 24, 2020, while letting agency heads keep certain offices open and employees working for national security or public need.

title: Increasing Economic and Geographic Mobility
summary: Sets six principles for occupational licensing reform and directs agencies to review their rules and report every 2 years on aligning with them and on rewarding States that adopt them.

title: Promoting Beautiful Federal Civic Architecture
summary: Makes classical architecture the default for D.C. federal buildings and establishes a Council on Improving Federal Civic Architecture. Requires GSA to notify the President before approving designs that depart from preferred styles.

title: Promoting Redemption of Savings Bonds
summary: Directs Treasury to digitize savings bond records to identify owners of matured unredeemed bonds and add them to Treasury Hunt, research redemption barriers, work with States, and report within 6 months.

title: Expanding Educational Opportunity Through School Choice
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to allow Community Services Block Grant funds to be used for emergency learning scholarships for disadvantaged families whose children lack in-person learning, covering private school tuition, tutoring and more.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets adjusted pay rates for statutory pay systems, the Senior Executive Service, executive, legislative and judicial offices, and uniformed services, plus locality pay; supersedes EO 13901.

title: Addressing the Threat Posed by Applications and Other Software Developed or Controlled by Chinese Companies
summary: Prohibits, starting 45 days after the order, U.S. transactions with developers or controllers of eight named Chinese apps, including Alipay and WeChat Pay, as Commerce identifies them; Commerce must report on user-data transfers.

title: Promoting Small Modular Reactors for National Defense and Space Exploration
summary: Directs Defense to plan a licensed micro-reactor demonstration at a military installation and pilot a transportable one; NASA to define nuclear needs; Energy to complete HALEU work; agencies to build a roadmap.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Environmental Protection Agency
summary: Sets the order in which 17 listed EPA officials, starting with the General Counsel, act as EPA Administrator when the Administrator and Deputy Administrator cannot serve, and revokes Executive Order 13763.

title: Amending Executive Order 13959 Addressing the Threat From Securities Investments That Finance Communist Chinese Military Companies
summary: Amends EO 13959 to set divestment windows for securities in Chinese military companies (Nov. 11, 2021, or 365 days after listing) and revises the listing criteria and the "transaction" definition.

title: Encouraging Buy American Policies for the United States Postal Service
summary: Encourages the Postmaster General to consider amending USPS supplying practices to match FAR price-differential and foreign-origin rules within 90 days of any final FAR rule under EO 13881.

title: Establishing the Wildland Fire Management Policy Committee
summary: Establishes the interagency Wildland Fire Subcabinet, co-chaired by the Agriculture and Interior Secretaries, and directs it to recommend consolidating wildfire working groups and publish a strategic plan within 180 days.

title: Protecting Law Enforcement Officers, Judges, Prosecutors, and Their Families
summary: Directs agencies to remove obstacles to LEOSA concealed carry by federal officers and the Attorney General to propose deputation of at-risk federal prosecutors to carry firearms, plus protections and legislation.

title: Building the National Garden of American Heroes
summary: Amends EO 13934 to list individuals for statues in the National Garden of American Heroes and to direct site selection and construction; requires annual Task Force progress reports.

title: Ensuring Democratic Accountability in Agency Rulemaking
summary: Requires agency heads to have senior appointees sign section 553 rules, initiate rulemaking and approve regulatory agendas, and to review existing delegations and past significant rules.

title: Protecting Americans From Overcriminalization Through Regulatory Reform
summary: Directs agencies to state in rules whether violations carry criminal penalties and the mens rea required, and to publish guidance on handling regulatory offenses administratively.

title: Protecting the United States From Certain Unmanned Aircraft Systems
summary: Directs agencies to review authority to stop procuring or funding UAS tied to foreign adversaries and report on their existing fleets; directs the FAA to propose rules limiting UAS over critical infrastructure.

title: Care of Veterans With Service in Uzbekistan
summary: Directs the VA Secretary to consider designating veterans who served in Uzbekistan from 2001 to 2005 as theater-of-combat veterans. Directs DoD to study toxic exposure at Karshi-Khanabad Air Base within 365 days.

title: Revocation of Executive Order 13770
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13770 on ethics commitments by executive branch appointees, effective noon January 20, 2021, so employees and former employees are no longer bound by those commitments.

title: Taking Additional Steps To Address the National Emergency With Respect to Significant Malicious Cyber- Enabled Activities
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to propose regulations within 180 days requiring U.S. IaaS providers to verify foreign customers' identities and keep records, and allowing special measures against certain foreign jurisdictions or persons.

title: Advancing Racial Equity and Support for Underserved Communities Through the Federal Government
summary: Directs agencies to review programs for barriers facing underserved communities and produce plans addressing them, creates an Equitable Data Working Group, and revokes EOs 13950 and 13958.

title: Ensuring a Lawful and Accurate Enumeration and Apportionment Pursuant to the Decennial Census
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to report state population tabulations for apportionment without regard to immigration status, and revokes EO 13880 and the July 2020 memorandum on excluding illegal aliens.

title: Organizing and Mobilizing the United States Government To Provide a Unified and Effective Response To Combat COVID-19 and To Provide United States Leadership on Global Health and Security
summary: Establishes a COVID-19 Response Coordinator and Deputy in the Executive Office of the President, and creates an NSC Directorate on Global Health Security and Biodefense and a 180-day biopreparedness review.

title: Preventing and Combating Discrimination on the Basis of Gender Identity or Sexual Orientation
summary: Directs agency heads to review agency actions under sex-discrimination laws for inconsistency with the order's policy, consider revising or rescinding them, and develop plans within 100 days.

title: Ethics Commitments by Executive Branch Personnel
summary: Requires every executive agency appointee appointed on or after January 20, 2021 to sign an ethics pledge with gift, revolving-door and other limits, and sets waiver, administration and enforcement rules.

title: Protecting Public Health and the Environment and Restoring Science To Tackle the Climate Crisis
summary: Directs agencies to review 2017-2021 actions inconsistent with its policy and consider suspending or rescinding them. Revokes the Keystone XL permit and several earlier executive orders.

title: Protecting the Federal Workforce and Requiring Mask-Wearing
summary: Requires agency heads to enforce CDC mask-wearing and physical-distancing guidelines for federal employees, contractors and people in federal buildings and lands, and establishes a Safer Federal Workforce Task Force.

title: Revocation of Certain Executive Orders Concerning Federal Regulation
summary: Revokes six executive orders on federal regulation (13771, 13777, 13875, 13891, 13892, 13893) and directs OMB and agencies to rescind implementing policies and abolish entities those orders created.

title: Revision of Civil Immigration Enforcement Policies and Priorities
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13768 on interior immigration enforcement and directs State, Justice, Homeland Security, OMB, OPM and other agencies to review actions taken under it and issue revised guidance.

title: Ensuring a Data-Driven Response to COVID-19 and Future High-Consequence Public Health Threats
summary: Directs agencies to designate senior data leads and make COVID-19 data public, and directs OMB to issue open-data guidance. Directs HHS to review public health data systems and report, and OSTP to plan.

title: Ensuring an Equitable Pandemic Response and Recovery
summary: Establishes a COVID-19 Health Equity Task Force within HHS to recommend ways to reduce pandemic health inequities, and directs agencies to assess and modify response plans to advance equity.

title: Establishing the COVID-19 Pandemic Testing Board and Ensuring a Sustainable Public Health Workforce for COVID-19 and Other Biological Threats
summary: Establishes a COVID-19 Pandemic Testing Board to coordinate federal testing efforts, directs agencies to expand free testing, and requires HHS plans for a public health workforce and a U.S. Public Health Job Corps.

title: Improving and Expanding Access to Care and Treatments for COVID-19
summary: Directs HHS to plan COVID-19 therapy research, agencies to give surge assistance to care facilities, and HHS, Defense and VA to set treatment production targets and promote treatment access and coverage.

title: Promoting COVID-19 Safety in Domestic and International Travel
summary: Directs agencies to require masks in airports, on commercial aircraft, trains, ferries, intercity buses and public transit. Orders review of international travel testing and quarantine measures and port-of-entry plans.

title: Protecting Worker Health and Safety
summary: Directs the Labor Secretary to issue revised COVID-19 workplace safety guidance within 2 weeks, consider emergency temporary standards (including masks) by March 15, 2021, and focus OSHA enforcement.

title: Supporting the Reopening and Continuing Operation of Schools and Early Childhood Education Providers
summary: Directs the Secretaries of Education and of Health and Human Services to issue reopening guidance, collect data and give technical help to schools, child care and Head Start, and to report on COVID-19's educational impact.

title: A Sustainable Public Health Supply Chain
summary: Directs agencies to inventory COVID-19 response supplies and fill shortfalls, including via the Defense Production Act, and requires a long-term pandemic supply chain strategy within 180 days.

title: Economic Relief Related to the COVID-19 Pandemic
summary: Directs all executive agencies to identify actions within existing authorities to address the pandemic's economic crisis and, as appropriate, take them, prioritizing relief to individuals, families, small businesses and governments.

title: Protecting the Federal Workforce
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13957 (Schedule F) and three 2018 collective bargaining and removal orders, directs agencies to rescind related actions, and requires a report on a $15/hour federal minimum wage.

title: Enabling All Qualified Americans To Serve Their Country in Uniform
summary: Revokes the 2018 memorandum on transgender military service and directs Defense and Homeland Security (Coast Guard) to bar gender-identity discharges, review past separations and allow transition while serving.

title: Ensuring the Future Is Made in All of America by All of America's Workers
summary: Creates a Made in America Office in OMB to review agency waivers of Buy American laws, and directs a public waiver website and FAR Council review of domestic content rules. Revokes EOs 13788, 13975.

title: Reforming Our Incarceration System To Eliminate the Use of Privately Operated Criminal Detention Facilities
summary: Directs the Attorney General not to renew Department of Justice contracts with privately operated criminal detention facilities, consistent with applicable law.

title: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
summary: Establishes the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, up to 26 members, to advise on science, technology and innovation policy, and revokes Executive Order 13895.

title: Tackling the Climate Crisis at Home and Abroad
summary: Creates the Office of Domestic Climate Policy and National Climate Task Force and directs agencies on climate action, including pausing new oil and gas leases on public lands and offshore waters.

title: Strengthening Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act
summary: Directs agencies to review Medicaid and ACA actions for inconsistency with the order's policy and consider suspending or rescinding them; revokes EOs 13765 and 13813; HHS to consider a special enrollment period.

title: Creating a Comprehensive Regional Framework To Address the Causes of Migration, To Manage Migration Throughout North and Central America, and To Provide Safe and Orderly Processing of Asylum Seekers at the United States Border
summary: Directs strategies on migration root causes and regional migration management, orders reviews of border asylum policies, and revokes Executive Order 13767 and four other presidential documents.

title: Establishment of Interagency Task Force on the Reunification of Families
summary: Establishes an Interagency Task Force, chaired by the Homeland Security Secretary, to identify and reunite children separated at the border in 2017–2021, and revokes Executive Order 13841.

title: Restoring Faith in Our Legal Immigration Systems and Strengthening Integration and Inclusion Efforts for New Americans
summary: Directs State, Justice and DHS to review legal immigration and public charge actions and develop naturalization plans, creates a Naturalization Working Group, and revokes the 2019 sponsor memorandum.

title: Rebuilding and Enhancing Programs To Resettle Refugees and Planning for the Impact of Climate Change on Migration
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 13815 and 13888 and a 2017 memorandum, and directs agencies to improve refugee processing, review Iraqi and Afghan SIV programs, and report on climate migration.

title: Blocking Property With Respect to the Situation in Burma
summary: Declares a national emergency over Burma and blocks property of persons determined to be in its defense sector, responsible for undermining democracy or abuses, or military leaders; suspends their entry.

title: Establishment of the White House Office of Faith- Based and Neighborhood Partnerships
summary: Establishes the White House Office of Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships in the EOP, renames offices in five earlier orders, and revokes EO 13831, which created the White House Faith and Opportunity Initiative.

title: Revocation of Executive Order 13801
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13801 (Expanding Apprenticeships in America) and directs OMB and agency heads to consider rescinding implementing rules and policies and to abolish entities it established.

title: America's Supply Chains
summary: Orders a 100-day review of supply chain risks for semiconductors, high-capacity batteries, critical minerals and pharmaceuticals, plus one-year sectoral assessments of six industrial bases.

title: Revocation of Certain Presidential Actions
summary: Revokes seven Presidential actions, including EOs 13772, 13828, 13924, 13967 and 13979, and directs OMB and agencies to consider rescinding implementing rules and to abolish entities they created.

title: Promoting Access to Voting
summary: Directs agencies to evaluate and plan ways to promote voter registration and participation, and tasks GSA, OPM, DoD and DOJ with voting-access steps. Creates a Native American voting rights steering group.

title: Establishment of the White House Gender Policy Council
summary: Establishes the White House Gender Policy Council in the Executive Office of the President to coordinate federal gender equity efforts, and directs it to submit a Government-wide strategy within 200 days.

title: Guaranteeing an Educational Environment Free From Discrimination on the Basis of Sex, Including Sexual Orientation or Gender Identity
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to review, within 100 days, agency actions including the 2020 Title IX rule for consistency with a policy against sex discrimination, and to consider revising them and added enforcement.

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the International Criminal Court
summary: Terminates the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13928 on the International Criminal Court and revokes that order, ending the related entry suspension for covered individuals.

title: Establishment of the Presidential Commission on the Supreme Court of the United States
summary: Establishes the Presidential Commission on the Supreme Court, up to 36 members, to report to the President within 180 days of its first meeting on Supreme Court reform arguments and proposals.

title: Blocking Property With Respect To Specified Harmful Foreign Activities of the Government of the Russian Federation
summary: Declares a national emergency over specified Russian government activities and blocks property of persons determined to operate in Russia's technology or defense sectors or to be linked to the Russian government. Suspends their entry.
