title: Worker Organizing and Empowerment
summary: Establishes a Task Force on Worker Organizing and Empowerment, chaired by the Vice President, to recommend within 180 days ways to promote organizing and collective bargaining. Revokes EOs 13845 and 13931.

title: Increasing the Minimum Wage for Federal Contractors
summary: Requires agencies to include in covered contracts a clause setting a $15.00 hourly minimum wage from January 30, 2022, indexed annually thereafter, and revokes Executive Order 13838.

title: Establishment of the Climate Change Support Office
summary: Establishes a temporary Climate Change Support Office within the Department of State, headed by a Director, to support U.S. bilateral and multilateral diplomatic engagement on the global climate crisis.

title: Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity
summary: Directs agencies to strengthen cybersecurity through zero trust and cloud adoption, software supply chain standards, incident-reporting contract terms, and a new Cyber Safety Review Board.

title: Revocation of Certain Presidential Actions and Technical Amendment
summary: Revokes six Executive Orders issued in 2020–2021 and directs agencies to consider rescinding implementing rules. Amends Civil Service Rule VI (5 CFR 6.2, 6.4) to remove Schedule F.

title: Climate-Related Financial Risk
summary: Directs a Government-wide climate-related financial risk strategy and agency actions on financial regulation, pensions, procurement and budget; reinstates EO 13690 flood standard.

title: Advancing Equity, Justice, and Opportunity for Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders
summary: Establishes a 25-member President's Advisory Commission on AA and NHPI communities at HHS and a White House Initiative, an interagency working group, and supersedes four earlier AAPI orders.

title: Addressing the Threat From Securities Investments That Finance Certain Companies of the People's Republic of China
summary: Replaces EO 13959's core sections to bar U.S. persons from trading securities of listed PRC defense and surveillance technology companies, with divestment allowed to June 3, 2022; revokes EO 13974.

title: Blocking Property and Suspending Entry Into the United States of Certain Persons Contributing to the Destabilizing Situation in the Western Balkans
summary: Expands the Western Balkans national emergency and blocks property of persons determined to threaten regional stability, undermine democracy, or engage in corruption or abuses there. Suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Protecting Americans' Sensitive Data From Foreign Adversaries
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 13942, 13943 and 13971 (TikTok, WeChat, Chinese apps) and directs Commerce to report on protecting sensitive data and to evaluate risky connected software applications.

title: Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility in the Federal Workforce
summary: Directs OPM and OMB to reestablish a Government-wide diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility initiative and issue a strategic plan within 150 days, which agency heads must implement.

title: Promoting Competition in the American Economy
summary: Establishes a White House Competition Council in the Executive Office of the President and directs agencies to take pro-competition actions, with reports and rulemakings in agriculture, transport, health and other sectors.

title: Strengthening American Leadership in Clean Cars and Trucks
summary: Directs EPA and the Transportation Secretary to consider rulemakings for new emissions, fuel economy and fuel efficiency standards for light-, medium- and heavy-duty vehicles from model year 2027.

title: Blocking Property of Additional Persons Contributing to the Situation in Belarus
summary: Expands the Belarus national emergency and blocks property of persons determined to be Belarusian government officials, operators in key economic sectors, or involved in abuses. Suspends their entry.

title: Blocking Property With Respect to Certain Russian Energy Export Pipelines
summary: Blocks the U.S. property of foreign persons identified in State Department reports to Congress under PEESA section 7503(a)(1)(B), and directs State and Homeland Security to apply PEESA visa and entry limits.

title: Declassification Reviews of Certain Documents Concerning the Terrorist Attacks of September 11, 2001
summary: Directs the Attorney General and other originating agencies to complete staged declassification reviews of FBI and other records on the 9/11 attacks, report results, and publicly release declassified information.

title: White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity Through Historically Black Colleges and Universities
summary: Establishes a White House Initiative on HBCUs in the Department of Education, with an interagency working group and a President's Board of Advisors, and requires annual agency plans. Revokes EO 13779.

title: Ensuring Adequate COVID Safety Protocols for Federal Contractors
summary: Requires agencies to put a clause in covered federal contracts making contractors and subcontractors follow OMB-approved Safer Federal Workforce Task Force COVID-19 workplace guidance, and directs FAR amendments.

title: Requiring Coronavirus Disease 2019 Vaccination for Federal Employees
summary: Requires each executive agency to implement a program requiring COVID-19 vaccination for all its Federal employees, with legally required exceptions. Directs the Task Force to issue implementation guidance within 7 days.

title: Amending Executive Order 14007
summary: Amends Executive Order 14007 to set the membership of the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (PCAST) at not more than 32 members.

title: White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity for Hispanics
summary: Establishes a White House Initiative on Hispanic educational equity in the Education Department, with an interagency working group and agency plans, plus a 21-member advisory commission; revokes EO 13935.

title: Imposing Sanctions on Certain Persons With Respect to the Humanitarian and Human Rights Crisis in Ethiopia
summary: Declares a national emergency over northern Ethiopia and authorizes Treasury, with State, to impose blocking and other sanctions on foreign persons tied to the crisis, and suspends their entry into the U.S.

title: Adding Measles to the List of Quarantinable Communicable Diseases
summary: Amends section 1 of Executive Order 13295, as previously amended, to add measles to the list of quarantinable communicable diseases, placing it after infectious tuberculosis.

title: Continuance or Reestablishment of Certain Federal Advisory Committees and Amendments to Other Executive Orders
summary: Continues or reestablishes the listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2023, and amends the orders for the Medal of Science committee, NSTAC, NIAC and the sports and fitness council.

title: White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity for Native Americans and Strengthening Tribal Colleges and Universities
summary: Establishes in the Department of Education an Initiative on Native American education, co-chaired by three Secretaries, with NACIE as advisory council; agencies prepare plans. Revokes Executive Order 13592.

title: White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity for Black Americans
summary: Establishes a White House Initiative on Black Americans' education and economic opportunity in the Education Department, with an interagency working group and a 21-member advisory commission; revokes EO 13621.

title: Designation To Exercise Authority Over the National Defense Stockpile
summary: Designates the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment to release materials from the National Defense Stockpile, only for national defense needs and after consulting agency heads.

title: Implementation of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act
summary: Establishes an Infrastructure Implementation Task Force and a White House Infrastructure Coordinator in the EOP to coordinate the Infrastructure Act, and sets six priorities for agencies implementing it.

title: Improving Public Safety and Criminal Justice for Native Americans and Addressing the Crisis of Missing or Murdered Indigenous People
summary: Directs the Attorney General and Interior to develop a federal law enforcement strategy on violence against Native Americans and missing or murdered indigenous people, and directs data and prevention measures.

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the Situation in Burundi
summary: Terminates the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13712 on Burundi and revokes that order, ending the related entry suspension under Proclamation 8693 for covered individuals.

title: Nondisplacement of Qualified Workers Under Service Contracts
summary: Requires agencies to include in successor service contracts a clause giving predecessor contractors' service employees a right of first refusal, and revokes Executive Order 13897.

title: The National Space Council
summary: Sets the National Space Council's membership, chaired by the Vice President, and its duties on space policy, and creates a Users' Advisory Group. Revokes Executive Orders 13803 and 13906.

title: Catalyzing Clean Energy Industries and Jobs Through Federal Sustainability
summary: Sets federal sustainability goals, including carbon-free electricity by 2030, zero-emission vehicle purchases by 2035, and net-zero buildings by 2045, and reestablishes the Federal Chief Sustainability Officer. Revokes EO 13834.

title: Transforming Federal Customer Experience and Service Delivery To Rebuild Trust in Government
summary: Directs agencies to improve customer service, including online passport renewal and tax tools, and has OMB designate High Impact Service Providers and lead cross-agency customer experience work.

title: Imposing Sanctions on Foreign Persons Involved in the Global Illicit Drug Trade
summary: Declares a national emergency over the global illicit drug trade and authorizes the Treasury Secretary to impose blocking and other sanctions, plus entry suspension, on foreign persons involved in it.

title: Establishing the United States Council on Transnational Organized Crime
summary: Establishes the United States Council on Transnational Organized Crime, replacing a prior working group, and creates a Strategic Division at the Justice Department to produce whole-of-government counter-TOC plans.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2022 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, SES, Executive Schedule, uniformed services, judges and others, and sets locality pay; supersedes Executive Order 13970.

title: 2022 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts II and IV of the Manual for Courts-Martial as set out in an attached Annex, effective on the order's date, without making earlier acts punishable or invalidating proceedings already begun.

title: Use of Project Labor Agreements for Federal Construction Projects
summary: Requires agencies to have contractors on federal construction projects costing $35 million or more negotiate or join project labor agreements, subject to exceptions and reporting, and revokes Executive Order 13502.

title: Protecting Certain Property of Da Afghanistan Bank for the Benefit of the People of Afghanistan
summary: Declares a national emergency over Afghanistan and blocks Da Afghanistan Bank property held in U.S. financial institutions, which must move it into a consolidated account at the New York Federal Reserve.

title: Blocking Property of Certain Persons and Prohibiting Certain Transactions With Respect to Continued Russian Efforts To Undermine the Sovereignty and Territorial Integrity of Ukraine
summary: Expands the Ukraine national emergency; bans new U.S. investment, imports and exports involving the so-called DNR/LNR regions, blocks property of persons operating there, and suspends their entry.

title: Prohibiting Certain Imports and New Investments With Respect to Continued Russian Federation Efforts To Undermine the Sovereignty and Territorial Integrity of Ukraine
summary: Prohibits importing Russian-origin crude oil, petroleum products, liquefied natural gas and coal into the U.S., and new energy-sector investment in Russia by U.S. persons; expands the Executive Order 14024 emergency.

title: Ensuring Responsible Development of Digital Assets
summary: Directs agencies to produce reports, frameworks and plans on digital assets, including a U.S. central bank digital currency, consumer protection, illicit finance and international engagement.

title: Prohibiting Certain Imports, Exports, and New Investment With Respect to Continued Russian Federation Aggression
summary: Prohibits importing Russian-origin seafood, alcohol and non-industrial diamonds, exporting luxury goods and U.S. dollar banknotes to Russia, and new investment in Russian economic sectors designated by Treasury.

title: Advancing Economy, Efficiency, and Effectiveness in Federal Contracting by Promoting Pay Equity and Transparency
summary: Directs the FAR Council to consider proposed rules on pay equity and transparency for contractor employees, including limiting contractors' use of applicants' past or current compensation in hiring decisions.

title: Continuing To Strengthen Americans' Access to Affordable, Quality Health Coverage
summary: Directs agencies with health coverage responsibilities to review their actions to expand affordable coverage, improve quality, strengthen benefits and ease enrollment, examining six listed policy areas.

title: Prohibiting New Investment in and Certain Services to the Russian Federation in Response to Continued Russian Federation Aggression
summary: Prohibits new investment in Russia by U.S. persons and exports of Treasury-determined categories of services to persons in Russia, and bars U.S. persons from approving or financing prohibited foreign transactions.

title: Strengthening the Nation's Forests, Communities, and Local Economies
summary: Directs Interior and Agriculture to inventory mature and old-growth federal forests within a year and set reforestation targets, and directs State to report on combating international deforestation.

title: Enhancing the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee
summary: Establishes the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee of up to 26 appointed members to advise the President and NSTC subcommittees on the NQI Program, and revokes Executive Order 13885.

title: Advancing Effective, Accountable Policing and Criminal Justice Practices To Enhance Public Trust and Public Safety
summary: Directs federal law enforcement agencies to adopt use-of-force, chokehold, no-knock and body-camera policies, and orders the Attorney General to create a national database of officer misconduct records.

title: Advancing Equality for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Individuals
summary: Directs HHS, Education, HUD, Justice, State and OMB to run initiatives on LGBTQI+ health, schools, housing, child welfare, conversion therapy and data collection, with reports due within a year.

title: Protecting Access to Reproductive Healthcare Services
summary: Directs HHS to report within 30 days on expanding access to reproductive healthcare, including abortion, and creates an Interagency Task Force on Reproductive Healthcare Access, co-chaired by HHS and the Gender Policy Council.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between Certain Railroads Represented by the National Carriers' Conference Committee of the National Railway Labor Conference and Their Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a three-member emergency board, effective July 18, 2022, to investigate railroad–labor disputes under the Railway Labor Act and report to the President within 30 days.

title: Bolstering Efforts To Bring Hostages and Wrongfully Detained United States Nationals Home
summary: Declares a national emergency over hostage-taking and wrongful detention of U.S. nationals abroad, blocks property of responsible foreign persons, suspends their entry, and assigns interagency roles.

title: Securing Access to Reproductive and Other Healthcare Services
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to consider actions, including Medicaid for interstate travel, to advance reproductive healthcare access, promote non-discrimination compliance by providers, and evaluate health data efforts.

title: Implementation of the CHIPS Act of 2022
summary: Establishes the CHIPS Implementation Steering Council in the Executive Office of the President to coordinate CHIPS Act implementation, and sets agency priorities and OMB oversight of taxpayer funds.

title: Advancing Biotechnology and Biomanufacturing Innovation for a Sustainable, Safe, and Secure American Bioeconomy
summary: Directs agencies to produce reports, plans and programs on biotechnology and biomanufacturing R&D, data, biobased procurement, workforce, regulation, biosafety and threat assessment.

title: Implementation of the Energy and Infrastructure Provisions of the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022
summary: Establishes a White House Office on Clean Energy Innovation and Implementation to coordinate Inflation Reduction Act implementation, and amends EO 14008 to put its Senior Advisor in charge of the National Climate Task Force.

title: Ensuring Robust Consideration of Evolving National Security Risks by the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States
summary: Directs CFIUS to weigh supply chain resilience and technological leadership, plus aggregate investment trends, cybersecurity and sensitive data risks, in covered transactions, and to review its processes periodically.

title: Promoting the Arts, the Humanities, and Museum and Library Services
summary: Establishes the President's Committee on the Arts and the Humanities within IMLS to advise on arts and humanities policy, and directs agencies to coordinate with the NEA, NEH and IMLS on joint projects.

title: Expanding Eligibility for Certain Military Decorations and Awards
summary: Amends six orders on military decorations (Air Medal, Good Conduct, Bronze Star and others) to extend eligibility to the Space Force and Armed Forces generally, and updates gender-neutral wording.

title: Enhancing Safeguards for United States Signals Intelligence Activities
summary: Sets limits and safeguards on U.S. signals intelligence collection, handling and oversight, and creates a redress process with CLPO review and an appeal to a Data Protection Review Court.

title: Lowering Prescription Drug Costs for Americans
summary: Directs the HHS Secretary to consider Innovation Center payment and delivery models that lower drug costs for Medicare and Medicaid enrollees, report on selected models within 90 days, then test them.

title: Taking Additional Steps To Address the National Emergency With Respect to the Situation in Nicaragua
summary: Amends Executive Order 13851 on Nicaragua to add blocking criteria for the gold sector and arrests over free expression, and to prohibit certain imports, exports and new investment.

title: Establishing the President's Advisory Council on African Diaspora Engagement in the United States
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to establish, within 180 days, an Advisory Council of up to 12 members within the State Department to advise the President on engagement with the African Diaspora in the U.S.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2023 pay rates for federal statutory pay systems, the Senior Executive Service, executive, legislative and judicial offices, the uniformed services and administrative law judges, plus locality pay, superseding EO 14061.

title: Further Advancing Racial Equity and Support for Underserved Communities Through the Federal Government
summary: Requires named agencies to set up Agency Equity Teams and annual public Equity Action Plans, and creates a White House Steering Committee on Equity. Sets a 15 percent small disadvantaged business goal for FY2025.

title: Reducing Gun Violence and Making Our Communities Safer
summary: Requires reports on implementing the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act and directs agencies to act on gun violence, including a plan to clarify who must be a licensed firearms dealer.

title: Prohibition on Use by the United States Government of Commercial Spyware That Poses Risks to National Security
summary: Bars federal agencies from operational use of commercial spyware that poses significant counterintelligence, security or improper-use risks, and sets DNI assessments, review, waiver, procurement and reporting rules.

title: Modernizing Regulatory Review
summary: Amends EO 12866's definition of "significant regulatory action" (annual economic effect threshold now $200 million) and directs OIRA and agencies on public participation, and OMB to revise Circular A-4 within 1 year.

title: Increasing Access to High-Quality Care and Supporting Caregivers
summary: Directs agencies to improve pay and job quality for care workers, support family caregivers, make child care and long-term care more affordable, and expand the supply of care.

title: Revitalizing Our Nation's Commitment to Environmental Justice for All
summary: Directs agencies to make environmental justice part of their missions and submit strategic plans, and establishes a White House Office of Environmental Justice within CEQ.

title: Authority To Order the Ready Reserve of the Armed Forces to Active Duty To Address International Drug Trafficking
summary: Invokes 10 U.S.C. 12302 and authorizes the military service Secretaries and the Homeland Security Secretary (for the Coast Guard) to order Ready Reserve units and members to active duty for the drug trafficking emergency.

title: Imposing Sanctions on Certain Persons Destabilizing Sudan and Undermining the Goal of a Democratic Transition
summary: Expands the Sudan national emergency and blocks property of foreign persons found to threaten Sudan's stability or democratic transition, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Moving Beyond COVID-19 Vaccination Requirements for Federal Workers
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 14042 and 14043, ending COVID-19 vaccination requirements for federal employees and safety protocols for contractors, and requires agencies to rescind policies based on them.

title: Advancing Economic Security for Military and Veteran Spouses, Military Caregivers, and Survivors
summary: Directs OPM and OMB to issue a federal plan for hiring and retaining military and veteran spouses, caregivers and survivors; also directs agency actions on telework, child care and spouse-owned businesses.

title: Strengthening Access to Affordable, High-Quality Contraception and Family Planning Services
summary: Directs the Treasury, Labor, HHS, Defense, VA, OPM and Education heads to consider actions expanding affordable contraception access under the ACA, Medicaid, Medicare, and federal health programs.

title: Ordering the Selected Reserve and Certain Members of the Individual Ready Reserve of the Armed Forces to Active Duty
summary: Authorizes the Defense and Homeland Security Secretaries to order up to 3,000 Selected Reserve and Individual Ready Reserve members (no more than 450 IRR) to active duty for Operation Atlantic Resolve.

title: 2023 Amendments to the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States
summary: Amends the Manual for Courts-Martial through three annexes, effective on the order's date, per NDAA FY 2022 section 539C, and on December 27, 2023, and adds Appendices 12B, 12C and 12D.

title: Federal Research and Development in Support of Domestic Manufacturing and United States Jobs
summary: Requires R&D funding agencies to have recipients report where subject inventions are manufactured, and directs them to weigh domestic-manufacturing requirements and adopt common waiver questions.

title: Addressing United States Investments in Certain National Security Technologies and Products in Countries of Concern
summary: Declares a national emergency over countries of concern's advances in sensitive technologies and directs Treasury to issue regulations requiring notice of, and prohibiting, certain US investments in covered foreign persons.

title: United States Coast Guard Officer Personnel Management
summary: Delegates to the Secretary of Homeland Security presidential authority over Coast Guard officer appointments, selection boards and promotions, including wartime or emergency suspension of promotion laws.

title: Exemption of Paul H. Maurer From Mandatory Separation
summary: Exempts Paul H. Maurer, Special Agent in Charge of the George W. Bush Protective Detail in Dallas, from automatic mandatory separation under 5 U.S.C. 8425(b)(1), with Secret Service Director keeping supervisory authority.

title: Ensuring the People of East Palestine Are Protected Now and in the Future
summary: Directs federal agencies to support East Palestine recovery, requires a Federal Disaster Recovery Coordinator designation within 5 days, and orders EPA, HHS and DOT reports to the President.

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees and Amendments to Other Executive Orders
summary: Continues the listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2025, and amends Executive Orders 14031 and 14084 to adjust the duties of two presidential advisory bodies.

title: Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Directs federal agencies to set AI safety and security standards, require reporting from developers of dual-use foundation models, and issue AI guidance; establishes a White House AI Council.

title: Interagency Security Committee
summary: Establishes the Interagency Security Committee, chaired by the Homeland Security Secretary, to set security policies and standards for nonmilitary Federal facilities, and revokes Executive Order 12977.

title: Reforming Federal Funding and Support for Tribal Nations To Better Embrace Our Trust Responsibilities and Promote the Next Era of Tribal Self-Determination
summary: Directs OMB and the Domestic Policy Advisor to assess funding shortfalls for Tribal Nations and recommend additional funding, and directs agencies to reduce burdens and increase flexibility in Tribal funding programs.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2024 pay rates for federal civilian, uniformed service, executive, legislative, judicial and administrative law judge positions, and orders locality payments under Schedule 9. Supersedes EO 14090.

title: Taking Additional Steps With Respect to the Russian Federation's Harmful Activities
summary: Authorizes sanctions on foreign financial institutions facilitating significant transactions involving Russia's military-industrial base; expands EO 14068 import bans to seafood, alcohol, diamonds.

title: Imposing Certain Sanctions on Persons Undermining Peace, Security, and Stability in the West Bank
summary: Declares a national emergency and blocks property of foreign persons responsible for violence, displacement, or property destruction in the West Bank, and suspends their entry into the United States.

title: Amending Regulations Relating to the Safeguarding of Vessels, Harbors, Ports, and Waterfront Facilities of the United States
summary: Amends Coast Guard port security regulations (33 CFR part 6) to extend Captain of the Port and Commandant authorities, and reporting duties, to cyber incidents and digital infrastructure, adding definitions of damage and cyber incident.

title: Preventing Access to Americans' Bulk Sensitive Personal Data and United States Government-Related Data by Countries of Concern
summary: Directs the Attorney General to issue regulations prohibiting or restricting U.S. persons' transactions that give countries of concern access to bulk sensitive personal data or government-related data.

title: Termination of Emergency With Respect to the Situation in Zimbabwe
summary: Terminates the national emergency regarding Zimbabwe and revokes Executive Orders 13288, 13391 and 13469, while preserving pending actions, prior acts, and rights or penalties that arose before the order.

title: Scaling and Expanding the Use of Registered Apprenticeships in Industries and the Federal Government and Promoting Labor-Management Forums
summary: Creates a Registered Apprenticeship Interagency Working Group, directs agencies to expand apprenticeships in grants, procurement and hiring, and revokes EO 13812 to require Labor-Management Forums.

title: Advancing Women's Health Research and Innovation
summary: Directs agencies in the White House Initiative on Women's Health Research to strengthen research standards and prioritize funding for women's health, and HHS to assess menopause research within 90 days.

title: Recognizing and Honoring Women's History
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to report on sites of national importance tied to women's history, conduct a women's history theme study, review past studies, and seek National Park System Advisory Board recommendations.

title: COVID-19 and Public Health Preparedness and Response
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 13910, 13991 and 13998 on COVID-19, and transfers the COVID-19 Response Coordinator's duties to the OPPR Director while terminating the Coordinator and Deputy Coordinator positions.

title: White House Council on Supply Chain Resilience
summary: Codifies the White House Council on Supply Chain Resilience, co-chaired by the APNSA and APEP, and directs it to coordinate supply chain efforts and conduct quadrennial reviews, first report due December 31, 2024.

title: White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity Through Hispanic-Serving Institutions
summary: Establishes within the Department of Education an initiative on Hispanic-Serving Institutions, chaired by the Secretary, and creates a Presidential board of up to 21 members to advise on HSI policy.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate a Dispute Between New Jersey Transit Rail Operations and Its Locomotive Engineers Represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers and Trainmen
summary: Establishes an emergency board of three members to investigate the dispute between New Jersey Transit Rail Operations and its locomotive engineers, and requires it to report within 30 days.

title: Investing in America and Investing in American Workers
summary: Directs agencies to prioritize projects with high labor standards when awarding Investing in America funds, and establishes an Investing in Good Jobs Task Force in the Executive Office of the President.

title: Combating Emerging Firearms Threats and Improving School-Based Active-Shooter Drills
summary: Establishes an interagency Emerging Firearms Threats Task Force to report on machinegun conversion devices and 3D printed firearms, and directs Education and DHS to publish school active-shooter drill guidance.

title: Establishing a Second Emergency Board To Investigate a Dispute Between New Jersey Transit Rail Operations and Its Locomotive Engineers Represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers and Trainmen
summary: Establishes a second three-member emergency board, effective November 22, 2024, to investigate the dispute between New Jersey Transit Rail Operations and its locomotive engineers and report its selection of the most reasonable offer.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 24, 2024
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 24, 2024, while letting agency heads keep essential offices open for national security, defense, or public need.

title: 2024 Amendments to the Manual for Courts Martial, United States
summary: Amends Parts II–V of the Manual for Courts-Martial per an annex, and prescribes regulations for randomized selection of court-martial members to the maximum extent practicable.

title: Amendments to Executive Orders Relating to Certain Certificates and Badges
summary: Amends the orders on the Presidential Service Certificate and Badge and the Vice Presidential Service Badge, revising who is eligible, who awards them, and when the badges may be worn.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2025 pay rates for the General Schedule, Foreign Service, SES, Executive Schedule, uniformed services, judges and ALJs, and sets locality payments. Supersedes Executive Order 14113.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on January 9, 2025
summary: Closes all executive departments and agencies on January 9, 2025, in respect for James Earl Carter, Jr., letting agency heads keep essential offices open and treating the day as a holiday for pay and leave.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Agriculture
summary: Sets the order in which listed Department of Agriculture officials act as Secretary when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unable to serve, and revokes Executive Order 13612 of 2012.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Homeland Security
summary: Sets the order of succession for acting Secretary of Homeland Security: TSA Administrator, Under Secretary for Intelligence and Analysis, FLETC Director, then FEMA Region 3 Administrator. Revokes EO 13753.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Justice
summary: Designates, in order, the United States Attorneys for the Southern District of New York, Arizona, Northern Illinois and Hawaii to act as Attorney General; revokes Executive Order 13787.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of the Treasury
summary: Sets the order in which listed Treasury officials, starting with Under Secretaries and the General Counsel, act as Secretary when the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unable to serve; revokes EO 13735.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Office of Management and Budget
summary: Sets the order in which twelve OMB officials, starting with the Deputy Director for Management, act as Director when the Director and Deputy Director are unavailable, and revokes Executive Order 13615.

title: Providing an Order of Succession Within the Office of the National Cyber Director
summary: Sets the order in which six Office of the National Cyber Director officials, starting with the Deputy National Cyber Director, act as Director when the Director dies, resigns, or is unable to serve.

title: Taking Additional Steps With Respect to the Situation in the Western Balkans
summary: Amends Executive Order 14033 to expand Western Balkans property-blocking sanctions to persons involved in corruption, undermining peace agreements, or human rights abuse, and to spouses and adult children of those blocked.

title: Advancing United States Leadership in Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure
summary: Directs Defense and Energy to identify Federal sites to lease for frontier AI data centers and clean energy, and directs agencies to expedite permitting and grid access for them.

title: Taking Additional Steps With Respect to the Situation in Syria
summary: Amends Executive Order 13894 by striking the phrase on Turkey's military offensive, replacing subsections (1)(a)(i)(B)-(F) with new (B) and (C) on blocked persons, and striking subsection 8(f).

title: Providing for the Appointment of Alumni of AmeriCorps to the Competitive Service
summary: Allows agency heads to noncompetitively appoint AmeriCorps alumni to competitive service positions, with the AmeriCorps CEO certifying those who completed at least 1,700 hours of national service.

title: Strengthening and Promoting Innovation in the Nation's Cybersecurity
summary: Directs agencies to strengthen cybersecurity in software supply chains, federal systems and communications, and AI use; amends EO 13694 to revise cyber sanctions criteria.

title: Helping Left-Behind Communities Make a Comeback
summary: Directs Commerce to coordinate federal investments with implementing agencies on place-based economic development in covered communities; agencies must favor and assist grant applicants there.

title: Partial Revocation of Executive Order 13961
summary: Revokes sections 1, 3, 4, 5 and 7 of EO 13961 on federal mission resilience, renumbers the rest, and replaces its Executive Committee reference with the Restricted Principals Committee under the National Continuity Policy memorandum.

title: Ending the Weaponization of the Federal Government
summary: Directs the Attorney General and Director of National Intelligence to review the last 4 years of enforcement and intelligence activities and report remedial recommendations to the President.

title: Initial Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions
summary: Revokes dozens of 2021–2025 executive orders and presidential memoranda, and directs the DPC, NEC and National Security Advisor to review related actions and recommend further rescissions within 45 days.

title: Restoring Freedom of Speech and Ending Federal Censorship
summary: Bars federal officials from acting against the order's free speech policy, and directs the Attorney General to investigate the past 4 years of federal activity and recommend remedies.

title: America First Policy Directive to the Secretary of State
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to issue guidance, as soon as practicable, aligning the Department of State's policies, programs, personnel, and operations with an "America First" foreign policy.

title: Ending Radical and Wasteful Government DEI Programs and Preferencing
summary: Directs OMB to coordinate ending federal DEI and DEIA programs, and requires agencies within 60 days to terminate DEI and equity offices, positions, plans and grants and report related lists to OMB.

title: Holding Former Government Officials Accountable for Election Interference and Improper Disclosure of Sensitive Governmental Information
summary: Directs the DNI, consulting the CIA Director, to revoke the active security clearances of 50 named individuals including John Bolton, and to report within 90 days on related conduct and discipline.

title: Unleashing Alaska's Extraordinary Resource Potential
summary: Directs agencies to rescind or revise actions inconsistent with expanded Alaska resource development and prioritize Alaska LNG. Orders Interior, Agriculture and Army to reverse specific Alaska land and leasing decisions.

title: Unleashing American Energy
summary: Directs agencies to review and suspend, revise or rescind actions burdening domestic energy, revokes twelve earlier executive orders, and pauses Inflation Reduction Act and infrastructure law funds.

title: Withdrawing the United States From the World Health Organization
summary: Withdraws the U.S. from the World Health Organization, revoking the 2021 retraction letter and EO 13987, pausing WHO funding, recalling personnel, and halting Pandemic Agreement negotiations.

title: Declaring a National Energy Emergency
summary: Declares a national energy emergency and directs agencies to use emergency authorities, including Army Corps permitting and ESA consultation rules, to expand domestic energy supply.

title: Designating Cartels and Other Organizations as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and Specially Designated Global Terrorists
summary: Declares a national emergency under IEEPA over cartels and other transnational organizations and directs the Secretary of State to recommend terrorist designations within 14 days.

title: Establishing and Implementing the President's "Department of Government Efficiency"
summary: Renames the U.S. Digital Service the U.S. DOGE Service, creates a temporary DOGE organization ending July 4, 2026, requires agency DOGE Teams, and gives USDS access to agency records and IT systems.

title: Protecting the American People Against Invasion
summary: Revokes four 2021 immigration orders and directs agencies to prioritize immigration enforcement, including Homeland Security Task Forces in all States and detention facilities.

title: Protecting the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship
summary: Bars federal agencies from issuing or accepting citizenship documents for children born in the US to mothers unlawfully or temporarily present and fathers not citizens or permanent residents.

title: Protecting the United States From Foreign Terrorists and Other National Security and Public Safety Threats
summary: Directs State, Justice, DHS and DNI to expand vetting and screening of aliens, restore the January 19, 2021 screening baseline, and report within 60 days on countries warranting admission suspensions.

title: Putting America First in International Environmental Agreements
summary: Directs the U.N. Ambassador to notify withdrawal from the Paris Agreement and other UNFCCC commitments, ends related financial commitments, and revokes the U.S. International Climate Finance Plan.

title: Realigning the United States Refugee Admissions Program
summary: Suspends entry of refugees under the USRAP from January 27, 2025, with case-by-case exceptions, halts refugee application decisions, requires 90-day resumption reports, and revokes EO 14013.

title: Restoring the Death Penalty and Protecting Public Safety
summary: Directs the Attorney General to pursue the death penalty, including for killings of law-enforcement officers and capital crimes by illegal aliens, and to ensure states have lethal injection drugs.

title: Securing Our Borders
summary: Directs Defense and DHS to build barriers and deploy personnel at the southern border; directs DHS to detain apprehended aliens, resume Migrant Protection Protocols and end CBP One parole.

title: Application of Protecting Americans From Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act to TikTok
summary: Directs the Attorney General not to enforce the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act against TikTok for 75 days, and to issue guidance and no-liability letters to providers.

title: Clarifying the Military's Role in Protecting the Territorial Integrity of the United States
summary: Directs the Secretary of Defense to deliver a Unified Command Plan revision assigning USNORTHCOM the mission to seal the borders, and to add border planning requirements to defense guidance.

title: Defending Women From Gender Ideology Extremism and Restoring Biological Truth to the Federal Government
summary: Defines sex as male or female for all federal agency use, requires agencies to apply these definitions in forms, IDs, and single-sex spaces, and rescinds five earlier executive orders.

title: Reevaluating and Realigning United States Foreign Aid
summary: Pauses new obligations and disbursements of foreign development assistance for 90 days pending program reviews, with OMB enforcing the pause and the Secretary of State able to waive it for specific programs.

title: Reforming the Federal Hiring Process and Restoring Merit to Government Service
summary: Directs the Domestic Policy adviser to develop a Federal Hiring Plan within 120 days, including a time-to-hire under 80 days, and tasks OPM with setting performance metrics and monitoring progress.

title: Restoring Accountability to Policy-Influencing Positions Within the Federal Workforce
summary: Reinstates Executive Order 13957 with amendments, renaming Schedule F as Schedule Policy/Career, and revokes Executive Order 14003; OPM must rescind the April 2024 civil service rule.

title: Restoring Names That Honor American Greatness
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to rename the Gulf of Mexico the "Gulf of America" and reinstate "Mount McKinley" within 30 days, and directs agency heads to review Board on Geographic Names appointees.

title: Ending Illegal Discrimination and Restoring Merit-Based Opportunity
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 11246, 12898, 13583 and 13672, ends federal contractor affirmative action requirements, and requires grant and contract certifications on unlawful DEI programs.

title: Revocation of Certain Executive Orders
summary: Revokes Executive Order 14042, on COVID safety protocols for federal contractors, and Executive Order 14043, which required coronavirus disease 2019 vaccination for federal employees.

title: Designation of Ansar Allah as a Foreign Terrorist Organization
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to report within 30 days on designating Ansar Allah (the Houthis) a Foreign Terrorist Organization and then act; USAID must end projects of partners tied to the group.

title: Declassification of Records Concerning the Assassinations of President John F. Kennedy, Senator Robert F. Kennedy, and the Reverend Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
summary: Directs the DNI and Attorney General to present plans for releasing records on the JFK assassination within 15 days, and on the RFK and Martin Luther King Jr. assassinations within 45 days.

title: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
summary: Establishes the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, with up to 24 members, to advise on science and technology policy, and revokes Executive Order 14007, which created the prior council.

title: Strengthening American Leadership in Digital Financial Technology
summary: Revokes EO 14067 and the Treasury's 2022 digital asset framework, establishes a Working Group on Digital Asset Markets to propose regulations, and prohibits agencies from establishing or promoting CBDCs.

title: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires an AI action plan within 180 days and directs agencies to suspend, revise, or rescind actions taken under EO 14110 that are inconsistent with the policy of sustaining U.S. AI dominance.

title: Council To Assess the Federal Emergency Management Agency
summary: Establishes a FEMA Review Council of up to 20 members, co-chaired by the Secretaries of Homeland Security and Defense, to assess FEMA and report recommended changes to the President within 180 days of its first meeting.

title: Emergency Measures To Provide Water Resources in California and Improve Disaster Response in Certain Areas
summary: Directs federal agencies to maximize water deliveries in Southern California, including Central Valley Project operations and ESA streamlining, and sets wildfire and Hurricane Helene recovery actions for housing, debris and roads.

title: Enforcing the Hyde Amendment
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 14076 and 14079 of 2022 and directs the OMB Director to issue guidance to agency heads on implementing the policy against federal funding of elective abortion.

title: Prioritizing Military Excellence and Readiness
summary: Directs the Defense Secretary to update military medical standards and end identification-based pronoun use. Bars opposite-sex facility use and rescinds policies issued under EO 14004.

title: Reinstating Service Members Discharged Under the Military's COVID-19 Vaccination Mandate
summary: Directs the Defense and Homeland Security Secretaries to offer reinstatement to service members discharged solely for refusing the COVID-19 vaccine, with former rank and full back pay and benefits, and to report progress within 60 days.

title: Restoring America's Fighting Force
summary: Directs Defense and Homeland Security (for the Coast Guard) to abolish all DEI offices, bars teaching of "divisive concepts" and gender ideology in the armed forces, and orders a DoD internal review.

title: The Iron Dome for America
summary: Directs the Secretary of Defense to submit, within 60 days, an architecture, requirements, implementation and funding plans for a next-generation missile defense shield, then to review theater missile defense.

title: Protecting Children From Chemical and Surgical Mutilation
summary: Directs agencies to end federal funding and coverage of puberty blockers, hormones and surgery for gender transition in people under 19, using grant conditions, HHS, TRICARE and FEHB actions.

title: Additional Measures To Combat Anti-Semitism
summary: Directs each agency head to report within 60 days on legal authorities usable against anti-Semitism and on pending campus anti-Semitism complaints, with added reporting duties for the AG and Education Secretary.

title: Celebrating America's 250th Birthday
summary: Establishes the White House Task Force on Celebrating America's 250th Birthday, housed in Defense, to plan the July 4, 2026 celebration, and reinstates the National Garden of American Heroes and monument-protection orders.

title: Ending Radical Indoctrination in K-12 Schooling
summary: Requires a 90-day strategy to end federal K-12 funding for gender and discriminatory equity ideology and protect parental rights; reestablishes the 1776 Commission in the Education Department.

title: Expanding Educational Freedom and Opportunity for Families
summary: Directs Education to issue guidance on using federal formula funds for K-12 school choice, and directs Labor, HHS, Defense and Interior to review programs and issue guidance or plans on school choice.

title: Unleashing Prosperity Through Deregulation
summary: Requires agencies to identify at least 10 existing regulations for repeal for each new regulation and sets cost caps, with OMB oversight; revokes OMB Circular A-4 of 2023 and reinstates the 2003 version.

title: Imposing Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Northern Border
summary: Imposes an additional 25 percent duty on imports of Canadian products, 10 percent on energy resources, from February 4, 2025, under an expanded national emergency over illicit drugs.

title: Imposing Duties To Address the Situation at Our Southern Border
summary: Imposes an additional 25 percent ad valorem duty on products of Mexico from February 4, 2025, and expands the southern border national emergency to cover Mexico's failure to intercept traffickers and drugs.

title: Imposing Duties To Address the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
summary: Imposes an additional 10 percent ad valorem duty on products of the PRC from February 4, 2025, and expands the southern-border national emergency to cover PRC failure to curb synthetic opioids.

title: A Plan for Establishing a United States Sovereign Wealth Fund
summary: Directs the Treasury and Commerce Secretaries to develop and submit to the President within 90 days a plan for a sovereign wealth fund, covering funding, investment, structure, governance and legal needs.

title: Progress on the Situation at Our Northern Border
summary: Pauses the additional 25 percent tariffs on Canadian products (10 percent on energy products) until March 4, 2025, amends the February 1 order's dates, and withdraws its in-transit exceptions.

title: Progress on the Situation at Our Southern Border
summary: Pauses the additional 25 percent tariff on products of Mexico until March 4, 2025, by amending the dates in the February 1 order, and withdraws that order's exceptions for goods in transit.

title: Withdrawing the United States From and Ending Funding to Certain United Nations Organizations and Reviewing United States Support to All International Organizations
summary: Ends U.S. participation in the UN Human Rights Council, bars funding to UNRWA, and orders reviews of UNESCO membership (90 days) and of all international organizations and treaties (180 days).

title: Amendment to Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
summary: Replaces subsection (g) of section 2 of the February 1, 2025 China synthetic opioid duties order, keeping de minimis treatment available until the Commerce Secretary notifies the President that systems can process the tariffs.

title: Keeping Men Out of Women's Sports
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to prioritize Title IX enforcement to reserve women's sports for women, and agencies to rescind funding for noncompliant programs. Directs State to press sex-based rules internationally.

title: Eradicating Anti-Christian Bias
summary: Establishes a Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias within the Department of Justice, chaired by the Attorney General, to review agency conduct, recommend remedies, and report to the President; it ends after 2 years.

title: Imposing Sanctions on the International Criminal Court
summary: Declares a national emergency over ICC actions against protected persons, blocks property of the listed person and those the Secretary of State designates, and suspends their entry and that of ICC staff.

title: Addressing Egregious Actions of the Republic of South Africa
summary: Directs agencies to halt foreign aid to South Africa to the extent allowed by law, and directs State and Homeland Security to prioritize refugee resettlement for Afrikaners.

title: Establishment of the White House Faith Office
summary: Establishes the White House Faith Office in the Domestic Policy Council to lead executive branch work with faith-based groups, and amends five earlier orders to rename the office and agency centers.

title: Protecting Second Amendment Rights
summary: Directs the Attorney General to review agency actions for infringements of Second Amendment rights and submit a proposed plan of action within 30 days, then finalize it with the Domestic Policy Advisor.

title: Eliminating the Federal Executive Institute
summary: Directs the OPM Director to take all necessary steps to eliminate the Federal Executive Institute, and revokes the 1968 Presidential Memorandum and applicable provisions of EO 11348 that established or required it.

title: Ending Procurement and Forced Use of Paper Straws
summary: Directs agencies to eliminate procurement of paper straws and their provision in agency buildings, and orders a National Strategy to End the Use of Paper Straws within 45 days.

title: Pausing Foreign Corrupt Practices Act Enforcement To Further American Economic and National Security
summary: Directs the Attorney General to review FCPA enforcement guidelines for 180 days, extendable by 180 more, and to stop opening new FCPA investigations or actions, absent an exception, while reviewing existing cases.

title: Implementing the President's "Department of Government Efficiency" Workforce Optimization Initiative
summary: Directs agencies to prepare large-scale reductions in force and cap hiring at one employee per four departures, with DOGE Team Lead input on hires; OPM must propose new suitability criteria.

title: One Voice for America's Foreign Relations
summary: Directs the Secretary of State to reform the Foreign Service, including recruiting, evaluation and retention standards and the Foreign Affairs Manual, and to take personnel action for conduct warranting it.

title: Establishing the President's Make America Healthy Again Commission
summary: Establishes the President's Make America Healthy Again Commission, chaired by the HHS Secretary, to study childhood chronic disease and deliver an assessment within 100 days and a strategy within 180 days.

title: Establishing the National Energy Dominance Council
summary: Establishes the National Energy Dominance Council in the Executive Office of the President, chaired by the Interior Secretary, to advise on energy production and recommend a National Energy Dominance Strategy.

title: Keeping Education Accessible and Ending COVID-19 Vaccine Mandates in Schools
summary: Directs the Secretary of Education to issue guidelines on schools' legal obligations regarding COVID-19 mandates, and to submit within 90 days a plan to end them, including identifying federal funds at risk.

title: Ensuring Accountability for All Agencies
summary: Amends Executive Order 12866 so independent regulatory agencies submit significant regulatory actions to OIRA review, and directs OMB to set performance standards and adjust their apportionments.

title: Expanding Access to In Vitro Fertilization
summary: Directs the Assistant to the President for Domestic Policy to submit policy recommendations to the President within 90 days on protecting IVF access and reducing out-of-pocket and health plan costs for IVF.

title: Commencing the Reduction of the Federal Bureaucracy
summary: Eliminates non-statutory functions of the Presidio Trust, Inter-American Foundation, U.S. African Development Foundation and U.S. Institute of Peace, and ends the Federal Executive Boards and the PMF Program.

title: Ending Taxpayer Subsidization of Open Borders
summary: Directs agencies to identify programs that give illegal aliens benefits, align them with federal law, and enhance eligibility verification; OMB and DOGE identify other funding within 30 days.

title: Ensuring Lawful Governance and Implementing the President's "Department of Government Efficiency" Deregulatory Initiative
summary: Directs agency heads to review all regulations and identify unlawful or burdensome ones within 60 days, and to de-prioritize enforcement of those, with OIRA developing an agenda to rescind or modify them.

title: Addressing the Threat to National Security From Imports of Copper
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to open a section 232 investigation into the national security effects of copper imports and to report findings and recommendations to the President within 270 days.

title: Making America Healthy Again by Empowering Patients With Clear, Accurate, and Actionable Healthcare Pricing Information
summary: Directs the Treasury, Labor, and HHS Secretaries to implement and enforce healthcare price transparency rules, including within 90 days requiring actual prices, standardized data, and updated enforcement policies.

title: Implementing the President's "Department of Government Efficiency" Cost Efficiency Initiative
summary: Directs agency heads to build payment-justification systems and review contracts, grants and contracting processes within 30 days. Also requires travel justifications, freezes agency credit cards for 30 days, and sets real property steps.

title: Addressing the Threat to National Security From Imports of Timber, Lumber, and Their Derivative Products
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to open a section 232 investigation into the national security effects of timber, lumber and derivative product imports, and to report to the President within 270 days.

title: Designating English as the Official Language of the United States
summary: Designates English as the official language of the United States and revokes Executive Order 13166 on limited English proficiency. Directs the Attorney General to rescind guidance issued under it.

title: Immediate Expansion of American Timber Production
summary: Directs Interior and Agriculture to issue timber production guidance, set a 4-year federal timber sale target and adopt categorical exclusions, and directs agencies to cut permitting delays and burdensome rules.

title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Northern Border
summary: Amends the northern border duties order to allow duty-free de minimis treatment for eligible covered articles until the Commerce Secretary notifies the President that systems can process and collect the tariffs.

title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Situation at Our Southern Border
summary: Amends EO 14194 so duty-free de minimis treatment stays available for covered southern-border articles until the Commerce Secretary notifies the President that systems can process and collect the tariffs.

title: Further Amendment to Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
summary: Raises the ad valorem tariff on products of the People's Republic of China under Executive Order 14195 from 10 percent to 20 percent, citing the PRC's inadequate steps against the illicit drug crisis.

title: Honoring Jocelyn Nungaray
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to rename the Anahuac National Wildlife Refuge the Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge within 30 days and to issue guidance so federal references reflect the new name.

title: Addressing Risks From Perkins Coie LLP
summary: Suspends security clearances of Perkins Coie personnel pending review, directs agencies to end contracts and services for the firm, and limits its employees' access to federal buildings and hiring.

title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Northern Border
summary: Exempts Canadian goods entered duty-free under the USMCA from the additional tariffs in Executive Order 14193, and cuts the duty on non-exempt potash from 25 to 10 percent, effective March 7, 2025.

title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Southern Border
summary: Exempts Mexican goods entered duty-free under USMCA-related HTSUS provisions from the additional tariff in EO 14194, and cuts the additional duty on non-exempt potash from 25 to 10 percent, effective March 7, 2025.

title: Establishment of the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and United States Digital Asset Stockpile
summary: Directs Treasury to set up a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve of forfeited bitcoin, not to be sold, and a Digital Asset Stockpile of other forfeited digital assets; agencies must report their holdings within 30 days.

title: Establishing the White House Task Force on the FIFA World Cup 2026
summary: Establishes the White House Task Force on the FIFA World Cup 2026, chaired by the President, to coordinate agencies on the 2025 Club World Cup and 2026 World Cup; it is housed in DHS and ends December 31, 2026.

title: Restoring Public Service Loan Forgiveness
summary: Directs the Secretary of Education to propose revisions to 34 CFR 685.219 so the Public Service Loan Forgiveness definition of "public service" excludes organizations with a substantial illegal purpose, as listed.

title: Additional Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions
summary: Revokes 18 Biden-era executive orders, national security memoranda, presidential memoranda and presidential determinations, including those on the federal contractor minimum wage, biotechnology, and arms transfers.

title: Addressing Risks From Paul Weiss
summary: Directs agencies to suspend security clearances of Paul Weiss personnel and Mark Pomerantz, end Government services to the firm, review its contracts, and limit its employees' access and hiring.

title: Continuing the Reduction of the Federal Bureaucracy
summary: Directs seven entities, including the Institute of Museum and Library Services and the Minority Business Development Agency, to eliminate non-statutory functions and cut statutory ones to the legal minimum.

title: Achieving Efficiency Through State and Local Preparedness
summary: Directs the Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs to publish a National Resilience Strategy in 90 days and review infrastructure, continuity and preparedness policies.

title: Eliminating Waste and Saving Taxpayer Dollars by Consolidating Procurement
summary: Directs agency heads to propose having GSA conduct their common-goods procurement, GSA to draft a consolidation plan, and OMB to name GSA's Administrator executive agent for Government-wide IT acquisition contracts.

title: Immediate Measures To Increase American Mineral Production
summary: Directs agencies to expedite permits for priority mineral production projects, prioritizes mining on federal lands, and delegates Defense Production Act powers to the Defense Secretary and DFC.

title: Improving Education Outcomes by Empowering Parents, States, and Communities
summary: Directs the Secretary of Education to take all necessary lawful steps to close the Department of Education and return education authority to States and localities, and to condition Department funds on legal compliance.

title: Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos
summary: Directs agency heads to give designated federal officials full access to unclassified agency records and systems to pursue waste and fraud priorities, and to rescind guidance blocking data sharing within 30 days.

title: Addressing Remedial Action by Paul Weiss
summary: Revokes Executive Order 14237 of March 14, 2025, which addressed risks from the law firm Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP, citing the firm's agreed policy changes and pro bono commitments.

title: Imposing Tariffs on Countries Importing Venezuelan Oil
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of State to impose a 25 percent tariff, on or after April 2, 2025, on goods from countries importing Venezuelan oil, and has Commerce determine which countries do.

title: Addressing Risks From Jenner & Block
summary: Suspends security clearances of Jenner & Block personnel, ends government-provided resources to the firm, and directs agencies to review contracts with it and terminate those hiring it.

title: Modernizing Payments To and From America's Bank Account
summary: Directs Treasury to stop issuing paper checks for federal disbursements after September 30, 2025, and agencies to move to electronic payments, with limited exceptions and alternative payment options.

title: Preserving and Protecting the Integrity of American Elections
summary: Directs the Election Assistance Commission to require proof of citizenship on the federal voter registration form and directs agencies to verify voter citizenship and enforce election laws.

title: Protecting America's Bank Account Against Fraud, Waste, and Abuse
summary: Requires Treasury pre-certification fraud and improper-payment verification of agency payments, consolidation of agency financial systems, and a reduction of agencies' separate disbursing authority in favor of Treasury.

title: Addressing Risks From WilmerHale
summary: Directs agencies to suspend security clearances of WilmerHale personnel pending review, end government services to the firm, require contractors to disclose business with it, and review contracts and hiring.

title: Exclusions From Federal Labor-Management Relations Programs
summary: Amends Executive Order 12171 to exclude the Departments of State, Defense, Justice and others, plus Foreign Service subdivisions, from federal labor-management relations statutes.

title: Making the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful
summary: Establishes the D.C. Safe and Beautiful Task Force to coordinate crime-fighting in the District, and directs the Interior Secretary to create a beautification program and clear encampments.

title: Restoring Truth and Sanity to American History
summary: Directs the Vice President to pursue the order's policies at the Smithsonian via its Board of Regents, and the Interior Secretary to review monuments changed since 2020 and reinstate them.

title: Combating Unfair Practices in the Live Entertainment Market
summary: Directs the Attorney General, FTC and Treasury to enforce competition, ticketing, price-transparency and tax laws against ticket scalpers and the live entertainment market, and to report within 180 days.

title: Establishing the United States Investment Accelerator
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to establish the United States Investment Accelerator within 30 days to help investors with investments above $1 billion navigate regulation, and places the CHIPS Program Office under it.

title: Further Amendment to Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China as Applied to Low-Value Imports
summary: Ends duty-free de minimis treatment for low-value PRC and Hong Kong goods from May 2, 2025, and sets postal-item duties of 30% of value or $25 per item, rising to $50 on June 1, 2025.

title: Regulating Imports With a Reciprocal Tariff To Rectify Trade Practices That Contribute to Large and Persistent Annual United States Goods Trade Deficits
summary: Imposes an additional 10 percent duty on imports from all trading partners from April 5, 2025, and higher country-specific rates for Annex I partners from April 9, with Annex II exemptions.

title: Extending the TikTok Enforcement Delay
summary: Extends until June 19, 2025 the Justice Department's delay in enforcing the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act against TikTok, and directs the Attorney General to issue guidance and no-liability letters.

title: Amendment to Reciprocal Tariffs and Updated Duties as Applied to Low-Value Imports From the People's Republic of China
summary: Raises the reciprocal tariff on PRC goods from 34% to 84% effective April 9, 2025, and raises the low-value import duty from 30% to 90% and postal item duties from $25 to $75 and $50 to $150.

title: Protecting American Energy From State Overreach
summary: Directs the Attorney General to identify State and local laws burdening energy development that may be preempted or unconstitutional, and to act to stop their enforcement.

title: Reinvigorating America's Beautiful Clean Coal Industry and Amending Executive Order 14241
summary: Directs designation of coal as a mineral under Executive Order 14241, prioritization of coal leasing on Federal lands, and agency review of policies that discourage coal.

title: Strengthening the Reliability and Security of the United States Electric Grid
summary: Directs the Energy Secretary to expedite Federal Power Act section 202(c) emergency orders, develop a grid reserve margin methodology, and set a protocol to retain critical generation resources.

title: Addressing Risks From Susman Godfrey
summary: Directs agencies to suspend security clearances held by Susman personnel, cease providing resources to the firm, and review contracts with Susman or its business partners.

title: Maintaining Acceptable Water Pressure in Showerheads
summary: Directs the Secretary of Energy to publish a Federal Register notice rescinding the 2021 Definition of Showerhead rule, including the definition at 10 C.F.R. 430.2, effective 30 days after publication.

title: Modernizing Defense Acquisitions and Spurring Innovation in the Defense Industrial Base
summary: Directs the Secretary of Defense to submit plans to reform defense acquisition processes and the acquisition workforce, and to review major defense acquisition programs for possible cancellation.

title: Modifying Reciprocal Tariff Rates To Reflect Trading Partner Retaliation and Alignment
summary: Suspends country-specific reciprocal tariff rates until July 9, 2025, imposing a 10 percent duty on Annex I trading partners, and raises the tariff rate on PRC goods to 125 percent.

title: Reducing Anti-Competitive Regulatory Barriers
summary: Directs agency heads to review their regulations for anti-competitive effects and, within 70 days, send the FTC Chairman and Attorney General a list with rescission or modification recommendations.

title: Reforming Foreign Defense Sales To Improve Speed and Accountability
summary: Directs State and Defense to implement conventional arms transfer policy, propose raising congressional notification thresholds, and set priority partner and end-item lists within 60 days, with plans due in 90 and 120 days.

title: Restoring America's Maritime Dominance
summary: Requires a Maritime Action Plan within 210 days to rebuild U.S. shipbuilding and maritime workforce, with agency reports, legislative proposals, Section 301 trade actions, and port cargo fee enforcement.

title: Zero-Based Regulatory Budgeting To Unleash American Energy
summary: Requires EPA, DoE, FERC, NRC, and certain Interior and Army components to issue sunset rules by Sept. 30, 2025, so covered energy regulations expire after 1 year unless extended after public comment.

title: Ensuring Commercial, Cost-Effective Solutions in Federal Contracts
summary: Directs agencies to review open solicitations for non-commercial products and services and to require senior procurement executive written approval of new non-commercial procurements, with OMB reporting.

title: Ensuring National Security and Economic Resilience Through Section 232 Actions on Processed Critical Minerals and Derivative Products
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary to start a section 232 investigation of national security effects of processed critical mineral imports and derivative products, with a final report due within 180 days.

title: Lowering Drug Prices by Once Again Putting Americans First
summary: Directs HHS and other officials to lower drug costs via Medicare negotiation guidance, a high-cost drug payment model, health center insulin and epinephrine access, and faster importation approval.

title: Restoring Common Sense to Federal Office Space Management
summary: Revokes Executive Orders 12072 and 13006 on siting federal facilities in central business districts and historic properties, and directs GSA to begin amending its space management regulations to conform.

title: Restoring Common Sense to Federal Procurement
summary: Directs the OFPP Administrator, with the FAR Council and agencies, to amend the FAR within 180 days to keep only statutorily required or necessary provisions. Agencies must name acquisition officials to align supplements.

title: Restoring American Seafood Competitiveness
summary: Directs Commerce to review and reduce fishing regulations, develop an America First Seafood Strategy and a seafood trade strategy with USTR, and review marine national monuments for commercial fishing.

title: Advancing Artificial Intelligence Education for American Youth
summary: Establishes the White House Task Force on Artificial Intelligence Education, chaired by the OSTP Director, to plan a Presidential AI Challenge and direct agencies on AI education, educator training and apprenticeships.

title: Preparing Americans for High-Paying Skilled Trade Jobs of the Future
summary: Directs the Secretaries of Labor, Commerce and Education to review federal workforce programs and report in 90 days, and to submit a plan in 120 days to reach 1 million new active apprentices.

title: Reforming Accreditation To Strengthen Higher Education
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to hold accreditors accountable, up to ending recognition, for violating federal law, and to adopt new accreditation principles and recognition reforms.

title: Reinstating Commonsense School Discipline Policies
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to issue Title VI school discipline guidance within 30 days and act on noncompliance; directs the Defense Secretary to issue a revised school discipline code.

title: Restoring Equality of Opportunity and Meritocracy
summary: Directs agencies to deprioritize enforcement of laws and regulations that include disparate-impact liability, revokes Presidential approvals of certain DOJ Title VI regulations, and orders the Attorney General to repeal or amend them.

title: Transparency Regarding Foreign Influence at American Universities
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to enforce Section 117 foreign-funding disclosure by universities, with the Attorney General, including audits and investigations. Makes compliance certification material for grants.

title: White House Initiative To Promote Excellence and Innovation at Historically Black Colleges and Universities
summary: Establishes the White House Initiative on HBCUs in the Executive Office of the President and a President's Board of Advisors in the Education Department, and revokes Executive Order 14041.

title: Strengthening Probationary Periods in the Federal Service
summary: Adds Civil Service Rule XI, ending probationary and trial-period service unless the agency certifies the appointment advances the public interest, and supersedes 5 CFR part 315, subpart H.

title: Unleashing America's Offshore Critical Minerals and Resources
summary: Directs Commerce to expedite seabed mineral licensing beyond national jurisdiction and Interior to expedite Outer Continental Shelf permits and leases, and orders agency reports and mapping plans on seabed minerals.

title: Enforcing Commonsense Rules of the Road for America's Truck Drivers
summary: Directs DOT and FMCSA to rescind the 2016 English proficiency guidance, issue new inspection guidance, and make English violations out-of-service offenses. Also orders review of non-domiciled CDLs.

title: Protecting American Communities From Criminal Aliens
summary: Directs the Attorney General and DHS Secretary to publish a list of sanctuary jurisdictions, and agencies to identify federal funds to those jurisdictions for suspension or termination, with legal enforcement steps.

title: Strengthening and Unleashing America's Law Enforcement To Pursue Criminals and Protect Innocent Citizens
summary: Directs the Attorney General to create legal defense and indemnification for officers and to review police consent decrees; directs more excess military assets to local law enforcement.

title: Addressing Certain Tariffs on Imported Articles
summary: Bars stacking of tariffs on the same article: auto tariffs preclude the border and steel/aluminum tariffs, and the border tariffs preclude steel/aluminum tariffs. Applies retroactively to entries from March 4, 2025.

title: Ending Taxpayer Subsidization of Biased Media
summary: Directs the CPB Board to end direct and indirect funding of NPR and PBS, and directs all agency heads to identify and terminate any federal funding of them to the extent the law allows.

title: Establishment of the Religious Liberty Commission
summary: Establishes the Religious Liberty Commission, with up to 14 members, to produce a report on religious liberty in America and advise the White House Faith Office; it terminates July 4, 2026 unless extended.

title: Improving the Safety and Security of Biological Research
summary: Directs OSTP to issue guidance ending federal funding of dangerous gain-of-function research abroad and suspending it domestically, and to revise oversight policies and nucleic acid screening rules.

title: Regulatory Relief To Promote Domestic Production of Critical Medicines
summary: Directs FDA, EPA and the Army Corps to streamline regulatory review of domestic pharmaceutical manufacturing, strengthens FDA inspection of foreign facilities, and makes EPA lead permitting agency for EIS projects.

title: Fighting Overcriminalization in Federal Regulations
summary: Requires each agency to report to OMB and publicly post its criminal regulatory offenses, penalties and mens rea standards, and directs agencies to state mens rea in new rules.

title: Increasing Efficiency at the Office of the Federal Register
summary: Directs the Archivist, through the Office of the Federal Register, to reduce publication delays, report publication times to OMB, and review fee schedules so fees reflect actual publication costs.

title: Keeping Promises to Veterans and Establishing a National Center for Warrior Independence
summary: Directs the VA Secretary to designate a National Center for Warrior Independence on the West Los Angeles VA Campus for homeless veterans, with an action plan in 120 days to house up to 6,000 by 2028.

title: Delivering Most-Favored-Nation Prescription Drug Pricing to American Patients
summary: Directs HHS to communicate most-favored-nation price targets to drug makers within 30 days, with rulemaking, importation and enforcement steps if progress is lacking.

title: Modifying Reciprocal Tariff Rates To Reflect Discussions With the People's Republic of China
summary: Suspends for 90 days 24 points of the additional tariff on Chinese goods, leaving a 10 percent rate from May 14, 2025, and cuts the duty on low-value postal imports from China from 120 to 54 percent.
