title: Deploying Advanced Nuclear Reactor Technologies for National Security
summary: Directs the Army to run a nuclear reactor at a domestic base by Sept. 30, 2028, Energy to designate reactor sites and release HALEU fuel, and State to pursue new nuclear export agreements.

title: Ordering the Reform of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
summary: Directs the NRC to reorganize with staff reductions and wholly revise its regulations, with proposed rules in 9 months, final rules in 18, and fixed licensing deadlines (18 months for new reactors).

title: Reforming Nuclear Reactor Testing at the Department of Energy
summary: Directs the Energy Secretary to speed Department of Energy advanced reactor testing, aiming for operation within 2 years, and to create a pilot program approving at least three reactors outside the National Laboratories.

title: Reinvigorating the Nuclear Industrial Base
summary: Directs the Energy Secretary to plan expanded uranium conversion and enrichment, halt surplus plutonium disposal by dilution, seek fuel agreements with industry, and prioritize nuclear funding and workforce programs.

title: Restoring Gold Standard Science
summary: Directs OSTP to issue Gold Standard Science guidance and requires agencies to update scientific integrity policies, disclose influential data and models, and document uncertainty in using scientific information.

title: Leading the World in Supersonic Flight
summary: Directs the FAA to repeal the overland supersonic flight ban in 14 CFR 91.817 within 180 days and set an interim noise standard. Directs OSTP to coordinate supersonic research and the FAA to propose a noise rule.

title: Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty
summary: Establishes a Federal Task Force on drone threats and directs the FAA, Justice and Homeland Security to issue drone-flight restriction rules, enforce airspace laws, and expand drone detection and counter-UAS capacity.

title: Sustaining Select Efforts To Strengthen the Nation's Cybersecurity and Amending Executive Order 13694 and Executive Order 14144
summary: Amends EO 14144 to strike several cybersecurity provisions and add deadlines on secure software, post-quantum cryptography and AI. Limits EO 13694 sanctions criteria to foreign persons.

title: Unleashing American Drone Dominance
summary: Directs the FAA to propose a rule enabling routine BVLOS drone operations, establishes an eVTOL pilot program, and directs Commerce to secure drone supply chains and expand exports.

title: Empowering Commonsense Wildfire Prevention and Response
summary: Directs Interior and Agriculture to consolidate their wildland fire programs within 90 days and to develop a technology roadmap and local preparedness measures. Also directs EPA and others to review wildfire-related rules.

title: Implementing the General Terms of the United States of America-United Kingdom Economic Prosperity Deal
summary: Establishes an annual quota of 100,000 UK automobiles at a combined 10 percent tariff, lowers tariffs on UK auto parts and civil aircraft products, and directs Commerce to design UK steel and aluminum quotas.

title: Further Extending the TikTok Enforcement Delay
summary: Extends the TikTok enforcement delay until September 17, 2025, barring Justice Department enforcement of the Act during and before that period, and directs the Attorney General to issue guidance and letters to providers.

title: Establishing a White House Office for Special Peace Missions
summary: Establishes the Office for Special Peace Missions within the White House Office, headed by a presidentially appointed Special Envoy who works with State, Defense and other agencies to end conflicts abroad.

title: Providing for the Revocation of Syria Sanctions
summary: Terminates the Syria national emergency and revokes six sanctions orders effective July 1, 2025, and expands Executive Order 13894 sanctions to Assad-regime officials and captagon traffickers.

title: Establishing the President's Make America Beautiful Again Commission
summary: Establishes the President's Make America Beautiful Again Commission, chaired by the Interior Secretary, to advise on conserving natural resources and expanding public land access; sets land agency policies.

title: Making America Beautiful Again by Improving Our National Parks
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to develop a strategy to raise national park entrance and pass fees for nonresidents, favor U.S. residents in access rules, and review park rules; revokes a 2017 memorandum.

title: Ending Market Distorting Subsidies for Unreliable, Foreign-Controlled Energy Sources
summary: Directs Treasury to strictly enforce termination of the 45Y and 48E tax credits for wind and solar, tighten "beginning of construction" rules, and implement foreign-entity limits; directs Interior to remove wind/solar preferences.

title: Extending the Modification of the Reciprocal Tariff Rates
summary: Extends the suspension of the higher reciprocal tariff rates on listed trading partners, other than China, from July 9 to August 1, 2025, by suspending specified HTSUS headings and notes.

title: Creating Schedule G in the Excepted Service
summary: Creates Schedule G in the excepted service for noncareer policy-making or policy-advocating positions, amending Civil Service Rule VI, and directs OPM to issue implementing regulations and the VA Secretary's appointment criteria.

title: Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure
summary: Directs agencies to expedite permitting of large data center and related component projects through financing, NEPA exclusions, FAST-41 and federal land; revokes EO 14141.

title: Preventing Woke AI in the Federal Government
summary: Requires agencies to procure only large language models meeting "truth-seeking" and "ideological neutrality" principles, directs OMB to issue guidance within 120 days, and requires contract terms for compliance.

title: Promoting the Export of the American AI Technology Stack
summary: Establishes the American AI Exports Program at Commerce to select full-stack AI export packages, and directs the Economic Diplomacy Action Group to coordinate federal financing for them.

title: Ending Crime and Disorder on America's Streets
summary: Directs agencies to promote civil commitment of people with mental illness on the streets, favor grants for jurisdictions enforcing camping and drug bans, and end 'housing first' support.

title: Saving College Sports
summary: Directs the Education Secretary to develop a plan within 30 days to preserve non-revenue sports scholarships and bar third-party pay-for-play payments to college athletes; directs DOJ, FTC and Labor to act on litigation and athlete status.

title: Addressing Threats to the United States by the Government of Brazil
summary: Declares a national emergency over actions of the Government of Brazil and imposes an additional 40 percent ad valorem duty on Brazilian imports, with exceptions listed in Annex I.

title: Suspending Duty-Free De Minimis Treatment for All Countries
summary: Ends duty-free de minimis treatment for all shipments from all countries, effective August 29, 2025, and sets ad valorem or specific per-package duties ($80 to $200) for international postal shipments.

title: Amendment to Duties To Address the Flow of Illicit Drugs Across Our Northern Border
summary: Raises the additional duty on Canadian products under EO 14193 from 25 to 35 percent from August 1, 2025, and sets a 40 percent duty and penalties for goods transshipped to evade it.

title: Further Modifying the Reciprocal Tariff Rates
summary: Replaces the reciprocal tariff rates with country-specific additional duties listed in Annex I, applies 10 percent to unlisted partners, and sets a 40 percent duty on goods transshipped to evade duties.

title: President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition, and the Reestablishment of the Presidential Fitness Test
summary: Amends EO 13265 to establish the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition and reestablish the Presidential Fitness Test, and revokes EOs 13824 and 12345.

title: Establishing the White House Task Force on the 2028 Summer Olympics
summary: Establishes the White House Task Force on the 2028 Summer Olympics, chaired by the President, to coordinate federal security, transportation, and visa planning for the Games; it terminates December 31, 2028.

title: Addressing Threats to the United States by the Government of the Russian Federation
summary: Imposes an additional 25 percent ad valorem duty on imports of articles of India because it imports Russian Federation oil, and directs Commerce and State to assess other countries doing likewise.

title: Democratizing Access to Alternative Assets for 401(k) Investors
summary: Directs the Labor Secretary to reexamine ERISA fiduciary guidance on alternative assets in 401(k) plans within 180 days and propose clarifying rules or safe harbors; tells the SEC to consider easing access.

title: Guaranteeing Fair Banking for All Americans
summary: Directs federal banking regulators to remove reputation risk from their guidance and exam materials and review institutions for debanking, and directs the SBA to require lenders to reinstate affected clients.

title: Improving Oversight of Federal Grantmaking
summary: Requires agency heads to designate a senior appointee to review funding announcements and discretionary grants, and directs OMB to revise grant guidance to allow termination for convenience.

title: Declaring a Crime Emergency in the District of Columbia
summary: Requires the DC Mayor to provide Metropolitan Police Department services for Federal purposes for the maximum period under the Home Rule Act, and delegates direction of those services to the Attorney General.

title: Further Modifying Reciprocal Tariff Rates To Reflect Ongoing Discussions With the People's Republic of China
summary: Extends until November 10, 2025 the suspension of the additional country-specific tariff on imports from China, and directs agencies to implement the extension.

title: Enabling Competition in the Commercial Space Industry
summary: Directs Transportation to expedite environmental reviews and reevaluate 14 CFR Part 450 for launch and reentry licenses, and directs agencies to speed spaceport development and Commerce to propose novel-activity authorizations.

title: Ensuring American Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Resilience by Filling the Strategic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Reserve
summary: Directs ASPR to list about 26 critical drugs, ready the SAPIR repository, and obtain a 6-month supply of their APIs, preferring domestic makers. It also requires an updated essential medicines list and plan.

title: Revocation of Executive Order on Competition
summary: Revokes Executive Order 14036 of July 9, 2021 (Promoting Competition in the American Economy), which had set out a government-wide approach to competition policy.

title: Improving Our Nation Through Better Design
summary: Establishes the America by Design initiative and a National Design Studio with a Chief Design Officer in the White House Office, and directs agencies to consult the Officer and show initial results by July 4, 2026.

title: Additional Measures To Address the Crime Emergency in the District of Columbia
summary: Directs more Park Police and prosecutors in D.C., a specialized D.C. National Guard unit and a national Guard quick reaction force, a federal recruiting portal, and HUD and DOT inspections.

title: Measures To End Cashless Bail and Enforce the Law in the District of Columbia
summary: Directs federal officials to seek federal custody and charges for D.C. arrestees and the Attorney General to review MPD policies and assess D.C.'s cash bail ban, with agencies to identify actions to press D.C. to change it.

title: Prosecuting Burning of the American Flag
summary: Directs the Attorney General to prioritize prosecuting flag desecration that violates content-neutral laws, and directs denial of immigration benefits to foreign nationals who desecrate the flag.

title: Taking Steps To End Cashless Bail To Protect Americans
summary: Directs the Attorney General to list jurisdictions that have substantially eliminated cash bail, and directs agencies to identify federal funds to those jurisdictions that may be suspended or terminated.

title: Further Exclusions From the Federal Labor- Management Relations Program
summary: Amends Executive Order 12171 to exclude from federal labor-management relations coverage Bureau of Reclamation hydropower units, parts of Commerce and NOAA, NASA, and the U.S. Agency for Global Media.

title: Making Federal Architecture Beautiful Again
summary: Makes classical and traditional architecture the preferred style for major Federal buildings and directs GSA to update its procedures, staffing and design reviews, with notice to the President for divergent designs.

title: Implementing the United States-Japan Agreement
summary: Sets the additional ad valorem duty on products of Japan so the total with the Column 1 Duty Rate is 15 percent, including automobiles and parts, and ends certain tariffs on aircraft products.

title: Modifying the Scope of Reciprocal Tariffs and Establishing Procedures for Implementing Trade and Security Agreements
summary: Replaces Annex II to EO 14257 with an updated list of goods outside reciprocal tariffs, modifies the HTSUS, and directs Commerce and the USTR to implement framework and final trade agreements.

title: Restoring the United States Department of War
summary: Authorizes "Secretary of War" and "Department of War" as secondary titles for the Secretary and Department of Defense, and directs a 60-day recommendation on permanently renaming the Department.

title: Strengthening Efforts To Protect U.S. Nationals From Wrongful Detention Abroad
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of State to designate State Sponsors of Wrongful Detention and directs responses on designation, such as sanctions, visa, passport, aid and export restrictions.

title: Establishing an Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between the Long Island Rail Road Company and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes an emergency board of three members to investigate disputes between the Long Island Rail Road and employees represented by five labor organizations, and to report to the President within 30 days.

title: Further Extending the TikTok Enforcement Delay
summary: Extends the TikTok enforcement delay to December 16, 2025, barring Justice Department enforcement of the Act for past or current conduct, and directs the Attorney General to issue guidance and no-liability letters to providers.

title: The Gold Card
summary: Directs Commerce, State and Homeland Security to set up a "Gold Card" expedited immigrant visa program for aliens giving $1 million (individual) or $2 million (corporation) to Commerce, within 90 days.

title: Saving TikTok While Protecting National Security
summary: Determines the TikTok divestiture framework is a qualified divestiture under the Act and bars DOJ enforcement for 120 days. Revokes the 2024 delegation memorandum and amends the 2020 Musical.ly divestment order.

title: Assuring the Security of the State of Qatar
summary: Commits the U.S. to treat an armed attack on Qatar as a threat to U.S. peace and security and to take lawful measures in response, and directs the Secretary of War to maintain joint contingency planning with Qatar.

title: Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees
summary: Continues the listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2027, and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for them to the designated agency heads.

title: Unlocking Cures for Pediatric Cancer With Artificial Intelligence
summary: Directs the MAHA Commission to develop ways to use AI for pediatric cancer diagnosis and treatment, starting with the Childhood Cancer Data Initiative, and to pursue more funding. Tasks HHS with AI data-interoperability standards.

title: Ensuring Continued Accountability in Federal Hiring
summary: Bars filling vacant Federal civilian positions or creating new ones except as provided, and requires each agency to create a Strategic Hiring Committee and an Annual Staffing Plan.

title: Modifying Duties Addressing the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain in the People's Republic of China
summary: Reduces the additional duty on products of the PRC under Executive Order 14195 from 20 percent to 10 percent, effective November 10, 2025, and amends the HTSUS accordingly.

title: Modifying Reciprocal Tariff Rates Consistent With the Economic and Trade Arrangement Between the United States and the People's Republic of China
summary: Continues suspending the heightened reciprocal tariffs on imports from the PRC until November 10, 2026, to implement the US-PRC trade arrangement, and directs agencies to monitor PRC compliance.

title: Fostering the Future for American Children and Families
summary: Directs HHS to modernize state child-welfare data and systems, publish an annual state scorecard, and set up a "Fostering the Future" initiative for youth in or leaving foster care, plus faith-partner steps.

title: Modifying the Scope of the Reciprocal Tariffs With Respect to Certain Agricultural Products
summary: Exempts certain agricultural products from the reciprocal tariffs by modifying the Harmonized Tariff Schedule and updating Annex II and the aligned-partners annex, effective November 13, 2025.

title: Modifying the Scope of Tariffs on the Government of Brazil
summary: Exempts certain agricultural products from the additional 40 percent duty on Brazilian goods under EO 14323, modifying the Harmonized Tariff Schedule and updating Annex I, effective November 13, 2025.

title: Designation of Certain Muslim Brotherhood Chapters as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and Specially Designated Global Terrorists
summary: Directs State and Treasury to report within 30 days on designating Muslim Brotherhood chapters, including in Lebanon, Jordan and Egypt, as terrorist organizations, then act within 45 days of the report.

title: Launching the Genesis Mission
summary: Establishes the Genesis Mission, a national AI-for-science effort, and directs the Energy Secretary to build and run the American Science and Security Platform and to identify at least 20 science challenges.

title: Addressing Security Risks From Price Fixing and Anti-Competitive Behavior in the Food Supply Chain
summary: Directs the Attorney General and FTC Chairman to each establish a Food Supply Chain Security Task Force to investigate anti-competitive behavior and foreign control in food supply chains, and to brief Congress.

title: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
summary: Directs the Attorney General to set up an AI Litigation Task Force to challenge State AI laws, and directs Commerce, FCC, and FTC actions on State AI laws, including limits on BEAD funding for States.

title: Protecting American Investors From Foreign-Owned and Politically-Motivated Proxy Advisors
summary: Directs the SEC to review and consider revising rules on proxy advisors and shareholder proposals, the FTC to investigate proxy advisor practices, and the Labor Secretary to revise ERISA fiduciary guidance.

title: Designating Fentanyl as a Weapon of Mass Destruction
summary: Designates illicit fentanyl and its core precursor chemicals as weapons of mass destruction and directs agencies to pursue prosecutions, financial actions, and Defense and Homeland Security measures.

title: Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
summary: Sets 2026 pay schedules for federal civilian, Senior Executive Service, executive, legislative, judicial and military personnel, plus locality pay, and directs OPM to assess up to 3.8% for law enforcement.

title: Ensuring American Space Superiority
summary: Directs agencies to implement space policy priorities (Moon return by 2028, lunar outpost by 2030) through plans and acquisition reforms, and revokes the National Space Council order.

title: Increasing Medical Marijuana and Cannabidiol Research
summary: Directs the Attorney General to expeditiously complete rulemaking to move marijuana to Schedule III, and directs work with Congress and HHS agencies on hemp-derived CBD product definitions and research.

title: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 24, 2025, and December 26, 2025
summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 24 and 26, 2025, while letting agency heads keep certain offices open and staff on duty for national security or public need.

title: Prioritizing the Warfighter in Defense Contracting
summary: Directs the Secretary of War to identify underperforming defense contractors that made buy-backs or distributions, and to bar such payouts in future contracts during underperformance.

title: Safeguarding Venezuelan Oil Revenue for the Good of the American and Venezuelan People
summary: Declares a national emergency and bars attachment or other judicial process against Venezuelan oil revenue funds held in Treasury accounts, directing Treasury to hold them as Venezuela's property and assert immunity.

title: Establishing a Second Emergency Board To Investigate Disputes Between the Long Island Rail Road Company and Certain of Its Employees Represented by Certain Labor Organizations
summary: Establishes a second three-member emergency board, effective January 16, 2026, to investigate Long Island Rail Road labor disputes; it must report on the most reasonable final offer after offers are submitted.

title: Designating the Board of Peace as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain Privileges, Exemptions, and Immunities
summary: Designates the Board of Peace as a public international organization entitled to the privileges, exemptions, and immunities provided by the International Organizations Immunities Act.

title: Stopping Wall Street From Competing With Main Street Homebuyers
summary: Directs agencies to issue guidance barring federal support for or sale of single-family homes to large institutional investors, and directs Treasury, DOJ, FTC and HUD to review and act on investor purchases.

title: Addressing State and Local Failures To Rebuild Los Angeles After Wildfire Disasters
summary: Directs FEMA and SBA to consider rules preempting State and local permitting for federally funded disaster rebuilding with builder self-certification; orders audit of California's HMGP funds.

title: Continuance of the Federal Emergency Management Agency Review Council
summary: Continues the FEMA Review Council created by Executive Order 14180 until March 25, 2026, and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for it to the Secretary of Homeland Security.

title: Addressing Addiction Through the Great American Recovery Initiative
summary: Establishes the White House Great American Recovery Initiative, co-chaired by the HHS Secretary and a Senior Advisor, to coordinate federal addiction treatment and recovery efforts and advise agencies.

title: Addressing Threats to the United States by the Government of Cuba
summary: Declares a national emergency regarding Cuba and sets a process under which Commerce and State determine possible additional tariffs on goods from countries that supply oil to Cuba.

title: Celebrating American Greatness With American Motor Racing
summary: Directs the Interior and Transportation Secretaries to designate a Washington, D.C. route for the Freedom 250 Grand Prix INDYCAR race within 14 days and to expedite the permits and approvals it needs.

title: Addressing Threats to the United States by the Government of Iran
summary: Sets a process for additional tariffs, e.g. 25 percent, on goods of countries acquiring Iranian goods or services: Commerce makes findings, State recommends, and the President decides.

title: Establishing an America First Arms Transfer Strategy
summary: Establishes an America First Arms Transfer Strategy using arms sales to expand U.S. defense production, and directs agencies to build a sales catalog, a task force, and streamlined processes.

title: Modifying Duties To Address Threats to the United States by the Government of the Russian Federation
summary: Ends the additional 25 percent duty on imports of products of India imposed under Executive Order 14329, effective February 7, 2026, and directs Commerce to monitor whether India resumes importing Russian oil.

title: Protecting the National Security and Welfare of the United States and Its Citizens From Criminal Actors and Other Public Safety Threats
summary: Directs the Attorney General to give DHS access to criminal history record information held by DOJ for screening and vetting, and lets DHS exchange such records reciprocally with Visa Waiver Program and allied countries.

title: Strengthening United States National Defense With America's Beautiful Clean Coal Power Generation Fleet
summary: Directs the Secretary of War, with the Secretary of Energy, to seek long-term power purchase agreements with coal-fired plants to power DOW installations, prioritizing grid reliability, on-site fuel security and mission assurance.

title: Promoting the National Defense by Ensuring an Adequate Supply of Elemental Phosphorus and Glyphosate- Based Herbicides
summary: Delegates Defense Production Act contract-priority and allocation authority to the Agriculture Secretary to ensure supply of elemental phosphorus and glyphosate-based herbicides.

title: Continuing the Suspension of Duty-Free De Minimis Treatment for All Countries
summary: Continues the suspension of duty-free de minimis treatment for all countries and revises Executive Order 14324 so postal shipments pay a duty at the rate set in the February 20, 2026 import surcharge Proclamation.

title: Ending Certain Tariff Actions
summary: Provides that the additional ad valorem duties imposed pursuant to IEEPA in nine listed Executive Orders shall no longer be in effect or collected; the national emergencies remain in effect.

title: Combating Cybercrime, Fraud, and Predatory Schemes Against American Citizens
summary: Directs five agencies to review anti-cybercrime measures and submit an action plan against transnational criminal organizations. Directs State to press foreign governments to act.

title: Adjusting Certain Delegations Under the Defense Production Act
summary: Amends Executive Order 13603 to add the Secretary of Energy alongside the Commerce Secretary in section 203, each exercising the delegated authority independently. Clarifies agency heads need not recommend delegated actions under EO 14156.

title: Ensuring Truthful Advertising of Products Claiming To Be Made in America
summary: Directs the FTC to prioritize enforcement against unlawful "Made in America" claims and consider rules on online marketplace origin verification; agencies must verify origin claims in federal contracts.

title: Promoting Access to Mortgage Credit
summary: Directs the CFPB, bank regulators, FHFA, HUD, VA and USDA to consider easing mortgage rules for community and smaller banks, including ATR/QM, HMDA, capital, appraisal and e-signature changes; FHFA must report in 120 days.

title: Removing Regulatory Barriers to Affordable Home Construction
summary: Directs agencies to review and revise water, energy-efficiency and permitting rules affecting housing construction, and orders HUD to issue state and local regulatory best practices within 60 days.

title: Establishing the Task Force To Eliminate Fraud
summary: Establishes a Task Force to Eliminate Fraud in the Executive Office of the President, chaired by the Vice President, to coordinate national efforts against fraud in Federal benefit programs and set anti-fraud requirements.

title: Preserving America's Game
summary: Directs the Commerce Secretary and FCC Chairman to coordinate with the CFP Committee, NCAA and broadcasters to set an exclusive Army-Navy Game window with no other college football broadcast.

title: Further Continuance of the Federal Emergency Management Agency Review Council
summary: Continues the FEMA Review Council until 10 days after its report is submitted to the President or May 29, 2026, whichever is first, and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to the Homeland Security Secretary.

title: Addressing DEI Discrimination by Federal Contractors
summary: Requires agencies to put a clause in federal contracts and subcontracts barring racially discriminatory DEI activities, with termination and False Claims Act exposure for violations; directs OMB guidance and FAR changes.

title: Ensuring Citizenship Verification and Integrity in Federal Elections
summary: Directs DHS and SSA to compile State Citizenship Lists for election officials and the Postmaster General to propose USPS rules limiting ballot mail to enrolled voters, with barcoded envelopes.

title: Urgent National Action To Save College Sports
summary: Directs agencies that contract with or fund universities to weigh violations of college athletics rules in responsibility reviews, and the Attorney General to challenge conflicting State laws.

title: Accelerating Medical Treatments for Serious Mental Illness
summary: Directs FDA to give priority vouchers to Breakthrough-designated psychedelic drugs and set a Right to Try access pathway, and directs HHS to allocate at least $50 million to State psychedelic programs.

title: Promoting Efficiency, Accountability, and Performance in Federal Contracting
summary: Directs agencies to use fixed-price or performance-based contracts by default, requires written justification and dollar-threshold approval for non-fixed-price contracts, and orders review of each agency's 10 largest.

title: Promoting Retirement-Savings Access for American Workers by Establishing TrumpIRA.gov
summary: Directs the Treasury Secretary to establish the TrumpIRA.gov website by January 1, 2027, listing low-cost IRAs eligible for the Federal Saver's Match of up to $1,000, and to take steps to implement the match.

title: Imposing Sanctions on Those Responsible for Repression in Cuba and for Threats to United States National Security and Foreign Policy
summary: Blocks property of foreign persons tied to Cuba's government, listed sectors, human rights abuse or corruption, suspends their entry, and authorizes sanctions on foreign financial institutions dealing with them.

title: Integrating Financial Technology Innovation Into Regulatory Frameworks
summary: Directs Federal financial regulators to review within 90 days rules and processes affecting fintech firms and act within 180 days; asks the Federal Reserve to report on payment account access for covered firms.

title: Restoring Integrity to America's Financial System
summary: Directs Treasury to issue an advisory on financial-fraud red flags tied to non-work authorized populations and propose stronger Bank Secrecy Act due diligence rules; directs CFPB and bank regulators on credit risk.

title: Realigning United States Core Childhood Vaccine Recommendations With Best Practices From Peer, Developed Countries
summary: Directs CDC and ACIP to review HHS's peer-country scientific assessment and update the childhood vaccine schedule, and requires agencies to align actions and coverage with that schedule.

title: Removing Unnecessary and Counterproductive Restrictions on Access to Federal Lands
summary: Rescinds Executive Orders 11644 and 11989 on off-road vehicle use on public lands, and directs War, Interior, Agriculture, TVA and other agencies to start rulemakings to rescind or revise implementing regulations.

title: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
summary: Directs agencies to strengthen federal cyber defenses, form an AI cybersecurity clearinghouse, and design a voluntary framework for pre-release government access to covered frontier models.

title: Implementing Schedule Policy/Career in the Excepted Service
summary: Places the positions in its Appendix in Schedule Policy/Career, amends Civil Service Rules and two prior orders to implement it, and directs agencies to set aside bonus pools for these employees.

title: Strengthening Customs Enforcement
summary: Directs the Homeland Security Secretary to tighten importer-of-record rules (bonding, assets, disclosures, good standing, vetting, limits on foreign importers) and to strengthen penalties, disclosures and disposal of noncompliant imports.

title: Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks
summary: Directs agencies to transition to post-quantum cryptography; OMB guidance must require high value assets and high impact systems to use it for key establishment by 2030 and signatures by 2031.

title: Ushering in the Next Frontier of Quantum Innovation
summary: Directs an update of the National Quantum Strategy and establishes the QC-ADDS Effort to develop a quantum computer, with actions on quantum sensing, supply chains, workforce and security.

title: Advancing Regenerative Agriculture and Strengthening American Farm Resilience
summary: Directs EPA to prioritize registering alternatives to older active ingredients and review pre-harvest desiccation uses; directs USDA to maximize Regenerative Pilot Program funding.

title: Securing America's Defense Supply Chains and Ensuring Domestic Acquisition of Critical Materials
summary: Ends most 10 U.S.C. 4872(c)(1) waivers for covered materials after Jan. 1, 2027 unless a mitigation plan is accepted, and directs War Department supply chain mapping rules and domestic source qualification.

title: Restoring Trust in the Smithsonian Institution
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary, through the NPS, to install temporary signage and exhibits near the National Museum of American History citing the Report's findings; tasks officials to use available authorities on the Smithsonian.

title: Establishing the President's Military Spouse Commission
summary: Establishes the President's Military Spouse Commission, chaired by the Secretary of War's spouse, to advise the President on military spouse and family policies, with a report each fiscal year and a 2-year term.

title: Continuing To Protect the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship
summary: Prohibits agencies from issuing or accepting documents recognizing United States citizenship for persons when neither parent is a citizen and either is an alien enemy or foreign government employee.

title: Ending Birth Tourism
summary: Directs the Secretaries of State and Homeland Security to act against birth tourism on nonimmigrant visas, including denying or revoking visas and entry, and delegates INA section 215(a) authority to them.

title: Delivering Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations for Americans
summary: Declares childhood vaccine recommendations in three categories, directs HHS to present vaccine plans in 90 days, and directs the Attorney General to pursue legal actions on State exemption laws.

title: Declaring a National Emergency To Secure the United States Bulk-Power System
summary: Declares a national emergency over foreign supply of bulk-power system electric equipment and prohibits foreign-produced equipment transactions that the Energy Secretary determines pose undue risk.

title: Honoring the American History of the Great Lakes and Renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America
summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America" within 30 days and update the GNIS, and directs the Board on Geographic Names to guide federal references to the new name.

title: Establishing the United States Space Academy
summary: Establishes a Presidential Commission, chaired by the NASA Administrator, to report within 120 days on proposals for a NASA-led United States Space Academy, including governance, curriculum and service obligations.

title: Promoting Fair Competition in Livestock Markets and Expanding Market Access for American Meat Producers
summary: Directs the Agriculture Secretary to expand Packers and Stockyards Act enforcement and to widen interstate market access for State-inspected meat, including a new guaranteed loan program for small beef processors.

title: Supporting America's Ranchers
summary: Directs a 90-day review of regulations affecting ranchers, a delisting determination for gray and Mexican wolves, and a review of authority for mandatory beef country-of-origin labeling.

title: Accelerating Access to Veterans' Benefits and Employment Opportunities
summary: Requires the Secretaries of War and Veterans Affairs to set up ongoing sharing of military personnel and treatment records within 180 days and update the Transition Assistance Program.

title: Adjusting Certain Delegations Under the Defense Production Act
summary: Amends EO 13603 to add the Secretary of the Interior alongside the Secretary of Energy in Defense Production Act energy delegations, each acting independently, and routes energy disputes to the National Energy Dominance Council.

title: Providing Meaningful Water Quality Improvements Through Collaboration and Oversight of Federal Support
summary: Revokes Executive Order 13508 on Chesapeake Bay restoration, directs agencies to redirect Bay funding to direct water quality projects, and tasks EPA with working with jurisdictions to encourage repeal of stormwater fees.

title: Reinvigorating America's Hunting Heritage
summary: Directs Interior to allow hunting in Castle Mountains and Craters of the Moon national monuments and directs agencies to propose changes expanding hunting and fishing access on Federal lands.

title: Restoring American Saltwater Angling and Recreation
summary: Directs Commerce and NOAA to modernize recreational fishing data collection, including mobile reporting, and directs Interior to set up an offshore Reef-in-Place Program within 60 days.

title: Enhancing Program Integrity and Interagency Coordination in the Administration of the H-1B Nonimmigrant Visa Program
summary: Directs State, Labor and Homeland Security to consult Commerce, Education and SBA on H-1B filings and to weigh employer layoffs when considering H-1B applications, petitions and visas.

title: Streamlining Access to Government Services Through America.gov
summary: Directs the GSA Administrator to establish America.gov as a single online entry point for covered federal services, using Login.gov for authentication, and requires agencies to integrate their covered services.

title: Eliminating Disease-Carrying Pests and Restoring Enjoyment of the Great Outdoors
summary: Directs agencies to run a DC campaign to cut invasive mosquitoes 90% and ticks 50% by 2028. Also orders an EPA regulatory framework for new control technologies and HHS and USDA research prizes.

title: Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence
summary: Requires executive agencies to use "Super Intelligence" and "SI" in place of "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI" in non-statutory documents. Directs the APST to propose a legislative definition within 60 days.

title: Emergency Tax Relief on Diesel Fuel
summary: Directs the Treasury Secretary to determine within 5 days whether to defer diesel excise tax payments through December 31, 2026, and to have the IRS announce penalty relief for dyed diesel use.
